title: Vitamin B12 alleviates spliceosomopathy via phospholipid remodeling
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: mRNA splicing represents a fundamental level of gene regulation that alters proteomic diversity and cellular state. Its dysfunction can profoundly rewire metabolism, yet underlying mechanisms remain elusive. Here, we investigate Verheij syndrome, caused by mutations in core splicing factor PUF60, using a Caenorhabditis elegans model, human cell lines, and patient-derived samples. We demonstrate that RNP-6/PUF60 deficiency disrupts splicing of genes governing one-carbon metabolism and phospholipid remodeling, impairing S-adenosylmethionine/S-adenosylhomocysteine cycling and phosphatidylcholine synthesis. These perturbations trigger the integrated stress response and compromise mTORC1 signaling, causing developmental growth defects. Vitamin B12 supplementation restores metabolic balance by reactivating S-adenosylmethionine-dependent phospholipid remodeling and mTORC1 activity, effectively rescuing Verheij-like phenotypes. Similar responses arise from perturbing another splicing factor, PRP-19. Mechanistically, intron retention of nhr-114/HNF4 transcription factor drives these phenotypes, while restoring its splicing rescues them. Our findings implicate vitamin B12-dependent one-carbon metabolism as a metabolic modulator with therapeutic potential to mitigate Verheij syndrome and other spliceosomopathies.
title_zh: 维生素 B12 通过磷脂重塑缓解剪接病
abstract_zh: mRNA 剪接代表基因调控的基本水平，可改变蛋白质组多样性和细胞状态。它的功能障碍可以深刻地重新连接新陈代谢，但潜在的机制仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们使用秀丽隐杆线虫模型、人类细胞系和患者来源的样本研究了由核心剪接因子 PUF60 突变引起的 Verheij 综合征。我们证明，RNP-6/PUF60 缺陷会破坏控制一碳代谢和磷脂重塑的基因剪接，损害 S-腺苷甲硫氨酸/S-腺苷高半胱氨酸循环和磷脂酰胆碱合成。这些扰动会触发综合应激反应并损害 mTORC1 信号传导，导致发育生长缺陷。补充维生素 B12 通过重新激活 S-腺苷甲硫氨酸依赖性磷脂重塑和 mTORC1 活性来恢复代谢平衡，有效挽救 Verheij 样表型。干扰另一个剪接因子 PRP-19 也会产生类似的反应。从机制上讲，nhr-114/HNF4转录因子的内含子保留驱动了这些表型，而恢复其剪接则拯救了它们。我们的研究结果表明维生素 B12 依赖性一碳代谢作为一种代谢调节剂，具有减轻 Verheij 综合征和其他剪接病的治疗潜力。

title: Electrical control of exchange bias in sub-10 nm regime enabled by single-nanotube patterning
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Achieving stable magnetization in sub-10 nm ferromagnetic layers represents a fundamental bottleneck in spin-orbit torque magnetic random-access memory development. While exchange bias potentially offers stabilization at such scales through antiferromagnetic coupling, conventional lithography fundamentally limits nanoscale verification. Here, we introduce a lithography-free nanopatterning strategy exploiting individual carbon nanotubes as etching templates, enabling precise fabrication of exchange-biased heterostructures from tens of nanometers down to single-digit dimensions. In perpendicularly magnetized Pt/Co/IrMn stacks, we demonstrate robust exchange bias persistence even at sub-10 nm regimes and confirm effective spin-orbit torque switching through anomalous Hall effect measurements. Crucially, scaling reveals divergent switching mechanisms: Cobalt layers transition from multi-domain to abrupt single-domain reversal, while exchange bias switching maintains gradual characteristics consistent across sizes – indicating collective antiferromagnetic moment reorientation via exchange-spring dynamics. This work enables the physical patterning of sub-10 nm features for exchange bias stabilization, provides mechanistic insights into nanoscale magnetic switching, and establishes a viable pathway toward high-density spintronic memories.
title_zh: 通过单纳米管图案化实现亚 10 nm 范围内交换偏压的电控制
abstract_zh: 在亚 10 nm 铁磁层中实现稳定磁化是自旋轨道扭矩磁性随机存取存储器开发的基本瓶颈。虽然交换偏置可能通过反铁磁耦合在这种尺度上提供稳定性，但传统光刻从根本上限制了纳米级验证。在这里，我们引入了一种无需光刻的纳米图案化策略，利用单个碳纳米管作为蚀刻模板，从而能够精确制造从数十纳米到个位数尺寸的交换偏向异质结构。在垂直磁化的 Pt/Co/IrMn 堆栈中，即使在亚 10 nm 范围内，我们也展示了强大的交换偏置持久性，并通过反常霍尔效应测量确认了有效的自旋轨道扭矩切换。至关重要的是，缩放揭示了不同的切换机制：钴层从多域过渡到突然的单域反转，而交换偏置切换在不同尺寸之间保持一致的渐进特性 - 表明通过交换弹簧动力学进行集体反铁磁矩重新定向。这项工作实现了亚 10 nm 特征的物理图案化，以实现交换偏置稳定，提供了对纳米级磁开关的机械见解，并建立了一条通向高密度自旋电子存储器的可行途径。

title: Decoupling ferroelectric polarization and charge transport for thermally robust polymer dielectric energy storage
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Polymer dielectrics are vital for high-power electronics, yet their high-temperature application is fundamentally constrained by the inherent trade-offs among thermal stability, polarization retention, and conduction loss. Here, we mitigate these limitations by integrating high-entropy nanofillers with a preferentially oriented, wide-bandgap inorganic nanocoating to construct a multiscale heterointerfacial architecture. Within this design, entropy-driven compositional disorder enhances the structural stability and polarization response of the nanofillers, while the conformal inorganic network synergistically suppresses carrier injection and modulates bulk trap-mediated transport. Consequently, the engineered composites deliver a discharged energy density of 10.44 J cm−3 with 95% efficiency and a breakdown strength of 650 MV m−1 at room temperature. Notably, at 150 °C, the composites retain 8.35 J cm−3, 80% efficiency, and a breakdown strength of 610 MV m−1. First-principles calculations and phase-field simulations suggest multiscale field confinement that weakens electrothermal coupling and enhances high-temperature stability. This work establishes a comprehensive, multiscale design paradigm for next-generation polymer dielectric capacitors operating in extreme thermal environments.
title_zh: 解耦铁电极化和电荷传输，实现耐热聚合物介电储能
abstract_zh: 聚合物电介质对于高功率电子器件至关重要，但其高温应用从根本上受到热稳定性、极化保持和传导损耗之间固有权衡的限制。在这里，我们通过将高熵纳米填料与优先取向的宽带隙无机纳米涂层相结合来构建多尺度异质界面结构，从而缓解了这些限制。在该设计中，熵驱动的组成无序增强了纳米填料的结构稳定性和极化响应，而共形无机网络协同抑制载流子注入并调节本体陷阱介导的传输。因此，工程复合材料在室温下可提供 10.44 J cm−3 的放电能量密度、95% 的效率和 650 MV m−1 的击穿强度。值得注意的是，在 150 °C 时，复合材料保留了 8.35 J cm−3、80% 的效率和 610 MV m−1 的击穿强度。第一原理计算和相场模拟表明多尺度场限制可以减弱电热耦合并增强高温稳定性。这项工作为在极端热环境下运行的下一代聚合物介电电容器建立了全面的多尺度设计范例。

title: Evaluating technology upgrades as a complement to traditional bill assistance programs
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: State programs to improve energy affordability and reduce energy burden (the share of income spent on energy) could mitigate concerns about rising electricity prices. Many states offer bill assistance and rebates for weatherization and rooftop solar to income-qualifying households. Here, we analyse how these approaches may complement one another to improve energy affordability. Results illustrate trade offs between program costs and energy burden reduction, as well as between a program’s upfront and ongoing costs. Generally, the three strategies complement one another to improve energy affordability at lower net present cost than bill assistance alone, with varying effects across regions. Weatherization can reduce the solar installation capacity needed, and both together can reduce or eliminate ongoing reliance on bill assistance. Under full uptake among cost-effective households, fully rebated weatherization and solar rebated at $0.48/Watt, combined with bill assistance, yield the same modelled net present cost as bill assistance alone while reducing the share of low-income owner-occupied households with high energy burdens from 66% to 19%, compared with 34% under bill assistance alone. Absent tax credits, weatherization still reduces energy burden and bill assistance program costs, whereas solar may not be cost-competitive.
title_zh: 评估技术升级作为传统账单援助计划的补充
abstract_zh: 国家提高能源负担能力和减少能源负担（能源支出占收入比例）的计划可以减轻对电价上涨的担忧。许多州向符合收入资格的家庭提供防风雨和屋顶太阳能的账单援助和回扣。在这里，我们分析这些方法如何相互补充以提高能源负担能力。结果说明了项目成本和能源负担减轻之间以及项目的前期成本和持续成本之间的权衡。一般来说，这三种策略相辅相成，以比单独的账单援助更低的净当前成本提高能源负担能力，但不同地区的效果各不相同。防风雨可以减少所需的太阳能安装容量，两者结合起来可以减少或消除对账单援助的持续依赖。在具有成本效益的家庭全面采用的情况下，按 0.48 美元/瓦的全额回扣的防风雨和太阳能回扣，与账单援助相结合，产生与单独的账单援助相同的模型净现成成本，同时将高能源负担的低收入自住家庭的比例从 66% 减少到 19%，而单独的账单援助为 34%。如果没有税收抵免，耐候性仍然可以减轻能源负担和账单援助计划成本，而太阳能可能不具有成本竞争力。

title: Atomic-scale engineering of Pt shells on chiral Au nanoparticles for enhanced oxygen reduction
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Spin selection in chiral nanocatalysts enabled by the chiral-induced spin polarization (CISS) effect has emerged as a promising strategy for boosting the performance of the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR). However, achieving atomic-scale control of catalytically active surfaces on chiral nanostructures remains challenging. Herein, we demonstrate an approach for the atomic-level engineering of Pt shells on chiral substrates to enhance ORR performance. Pt shells with controlled thicknesses are deposited on chiral Au nanoparticles through a combined protocol of cyclic underpotential deposition and galvanic replacement reaction. This strategy not only maximizes the atomic utilization efficiency of Pt but also preserves the chiral geometry of the substrate and its chiroptical activity. For the chiral Au@Pt nanocatalysts, a volcano-type relationship is observed between the Pt shell thickness and ORR performance. The chiral Au@Pt nanoparticles exhibit a capability of spin polarization due to the CISS-like effect and competitive ORR activities. This work establishes a route for fabricating catalytically active chiral nanocatalysts with CISS-like effects, thereby laying a foundation for the development of advanced spin-selective electrocatalysts.
title_zh: 手性金纳米颗粒上铂壳的原子级工程以增强氧还原
abstract_zh: 由手性诱导自旋极化（CISS）效应实现的手性纳米催化剂中的自旋选择已成为提高氧还原反应（ORR）性能的有前途的策略。然而，实现手性纳米结构催化活性表面的原子尺度控制仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们展示了一种在手性基底上对 Pt 壳进行原子级工程以增强 ORR 性能的方法。通过循环欠电位沉积和电流置换反应的组合方案，将厚度受控的 Pt 壳沉积在手性金纳米颗粒上。该策略不仅最大化了 Pt 的原子利用效率，而且保留了基底的手性几何结构及其手性光学活性。对于手性 Au@Pt 纳米催化剂，在 Pt 壳厚度和 ORR 性能之间观察到火山型关系。由于类 CISS 效应和竞争性 ORR 活性，手性 Au@Pt 纳米颗粒表现出自旋极化能力。这项工作建立了一种制备具有类似CISS效应的催化活性手性纳米催化剂的路线，从而为先进自旋选择性电催化剂的开发奠定了基础。

title: Giant negative photomagnetism in an alterlattice
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Photomagnetism enables optical control of spin order for engineering non-equilibrium phases, yet studies remain largely confined to ferromagnetic systems. Here, we introduce the alterlattice, an emergent structural motif realized in the cation- and anion-deficient perovskite oxide La0.4Ca0.4TiO3–δ. The alterlattice is a three-dimensional alternately patterned superstructural network arising from structural competition, in which average lattice is described by Ibmm symmetry while local superstructure relaxes toward Cmmm symmetry. Within this motif, photo-induced antiferromagnetic correlations develop below 19 K. Under 473 nm illumination, the susceptibility of the alterlattice host decreases by 51.7% at 2 K and 1 T and rapidly recovers in the dark. The observed giant negative photomagnetism is associated with anisotropic strain fields that guide defect-mediated photocarrier transport, thereby driving the system from a spin-dilute paramagnetic state toward a short-range antiferromagnetic state with quasi-one-dimensional characteristics. The alterlattice opens a route to three-dimensional defect-topology engineering for non-equilibrium phases and antiferromagnetic spintronics.
title_zh: 交替晶格中的巨大负光磁性
abstract_zh: 光磁性能够对工程非平衡相的自旋顺序进行光学控制，但研究仍然主要局限于铁磁系统。在这里，我们介绍了交替晶格，这是在缺乏阳离子和阴离子的钙钛矿氧化物 La0.4Ca0.4TiO3-δ 中实现的一种新兴结构图案。交替晶格是由结构竞争产生的三维交替图案的上层结构网络，其中平均晶格由Ibmm对称性描述，而局部上层结构向Cmmm对称性弛豫。在该基序中，光诱导的反铁磁相关性在 19 K 以下发展。在 473 nm 照明下，交替晶格主体的磁化率在 2 K 和 1 T 下降低 51.7%，并在黑暗中迅速恢复。观察到的巨大负光磁性与引导缺陷介导的光载流子传输的各向异性应变场相关，从而驱动系统从自旋稀顺磁态转向具有准一维特性的短程反铁磁态。交替晶格为非平衡相和反铁磁自旋电子学的三维缺陷拓扑工程开辟了一条道路。

title: Spatiotemporally coupled sulfur chemistry for stable silicon-90+ anodes
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Silicon-based materials stand as tantalizing battery anodes for markedly advancing performance indicators of today’s rechargeable lithium-ion batteries; however, their structural degradations, together with detestable side reactions residing in electrode-electrolyte interphases, greatly hinder the delivery of energy promises under practical conditions. Herein, we introduce the spatiotemporally coupled sulfur chemistry as an effective antidote to cope with the volume change and structural integrity of near-full silicon anodes, and concurrently modulate inherent properties of electrode-electrolyte interphases layers enlisting elasticity and ion diffusivity. The sulfur regulated approach is readily achieved by overlaying silicon with a homogenous layer of elemental sulfur, which is highly compatible with present production facilities for lithium-ion batteries industry. The prototype LiNi0.9Co0.05Mn0.05O2 | |Si90+ pouch cell at ampere-hour level (7.3 Ah) delivers great performances assessed simultaneously by energy density (1190 Wh L−1 for cell), specific energy (416 Wh kg−1 for cell), and cycle life (80% capacity retention after 1700 cycles). In light of the significantly improved battery performance and practical applicability, the sulfur regulated Si90+ anodes thus could be considered as a game-changer for offering reliable power source and rapidly turning emerging applications into reality.
title_zh: 用于稳定硅 90+ 阳极的时空耦合硫化学
abstract_zh: 硅基材料是诱人的电池阳极，可显着提高当今可充电锂离子电池的性能指标；然而，它们的结构退化，以及电极-电解质界面中令人讨厌的副反应，极大地阻碍了实际条件下能量承诺的实现。在此，我们引入时空耦合的硫化学作为一种有效的解毒剂，以应对近全硅阳极的体积变化和结构完整性，并同时调节电极-电解质界面层的固有特性，包括弹性和离子扩散率。通过在硅上覆盖均匀的元素硫层可以很容易地实现硫调节方法，这与锂离子电池行业现有的生产设施高度兼容。原型LiNi0.9Co0.05Mn0.05O2 | |安时级 (7.3 Ah) 的 Si90+ 软包电池可提供出色的性能，同时通过能量密度（电池为 1190 Wh L−1）、比能量（电池为 416 Wh kg−1）和循环寿命（1700 次循环后容量保持率为 80%）来评估。鉴于电池性能和实际适用性的显着提高，硫调节的 Si90+ 阳极可以被认为是提供可靠电源并快速将新兴应用变为现实的游戏规则改变者。

title: Deterministic wet etching of aspheric fiber microlenses with tunable conic geometry for tailored optical functionality
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Efficient coupling between guided optical fiber modes and radiated fields in the surrounding medium remains a fundamental limitation across photonics, sensing, and biophotonics. Micro-lensed fibers offer a promising solution, yet scalable fabrication with predictable geometry and deterministic optical performance has remained elusive. Here, we introduce laser-controlled wet-chemical etching (LCWCE), a single-parameter strategy that directly sculpts micro-lenses, from hyperbolic to parabolic and prolate elliptical profiles, on standard optical fibers. Local laser illumination establishes an axially confined etching-rate gradient, enabling sub-micrometer control of curvature and working distance independent of fiber type or internal structure. A physics-separated multiphysics framework combining wave optics, heat-transfer, and temperature-dependent etching kinetics captures the observed geometry evolution and validates the underlying mechanism. LCWCE enables milliwatt-scale, minimal-power fiber-based optical trapping, as well as minimally invasive in vivo dendritic detection and single-cell neural interrogation beyond 1.5 mm depth in live brains, transforming ubiquitous optical fibers into scalable, high-performance photonic probes.
title_zh: 具有可调圆锥几何形状的非球面光纤微透镜的确定性湿法蚀刻，可实现定制的光学功能
abstract_zh: 引导光纤模式与周围介质中的辐射场之间的有效耦合仍然是光子学、传感和生物光子学的基本限制。微透镜光纤提供了一种有前途的解决方案，但具有可预测的几何形状和确定性光学性能的可扩展制造仍然难以实现。在这里，我们介绍激光控制湿化学蚀刻（LCWCE），这是一种单参数策略，可在标准光纤上直接雕刻微透镜，从双曲线到抛物线和长椭圆形轮廓。局部激光照明建立了轴向限制的蚀刻速率梯度，从而能够对曲率和工作距离进行亚微米控制，而与光纤类型或内部结构无关。物理分离的多物理场框架结合了波动光学、传热和温度相关的蚀刻动力学，捕获了观察到的几何演化并验证了潜在的机制。 LCWCE 能够实现毫瓦级、基于最小功率光纤的光学捕获，以及微创体内树突检测和活体大脑中超过 1.5 毫米深度的单细胞神经询问，将无处不在的光纤转变为可扩展的高性能光子探针。

title: Iron Oxide Photoanode for Glycerol-Assisted Hydrogen Production at 8.87 mA cm–2
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Iron oxide (α-Fe2O3) is an attractive photoanode for photoelectrochemical water splitting because of its abundance, suitable band gap, and stability in water, yet its practical use remains limited by poor charge transport and sluggish water oxidation. Here we show that these limitations can be addressed using a Ge and Ti co-doped Fe2O3 photoanode that couples glycerol oxidation with cathodic hydrogen evolution under simulated one-sun illumination (100 mW cm–2). In 1.0 M NaOH containing 2.0 M glycerol, the photoanode delivers a photocurrent density of 8.87 mA cm–2 at 1.23 V versus the reversible hydrogen electrode, above the practical benchmark of 8.1 mA cm–2. Ge incorporation also enables selective oxidation of glycerol to tartronic acid, a value-added product of glycerol oxidation. Electrochemical analyses and density functional theory calculations suggest that Ge and Ti co-doping improves charge utilisation, while Ge additionally promotes the tartronic acid-forming pathway.
title_zh: 用于在 8.87 mA cm–2 下甘油辅助制氢的氧化铁光电阳极
abstract_zh: 氧化铁（α-Fe2O3）因其丰富、合适的带隙和在水中的稳定性而成为光电化学水分解中一种有吸引力的光阳极，但其实际应用仍然受到电荷传输差和水氧化缓慢的限制。在这里，我们表明，可以使用 Ge 和 Ti 共掺杂 Fe2O3 光阳极来解决这些限制，该光阳极将甘油氧化与模拟单太阳光照（100 mW cm-2）下的阴极析氢耦合起来。在含有 2.0 M 甘油的 1.0 M NaOH 中，与可逆氢电极相比，光阳极在 1.23 V 电压下的光电流密度为 8.87 mA cm-2，高于 8.1 mA cm-2 的实际基准。 Ge的掺入还使得甘油能够选择性氧化为丙三醇酸，丙三醇氧化的增值产物。电化学分析和密度泛函理论计算表明，Ge 和 Ti 共掺杂提高了电荷利用率，同时 Ge 还促进了丙醇二酸形成途径。

title: Lying mirror using structured surfaces
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: We introduce an all-optical system, termed the “lying mirror”, to hide input information by transforming it into misleading, ordinary-looking patterns that effectively camouflage the underlying image data and deceive the observers. This misleading transformation is achieved through passive light-matter interactions of the incident light with an optimized structured diffractive surface, enabling the optical concealment of any form of secret input data without any digital computing. These lying mirror designs were shown to camouflage different types of input image data, exhibiting robustness against a range of adversarial manipulations, including random image noise as well as unknown, random rotations, shifts, and scaling of the object features. The feasibility of the lying mirror concept was also validated experimentally using a structured micro-mirror array along with multi-wavelength illumination at 480, 550 and 600 nm" role="presentation">nm{nm}, covering the blue, green and red image channels. Furthermore, we created a broadband lying mirror that operates across a continuous spectral range, enhancing its adaptability under diverse illumination conditions. This framework showcases the power of structured diffractive surfaces for visual information processing and might find various applications in defense, security and entertainment.
title_zh: 使用结构化表面的卧镜
abstract_zh: 我们引入了一种全光学系统，称为“说谎镜”，通过将输入信息转换为误导性的、看似普通的图案来隐藏输入信息，从而有效地伪装底层图像数据并欺骗观察者。这种误导性的转换是通过入射光与优化的结构化衍射表面的被动光-物质相互作用来实现的，从而无需任何数字计算即可光学隐藏任何形式的秘密输入数据。这些卧镜设计被证明可以伪装不同类型的输入图像数据，表现出针对一系列对抗性操作的鲁棒性，包括随机图像噪声以及对象特征的未知、随机旋转、移位和缩放。还使用结构化微镜阵列和 480、550 和 600 nm 的多波长照明（覆盖蓝色、绿色和红色图像通道）对卧镜概念的可行性进行了实验验证。此外，我们创建了一种在连续光谱范围内工作的宽带卧镜，增强了其在不同照明条件下的适应性。该框架展示了结构化衍射表面在视觉信息处理中的强大功能，并可能在国防、安全和军事领域找到各种应用。娱乐。

title: Heat stress promotes pre-tRNA capping to modulate cap-dependent translation in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Methylguanosine capping, a post-transcriptional modification of the 5′ terminus of RNA polymerase II transcripts, influences RNA function, stability, and protein synthesis. Previously, we identified the cap modification in specific transfer RNA (tRNA) precursors (pre-tRNAs) transcribed by RNA polymerase III in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, and demonstrated that pre-tRNA capping prevents 5′ exonucleolytic degradation of pre-tRNAs. Herein, we comprehensively mapped pre-tRNA capping and found that nearly all pre-tRNAs undergo cap modification. This analysis enabled precise determination of transcription start sites for all tRNA genes, and the capping efficiency was strongly influenced by the base-pairing probability between 5′ leaders and 3′ trailers of pre-tRNAs. Furthermore, pre-tRNA capping was significantly upregulated under heat stress, resulting in capped pre-tRNA-derived fragments. Capped pre-tRNAs modulated cap-dependent translation by sequestering eukaryotic initiation factor 4E (eIF4E). Overall, these findings suggest that pre-tRNA capping contributes to the regulation of cap-dependent translation under heat stress conditions in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
title_zh: 热应激促进前 tRNA 加帽以调节酿酒酵母中帽依赖性翻译
abstract_zh: 甲基鸟苷加帽是 RNA 聚合酶 II 转录物 5' 末端的转录后修饰，影响 RNA 功能、稳定性和蛋白质合成。此前，我们鉴定了酿酒酵母中 RNA 聚合酶 III 转录的特定转移 RNA (tRNA) 前体 (pre-tRNA) 中的帽子修饰，并证明 pre-tRNA 加帽可防止前 tRNA 的 5' 核酸外切降解。在此，我们全面绘制了 tRNA 前体加帽图谱，发现几乎所有 tRNA 前体都经历了帽修饰。该分析能够精确确定所有 tRNA 基因的转录起始位点，并且加帽效率受到前 tRNA 的 5' 前导序列和 3' 尾序列之间的碱基配对概率的强烈影响。此外，前 tRNA 加帽在热应激下显着上调，产生加帽的前 tRNA 衍生片段。加帽前 tRNA 通过隔离真核起始因子 4E (eIF4E) 来调节帽依赖性翻译。总体而言，这些研究结果表明，前 tRNA 加帽有助于在酿酒酵母热应激条件下调节帽子依赖性翻译。

title: Long-term deployment of marine current turbines: a review of biofouling effects on performance degradation, mitigation strategies and techno-economic impacts
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Marine current turbines (MCTs) are a promising technology for predictable renewable energy generation, but their long-term performance is significantly affected by the harsh marine environment. Among the various degradation mechanisms, biofouling is one of the most critical, as it increases surface roughness, modifies hydrodynamic loads, reduces energy conversion efficiency, and raises operation and maintenance costs. This review critically examines the effects of biofouling on MCT performance by integrating hydrodynamic, biological, operational, and techno-economic perspectives. Existing experimental, numerical, and field studies indicate that moderate biofouling typically reduces the power coefficient by 10–20%, while severe natural colonisation may lead to power losses exceeding 40%, with the magnitude of degradation depending on fouling morphology, turbine configuration, installation conditions, and operating strategy. The effectiveness and limitations of current mitigation approaches, including antifouling and foul-release coatings, adaptive tip-speed-ratio control, cleaning schedules, and component-specific maintenance strategies, are systematically discussed. A key contribution of this review is the identification of the gap between site-specific biofouling observations, predictive growth modelling, and turbine performance assessment. To address this limitation, an integrated framework is proposed that combines local biofouling monitoring, hydrodynamic modelling, and techno-economic indicators to support lifecycle performance assessment. The analysis highlights that biofouling should be considered not only as a surface degradation phenomenon but also as a key lifecycle driver influencing turbine design, maintenance planning, annual energy production, and the economic viability of tidal energy systems.

title: Agrivoltaics could increase global land use efficiency compared to bioenergy
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Climate change mitigation scenarios often include a substantial bioenergy component, raising concerns about the land use impacts of large-scale energy crop production. However, agrivoltaic systems have the potential to generate electricity with a higher land use efficiency than bioenergy by integrating photovoltaic panels into agricultural land. Here, we model the global land system to explore the land use impacts of energy crops, agrivoltaics, and photovoltaics under a 1.5 °C climate change mitigation scenario. Bioenergy demand in the bioenergy scenario increases almost six-fold from 2020 to 2060. Replacing all bioenergy with agrivoltaics requires 30 times less land, leading to 106 Mha more natural land cover, 52 Mt. less nitrogen fertiliser applied, and 305 km 3 less irrigation water withdrawn per year by 2060. Similar but smaller reductions in land use are achieved with standard photovoltaic systems. Our findings suggest that future net cropland expansion can be avoided by prioritising agrivoltaic and photovoltaic systems over bioenergy. Policies that incentivise the adoption of agrivoltaics could increase global land use efficiency, reducing the trade-offs between energy supply, food production, and nature protection.

title: The Plasmodium heme detoxification protein functions in mitochondrial protein synthesis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Malaria blood-stage parasites digest ~80% of host cell hemoglobin within a degradative vacuole, releasing heme that is detoxified by sequestration into hemozoin crystals. Although essential for survival and a validated drug target, the mechanisms of heme biomineralization remain unclear. Here, we study the parasite’s Heme Detoxification Protein (HDP), previously proposed to mediate hemozoin formation, using genetic, microscopic, bioenergetic, and proteomic approaches. Endogenous tagging reveals that HDP localizes to the mitochondrion, not the digestive vacuole. HDP inactivation has no effect on heme biomineralization, but causes mitochondrial depolarization, proguanil hypersensitivity, and developmental arrest, which is rescued by bypassing respiratory-chain-dependent pyrimidine biosynthesis. HDP knockout abolishes mitochondrial electron flow due to loss of complexes III and IV, consistent with impaired mitochondrial protein synthesis. Integration of structural modelling with quantitative proteomics places HDP within the mitoribosomal large subunit. Here, we show that HDP is essential for mitochondrial function and does not contribute to hemozoin formation.
title_zh: 疟原虫血红素解毒蛋白在线粒体蛋白质合成中发挥作用
abstract_zh: 疟疾血液阶段寄生虫在降解液泡内消化约 80% 的宿主细胞血红蛋白，释放血红素，通过隔离成疟原虫色素晶体来解毒。尽管血红素生物矿化对于生存和有效的药物靶点至关重要，但其机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们研究了寄生虫的血红素解毒蛋白（HDP），之前提出使用遗传、显微镜、生物能和蛋白质组学方法介导疟原虫色素的形成。内源标记显示 HDP 定位于线粒体，而不是消化液泡。 HDP 失活对血红素生物矿化没有影响，但会导致线粒体去极化、氯胍过敏和发育停滞，这是通过绕过呼吸链依赖性嘧啶生物合成来挽救的。 HDP 敲除由于复合物 III 和 IV 的损失而消除了线粒体电子流，这与线粒体蛋白质合成受损一致。结构建模与定量蛋白质组学的整合将 HDP 置于线粒体大亚基内。在这里，我们证明 HDP 对于线粒体功能至关重要，并且不会促进疟原虫色素的形成。

title: CAFs shape the immunosuppressive microenvironment of pancreatic cancer through the Lin28b-STING Axis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cancer-associated fibroblasts comprise diverse functionally distinct cellular subsets, with certain subpopulations exerting pivotal influence in shaping the pancreatic cancer immune microenvironment. Here we show that Lin28b+ cancer-associated fibroblasts contribute to establishing an immunologically cold tumor microenvironment in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Mechanistically, Lin28b directly binds to STING mRNA and promotes its degradation, thereby suppressing STING expression and downstream type I interferon signaling. Loss of Lin28b in cancer-associated fibroblasts activates the cGAS-STING-interferon signaling cascade, enhancing dendritic cell antigen presentation and CD8+ T cell cytotoxic function. Importantly, genetic inhibition of Lin28b in cancer-associated fibroblasts enhances sensitivity to anti-PD-L1 immune checkpoint blockade therapy. These findings reveal that targeting the Lin28b-STING axis represents a promising therapeutic strategy for overcoming the intrinsic resistance of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma to immunotherapy.

title: Biosynthetic mechanism and ecological function of chirality in Solanum steroidal alkaloids
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Chirality fundamentally influences the bioactivity and ecological roles of plant natural products. Steroidal glycoalkaloids (SGAs) in tomato and wild relatives exhibit this stereochemical variation. Forward genetics identifies C26 hydroxylase GAME8 as the key enzyme controlling SGA chirality. Cultivated tomato harbors two identical GAME8 copies yielding S-configured intermediates, whereas Solanum pennellii homologs GAME8a and GAME8b dominantly produce R- and S-configured products, respectively. Site-saturation mutagenesis and molecular docking reveal four residues sufficient to switch this chirality. Bioassays demonstrate that R-type SGAs, predominant in wild tomato, offer superior defense against the specialist pest Phthorimaea absoluta, although chirality does not affect resistance to the generalist Spodoptera litura. Collectively, these results elucidate the biosynthetic mechanism and ecological significance of SGA chirality, establishing a basis for tailoring phytochemical stereochemistry to enhance crop protection.
title_zh: 茄甾生物碱手性生物合成机制及生态功能
abstract_zh: 手性从根本上影响植物天然产物的生物活性和生态作用。番茄和野生近缘种中的甾体配糖生物碱 (SGA) 表现出这种立体化学变异。正向遗传学将 C26 羟化酶 GAME8 确定为控制 SGA 手性的关键酶。栽培番茄含有两个相同的 GAME8 拷贝，产生 S-构型中间体，而茄属同源物 GAME8a 和 GAME8b 分别主要产生 R- 和 S-构型产物。位点饱和诱变和分子对接揭示了四个足以改变这种手性的残基。生物测定表明，R 型 SGA（主要存在于野生番茄中）对专科害虫赤霉病具有卓越的防御能力，尽管手性并不影响对斜纹夜蛾的抵抗力。总的来说，这些结果阐明了 SGA 手性的生物合成机制和生态意义，为定制植物化学立体化学以增强作物保护奠定了基础。

title: Asymmetric fluorinated sulfonamide electrolyte solvent for high-voltage and wide-temperature Li-metal batteries
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Stable cycling of Ni-rich positive electrodes under high voltages (≥ 4.6 V) is critically challenging due to severe interfacial parasitic reactions and structural degradation, especially under all-climate conditions (i.e., ≤ −20 °C and ≥ 55 °C). Herein, we rationally design and synthesize an asymmetric fluorinated sulfonamide solvent, N-ethyl-N-methyltrifluoromethane-sulfonamide, where the fluorination of sulfone backbone greatly promotes the oxidation stability, while the introduction of asymmetric amine group bestows the solvent with an low freezing point (below −150 °C). This obtained solvent, with 1 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, delivers high oxidation stability (above 5.0 V) and good Li reversibility (up to 99.8% in Li | |Cu cells). Coupled with its ability to form highly robust LiF-rich solid-electrolyte/cathode-electrolyte interphases, this single-salt single-solvent electrolyte enables stable cycling of Li | |Ni0.8Co0.1Mn0.1 cells under an high voltage of 4.8 V across an wide temperature of −60 to 100 °C. Remarkably, a prototype 5 Ah-level Li | | Ni0.8Co0.1Mn0.1 pouch cell at an cut-off voltage of 4.7 V and 0.1 C demonstrates a high specific energy (based on the mass of all components) of 514 Wh kg−1 over 20 cycles.

title: Tuning electron back-donation to switch reaction pathway in CO2 hydrogenation
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: CO2 hydrogenation over earth-abundant Ni catalysts is attractive for CO-based fuel synthesis, but Ni intrinsically favors methanation. Here we show that ordered Ni3Sn2 intermetallics tune Ni–CO electron back-donation and switch CO2 hydrogenation from CH4 formation to the reverse water–gas shift reaction. Atomic-resolution microscopy and X-ray absorption spectroscopy reveal disruption of extended Ni–Ni ensembles by Sn, while spectroscopy and theoretical calculations show that Ni–Sn d-p hybridization downshifts the Ni 3d band and weakens Ni→CO 2π* back-donation. The Ni3Sn2 catalyst achieves CO2 conversion approaching thermodynamic equilibrium with nearly 100% CO selectivity and remains stable for 300 h. In situ infrared spectroscopy, steady-state isotopic transient kinetic analysis and theoretical calculations indicate that H-assisted CO2 activation, spectator-like formate species and facile CO desorption underpin the CO-selective pathway. Similar behavior over Ni–Ga and Ni–In catalysts suggests a general back-donation strategy for redirecting Ni-based CO2 hydrogenation.
title_zh: 调整电子反馈以切换 CO2 加氢反应途径
abstract_zh: 在地球上储量丰富的镍催化剂上进行二氧化碳加氢对于基于二氧化碳的燃料合成很有吸引力，但镍本质上有利于甲烷化。在这里，我们展示了有序 Ni3Sn2 金属间化合物调节 Ni-CO 电子回馈并将 CO2 加氢从 CH4 形成转变为反向水煤气变换反应。原子分辨率显微镜和X射线吸收光谱揭示了Sn对延伸的Ni-Ni系综的破坏，而光谱和理论计算表明Ni-Sn d-p杂化使Ni 3d带下移并削弱了Ni→CO 2π*回馈。 Ni3Sn2催化剂实现CO2转化接近热力学平衡，CO选择性接近100%，并保持稳定300小时。原位红外光谱、稳态同位素瞬态动力学分析和理论计算表明，H 辅助的 CO2 活化、类似观察者的甲酸盐物种和容易的 CO 解吸支撑了 CO 选择性途径。 Ni-Ga 和 Ni-In 催化剂的类似行为表明了一种用于重定向 Ni 基 CO2 加氢的通用回馈策略。

title: Trap-induced white circularly polarized persistent luminescence from a host-guest molecular system
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Circularly polarized luminescence (CPL), which encodes non-replicable optical information in the characteristics of chirality, wavelength, and time, holds significant promise for advanced information technologies. However, effective strategies for systematically regulating multiple optical properties remain elusive. Herein, we report a general approach that imparts hour-level dual-band persistent luminescence to CPL materials through the introduction of trap states into an organic host-guest molecular system. The electrons released from traps repopulate both the singlet and triplet states of the chiral guest molecules, producing dual-band white circularly polarized persistent luminescence for 4 h at room temperature. Systematic characterization reveals that two different chiral configurations leave the trap depth basically unaltered, while conferring pronounced CPL activity on these composites with a maximum luminescence dissymmetry factor glum of 1.6 × 10−3/−2.3 × 10−3. Leveraging these characteristics, we present a proof-of-concept demonstration of warm-white circularly polarized persistent luminescence materials for Morse-code encryption and multimodal information storage.
title_zh: 来自主客体分子系统的陷阱诱导的白色圆偏振持续发光
abstract_zh: 圆偏振发光（CPL）以手性、波长和时间特征对不可复制的光学信息进行编码，为先进信息技术带来了巨大的希望。然而，系统调节多种光学特性的有效策略仍然难以捉摸。在此，我们报告了一种通过将陷阱态引入有机主客体分子系统而赋予 CPL 材料小时级双波段持久发光的通用方法。从陷阱释放的电子重新填充手性客体分子的单重态和三重态，在室温下产生双波段白色圆偏振持久发光4小时。系统表征表明，两种不同的手性构型使陷阱深度基本不变，同时赋予这些复合材料显着的 CPL 活性，最大发光不对称因子 glum 为 1.6 × 10−3/−2.3 × 10−3。利用这些特性，我们提出了用于莫尔斯电码加密和多模式信息存储的暖白圆偏振持久发光材料的概念验证演示。

title: Bubble-triggered built-in liquid metal-based galvanic cell for gas pipeline microleak detection
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Due to the significant economic losses and safety issues caused by gas pipeline leaks, timely detection of minor leaks in pipelines is crucial important. Herein, we present an intelligent liquid metal bubble generator (LMBG) chamber capable of converting mechanical leakage signals into real-time electrical feedback through the electrochemical conversion mechanism at the liquid metal interface. The proposed system exploits the intrinsic electric potential difference of a liquid metal (LM) and its oxide. The rupture of LM bubbles at leakage site activates a built-in galvanic cell between the metallic core and the oxide shell, achieving direct mechanoelectrical energy conversion. Notably, the system demonstrates sensitivity with linear voltage-volume (173.46 V·cm−3) and frequency-flow velocity (0.25 Hz·cm−1·s) correlations, as well as rapid response characteristics (0.33 s latency). Notably, the exceptional detection resolution for micro-leakages as small as 1.0×10−3 cm3. This achievement in active sensing technology establishes a route for intelligent infrastructure monitoring, particularly providing a possible way for the critical need of leakage detection for gas pipelines.
title_zh: 用于气体管道微泄漏检测的气泡触发内置液态金属原电池
abstract_zh: 由于燃气管道泄漏造成重大经济损失和安全问题，及时发现管道轻微泄漏至关重要。在此，我们提出了一种智能液态金属气泡发生器（LMBG）室，能够通过液态金属界面的电化学转换机制将机械泄漏信号转换为实时电反馈。所提出的系统利用了液态金属（LM）及其氧化物的固有电势差。 LM气泡在泄漏处破裂，激活金属核和氧化物壳之间的内置原电池，实现直接的机电能量转换。值得注意的是，该系统表现出线性电压-体积（173.46 V·cm−3）和频率-流速（0.25 Hz·cm−1·s）相关性的灵敏度，以及快速响应特性（0.33 s延迟）。值得注意的是，对于小至 1.0×10−3 cm3 的微泄漏具有卓越的检测分辨率。主动传感技术的这一成就为智能基础设施监测开辟了一条途径，特别是为天然气管道泄漏检测的关键需求提供了可能的方法。

title: All-optical Mie void sensor for complex nanoplastic mixtures
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The fragmentation and direct release of plastic debris have emerged as a pressing ecological concern. Once dispersed, these particles infiltrate food webs, accumulate within organisms, and bind toxic co-contaminants, posing long-term risks to ecosystems and human health. Despite growing awareness, the characterization of nanoplastics remains highly challenging. Moreover, obtaining additional information, such as particle shape or material composition, further exacerbates these detection hurdles. Here, we introduce a photonic sensing platform based on nanoscale voids that enables the simultaneous material- and morphology-sensitive detection of particles below 500 nm. Void arrays embedded in a high-refractive-index material act in parallel as both sorting elements and color reporters. Spherical and elongated particles are selectively trapped in circular and elliptical voids, while different polymer types are distinguished simultaneously. This approach offers a scalable route toward optical identification of nanoplastics in environmental settings. Its compatibility with high-throughput analysis positions it as a promising tool for real-time studies.
title_zh: 用于复杂纳米塑料混合物的全光学米氏空隙传感器
abstract_zh: 塑料碎片的破碎和直接释放已成为紧迫的生态问题。一旦分散，这些颗粒就会渗入食物网，在生物体内积聚，并与有毒的共污染物结合，对生态系统和人类健康构成长期风险。尽管人们的认识不断增强，但纳米塑料的表征仍然极具挑战性。此外，获得额外的信息，例如颗粒形状或材料成分，进一步加剧了这些检测障碍。在这里，我们介绍了一种基于纳米级空隙的光子传感平台，可以同时对 500 nm 以下的颗粒进行材料和形态敏感的检测。嵌入高折射率材料中的空隙阵列同时充当排序元件和颜色报告器。球形和细长颗粒被选择性地捕获在圆形和椭圆形空隙中，同时区分不同的聚合物类型。这种方法为环境环境中纳米塑料的光学识别提供了一条可扩展的途径。它与高通量分析的兼容性使其成为实时研究的有前途的工具。

title: Selective and autonomous generation of singlet oxygen for synergistic heavy metal-organic removal without energy input
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: A fundamental challenge across environmental catalysis is the reliance on external energy or chemical inputs to drive detoxification reactions. Here, we transcend this limitation with a pollutant-driven framework, demonstrated by a variable-valent molybdenum oxide (MoOx). A vacancy-anchored dual-site polarization mechanism enables the selective conversion of adsorbed oxygen into singlet oxygen (1O2), bypassing radical intermediates, driven by the synergistic interaction between low-valent Mo and high-valent metal ions. This process achieves simultaneous heavy-metal reduction and organic degradation without the addition of molecular oxygen (O2) gas, external energy (e.g., light, electricity, or heat), or chemical oxidants (e.g., persulfate or peroxide). The MoOx material maintains robust performance in complex water and retains over 99% removal efficiency after closed-loop regeneration. This work establishes a general design principle for energy-autonomous catalysis, bridging environmental remediation with sustainable chemistry and suggesting a potential pathway for self-sustaining processes in wastewater and beyond.
title_zh: 选择性自主生成单线态氧，无需能量输入即可协同去除重金属有机物
abstract_zh: 环境催化的一个基本挑战是依赖外部能量或化学输入来驱动解毒反应。在这里，我们通过污染物驱动的框架超越了这一限制，并通过可变价氧化钼（MoOx）进行了证明。在低价Mo和高价金属离子之间的协同相互作用的驱动下，空位锚定的双位点极化机制能够绕过自由基中间体，选择性地将吸附的氧转化为单线态氧（1O2）。该过程无需添加分子氧 (O2) 气体、外部能量（例如光、电或热）或化学氧化剂（例如过硫酸盐或过氧化物）即可同时实现重金属还原和有机降解。 MoOx 材料在复杂水中保持稳健的性能，并在闭环再生后保留超过 99% 的去除效率。这项工作建立了能量自主催化的一般设计原则，将环境修复与可持续化学联系起来，并为废水及其他领域的自我维持过程提出了潜在途径。

title: Low curvature combined with high amorphization improves SERS sensitivity of semiconducting Rh–Se mesoporous nanospheres toward non-adsorbing resistant pollutants
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Amorphous metal–selenium (M–Se) alloys hold promise for applications such as catalysis, electronics, and surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS) sensing due to their surface reactivity, isotropic properties, and tunable bandgap. However, controlling the synthesis of nanostructured noble-metal-based M–Se materials is difficult, as the strong metallic bonding and low chemical reactivity of noble metals hinder homogeneous selenization. Here we show a one-step micellar self-assembly reduction method to produce amorphous semiconducting Rh–Se mesoporous nanospheres (a-Rh–Se MNs). We systematically investigate how composition, surface curvature, and crystallinity affect SERS performance. a-Rh–Se MNs with low curvature and high amorphization achieve enhanced sensitivity toward typically non-adsorbing, low-polarizability analytes, including hexachlorobenzene, anthracene, and polytetrafluoroethylene microplastics (even in wastewater). Combined experimental and theoretical analyses reveal that co-modulating curvature and amorphization tunes key electronic descriptors (e.g., d-band center and work function), thereby promoting resonant charge transfer. This finding overturns the conventional paradigm that prioritizes high-surface-area substrates. Our work establishes mesostructured a-Rh–Se for SERS applications and provides insights into M–Se surface chemistry for designing advanced SERS materials.
title_zh: 低曲率与高非晶化相结合提高了半导体 Rh-Se 介孔纳米球对非吸附性污染物的 SERS 敏感性
abstract_zh: 非晶金属硒 (M-Se) 合金由于其表面反应性、各向同性特性和可调谐带隙，在催化、电子学和表面增强拉曼光谱 (SERS) 传感等应用中具有广阔的前景。然而，控制纳米结构贵金属基M-Se材料的合成很困难，因为贵金属的强金属键合和低化学反应性阻碍了均相硒化。在这里，我们展示了一种一步胶束自组装还原方法来生产非晶半导体 Rh-Se 介孔纳米球（a-Rh-Se MN）。我们系统地研究成分、表面曲率和结晶度如何影响 SERS 性能。具有低曲率和高非晶化度的 a-Rh-Se MN 可提高对典型非吸附性、低极化性分析物的灵敏度，包括六氯苯、蒽和聚四氟乙烯微塑料（甚至在废水中）。实验和理论分析相结合表明，共调制曲率和非晶化可调节关键电子描述符（例如 d 带中心和功函数），从而促进共振电荷转移。这一发现颠覆了优先考虑高表面积基材的传统范例。我们的工作为 SERS 应用建立了介观结构的 a-Rh-Se，并为设计先进的 SERS 材料提供了对 M-Se 表面化学的见解。

title: Molecular-level insight into water adsorption and projected atmospheric water harvesting performance in a hydrolytically stable MOF
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Sorption-based atmospheric water harvesting (AWH) promises a solution to the global challenge of water scarcity and, despite the increasing number of promising AWH materials, there remains a need for insight into pore-filling mechanisms and the hydrolytic stability of such desiccants. Here, we report two bnn-topology rod building block (RBB) MOFs, M2F2(tzba)(bpy)2, tzba = 4-(1H-tetrazol-5-yl)benzoate, M = Co or Ni. The MOFs, bnn-1-Co and previously reported bnn-1-Ni, respectively, are built from an RBB comprising three bridging moieties, fluoride, carboxylate and tetrazolate. bnn-1-Ni exhibits promising material-level AWH performance and hydrolytic stability driven by a low uptake threshold ( 100 cycles) and projected gravimetric water productivity of 0.3044 wt% min−1 (4.38 kg−1 kg−1 d−1) under simulated temperature swing conditions. Loading of water molecules, visualised at the molecular level through single-crystal X-ray diffraction (SCXRD) and density functional theory (DFT) calculations, revealed a binding site with multiple hydrogen bonds for the first water molecule (adsorption energy −75 kJ mol−1) that anchors formation of water layers (average adsorption energy −59 kJ mol−1). bnn-1-Co is less hydrolytically stable, which we attribute to stronger Ni-N/O/F coordination bonds than their Co-N/O/F counterparts.
title_zh: 水解稳定 MOF 中水吸附和预计大气水收集性能的分子水平洞察
abstract_zh: 基于吸附的大气水收集（AWH）有望解决全球水资源短缺的挑战，尽管有前景的 AWH 材料数量不断增加，但仍然需要深入了解此类干燥剂的孔隙填充机制和水解稳定性。在这里，我们报告了两种 bnn 拓扑棒结构单元 (RBB) MOF，M2F2(tzba)(bpy)2，tzba = 4-(1H-四唑-5-基)苯甲酸酯，M = Co 或 Ni。 MOF、bnn-1-Co 和先前报道的 bnn-1-Ni 分别由包含三个桥连部分（氟化物、羧酸盐和四唑盐）的 RBB 构建。 bnn-1-Ni 在低吸收阈值（100 个循环）的驱动下表现出有前景的材料级 AWH 性能和水解稳定性，并且在模拟温度波动条件下预计重力水生产率为 0.3044 wt% min−1 (4.38 kg−1 kg−1 d−1)。通过单晶 X 射线衍射 (SCXRD) 和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算在分子水平上可视化水分子的负载，揭示了第一个水分子（吸附能 -75 kJ mol−1）具有多个氢键的结合位点，该结合位点锚定了水层的形成（平均吸附能 -59 kJ mol−1）。 bnn-1-Co 的水解稳定性较差，我们将此归因于 Ni-N/O/F 配位键比 Co-N/O/F 对应物更强。

title: Melt burst events in a dominantly amagmatic lithosphere at Gakkel Ridge in the Arctic Ocean
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Alternation of magmatic and amagmatic seafloor along the slow and ultraslow spreading ridges is common. Yet, temporal variation is obscured by sediments blanketing oceanic basement away from spreading centers. Here we analyze aeromagnetic data covering zero age to ~35 Ma oceanic crust at the ultraslow-spreading Gakkel Ridge to characterize magmatic and amagmatic lithospheric domains and their links to melt supply. Amagmatic seafloor unexpectedly dominates ~68% of the Eurasian Basin, while only 32% of magmatic seafloor over the last 35 Ma. The melt supply exhibits cycles initiating over a short episode of robust magmatism followed by a longer intermediate magmatism, then starved magmatism. These observations suggest that strong lithosphere presumably characterizing this ultraslow spreading ridge may prevent a continuous melt supply, instead favoring episodic melt bursts. Our study indirectly constraints the extent and duration of melting events and lithospheric accretion through the Gakkel Ridge history, away from the present spreading axis.
title_zh: 北冰洋加克尔海脊主要非岩浆岩石圈的熔体爆发事件
abstract_zh: 沿着慢速和超慢速扩张脊的岩浆和非岩浆海底交替是常见的。然而，时间变化被覆盖远离扩散中心的海洋基底的沉积物所掩盖。在这里，我们分析了超慢速扩张的 Gakkel 海脊处涵盖零年龄至约 35 Ma 洋壳的航磁数据，以表征岩浆和非岩浆岩石圈域及其与熔体供应的联系。出人意料的是，欧亚盆地约 68% 的区域是非岩浆海底，而在过去 35 Ma 中，岩浆海底仅占 32%。熔体供应呈现出以下循环：先是短暂的强烈岩浆活动，然后是较长的中间岩浆活动，然后是贫乏的岩浆活动。这些观察结果表明，强大的岩石圈可能是这种超慢扩张脊的特征，可能会阻止连续的熔体供应，反而有利于间歇性的熔体爆发。我们的研究间接限制了加克尔海脊历史上远离当前扩张轴的融化事件和岩石圈增生的程度和持续时间。

title: Ultrafast electron acceleration by space chorus
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Chorus emissions, among the strongest electromagnetic waves occurring in nature, have been believed to cause intense electron acceleration which can significantly alter space weather and climate. However, direct measurement of electron acceleration by chorus has been highly challenging due to small spatiotemporal scales involved. Here we present ultrafast measurements of electron acceleration by space chorus, using high-cadence observations from NASA’s Magnetospheric Multiscale spacecraft. We find that the observed chorus is associated with locally-accelerated energetic electrons exhibiting butterfly pitch angle distribution, and the chorus waves were locally damping, resulting in energy gain of electrons mainly at direction perpendicular to ambient magnetic field by cyclotron resonance. We demonstrate that the chorus-driven electron acceleration was ultrafast, with a net acceleration ratio of approximately 300 eV/s, and reveal that the electron acceleration was established in association with nonlinear wave trapping, controlled by spatiotemporal inhomogeneity of wave frequency and magnetic field. These observations provide direct evidence for nonlinear, ultrafast electron acceleration by chorus, suggest that future space weather forecasting models should incorporate chorus-induced nonlinear effects, and offer important insights into understanding energetic radiations in geospace and beyond.
title_zh: 空间合唱的超快电子加速
abstract_zh: 合唱发射是自然界中最强的电磁波之一，被认为会引起强烈的电子加速，从而显着改变太空天气和气候。然而，由于涉及的时空尺度较小，通过合唱团直接测量电子加速度一直非常具有挑战性。在这里，我们利用美国宇航局磁层多尺度航天器的高节奏观测，展示了空间合唱团对电子加速度的超快测量。我们发现，观察到的合唱与呈现蝶形俯仰角分布的局部加速高能电子相关，并且合唱波局部阻尼，导致电子主要通过回旋共振在垂直于环境磁场的方向获得能量增益。我们证明了合唱驱动的电子加速是超快的，净加速比约为 300 eV/s，并揭示电子加速与非线性波捕获相关，受波频率和磁场的时空不均匀性控制。这些观测结果为合唱团产生的非线性、超快电子加速提供了直接证据，表明未来的空间天气预报模型应纳入合唱团引起的非线性效应，并为理解地球空间及其他区域的高能辐射提供重要见解。

title: Engineering N-site isomerism in donor-acceptor covalent organic frameworks for efficient Fenton-like water purification
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) have emerged as promising candidates for singlet oxygen (1O2) generation via peroxymonosulfate (PMS) activation, yet their structure-property-activity relationships remain poorly understood. Herein, three constitutionally isomeric donor-acceptor COFs (TF-22Bpy, TA-22Bpy and TA-33Bpy) were constructed via N-site isomeric engineering, which involved precisely modulation of the imine and pyridine nitrogen positions within the skeleton. This systematically structural engineering was undertaken to unravel the fundamental effects of regioisomerism on both the electronic structure and subsequent Fenton-like catalytic activity. Among the isomers, TA-33Bpy showed the best catalytic activity for PMS activation, exhibiting an observed rate constant (kobs) of 0.165 min−1. This value is substantially higher than those of TF-22Bpy (0.013 min−1) and TA-22Bpy (0.052 min−1) by factors of 12.7 and 3.2, respectively. Mechanistic investigations indicate that direct PMS-COF interaction induces charge polarization within the donor-acceptor framework, generating localized electron-deficient and electron-enriched domains that promote the coupled redox steps required for selective ¹O₂ generation. This work identifies PMS-triggered charge polarization as a key determinant of PMS activation and offers a design principle for high-performance COF catalysts for water purification.
title_zh: 设计供体-受体共价有机框架中的 N 位异构现象，以实现高效的类芬顿水净化
abstract_zh: 共价有机框架（COF）已成为通过过一硫酸盐（PMS）活化生成单线态氧（1O2）的有希望的候选者，但它们的结构-性质-活性关系仍然知之甚少。在此，通过N位异构工程构建了三种结构异构的供体-受体COF（TF-22Bpy、TA-22Bpy和TA-33Bpy），其中涉及精确调节骨架内的亚胺和吡啶氮位置。这种系统的结构工程旨在揭示区域异构现象对电子结构和随后的类芬顿催化活性的基本影响。在异构体中，TA-33Bpy 对 PMS 激活表现出最佳的催化活性，观察到的速率常数 (kobs) 为 0.165 min−1。该值比 TF-22Bpy (0.013 min−1) 和 TA-22Bpy (0.052 min−1) 分别高出 12.7 和 3.2 倍。机理研究表明，直接的 PMS-COF 相互作用会诱导供体-受体框架内的电荷极化，产生局部缺电子和富电子域，从而促进选择性生成 1O2 所需的耦合氧化还原步骤。这项工作将 PMS 触发的电荷极化确定为 PMS 激活的关键决定因素，并为用于水净化的高性能 COF 催化剂提供了设计原理。

title: Enabling molecular signaling with temperature and ionic-strength independence or programmable dependence
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The equilibrium constants of chemical reactions fundamentally depend on temperature, posing challenges for living systems. However, many conformer organisms do not maintain a stable internal temperature. This raises the question: can molecular signaling pathways inherently resist temperature susceptibility? Molecular commutation is a recently discovered, fundamentally distinct mechanism of biological information processing and storage within reversible association/dissociation reactions. Here, we show that molecular commutation enables complex signaling systems that are independent of temperature and ionic strength and, even more generally, programmably dependent on these parameters. Using examples of various DNA logic gates, receptor-activator networks, and systems with complex input–output relationships (e.g., computed as algebraic functions), we demonstrate computationally that introducing compensatory reactions in these networks can render their signaling independent of temperature and ionic strength. We experimentally validate such independence for a case of a YES-logic gate. Finally, we computationally demonstrate networks with outputs that follow predefined functional forms of temperature and ionic strength (e.g., sin(T), where T is temperature). The presented intrinsic capabilities of affinity-based networks provide a remarkable homeostasis and signaling control mechanism that may be used by biological systems of arbitrarily high complexity.
title_zh: 实现具有温度和离子强度独立性或可编程依赖性的分子信号传导
abstract_zh: 化学反应的平衡常数从根本上取决于温度，这给生命系统带来了挑战。然而，许多构象生物体不能维持稳定的内部温度。这就提出了一个问题：分子信号通路本质上可以抵抗温度敏感性吗？分子交换是最近发现的一种从根本上不同的生物信息处理和可逆缔合/解离反应存储机制。在这里，我们表明分子换向能够实现独立于温度和离子强度的复杂信号系统，更一般地说，可以可编程地依赖于这些参数。使用各种 DNA 逻辑门、受体激活剂网络和具有复杂输入输出关系的系统（例如，计算为代数函数）的例子，我们通过计算证明在这些网络中引入补偿反应可以使其信号独立于温度和离子强度。我们通过实验验证了“是”逻辑门的这种独立性。最后，我们通过计算证明网络的输出遵循温度和离子强度的预定义函数形式（例如，sin(T)，其中 T 是温度）。基于亲和力的网络所呈现的内在能力提供了显着的稳态和信号控制机制，可以被任意高复杂性的生物系统使用。

title: Non-canonical pore architecture underlies constitutive gating of human retinal TRPM1
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Transient receptor potential melastatin 1 (TRPM1), a Ca²⁺-permeable nonselective cation channel essential for retinal ON bipolar cell signaling and night vision, and implicated in congenital night blindness, has remained structurally and functionally poorly characterized. Here we report the cryo–electron microscopy structure of human TRPM1, revealing that although it assembles as a tetramer, it adopts an unexpected clockwise domain-swapped pore module with rotational geometry inverse to that observed in previously characterized 6-TM tetrameric channels. This inverted topology is accompanied by extensive remodeling of the S5–P–S6 module, dilation of the selectivity filter, expansion of the central cavity, and splaying of S6 to form a wide intracellular gate. Our single-channel recordings reveal constitutive activity consistent with the conductive state captured. Together, these findings uncover a 6-TM fold in the tetrameric channel and provide a framework for understanding TRPM1 gating, disease-associated dysfunction, and associated pharmacology.
title_zh: 非典型孔结构是人视网膜TRPM1本构门控的基础
abstract_zh: 瞬时受体电位 melastatin 1 (TRPM1) 是一种 Ca2+ 渗透性非选择性阳离子通道，对于视网膜 ON 双极细胞信号传导和夜视至关重要，并与先天性夜盲症有关，但其结构和功能仍不清楚。在这里，我们报告了人类 TRPM1 的冷冻电子显微镜结构，揭示了虽然它组装为四聚体，但它采用了意想不到的顺时针结构域交换孔模块，其旋转几何形状与之前表征的 6-TM 四聚体通道中观察到的相反。这种倒置的拓扑结构伴随着 S5-P-S6 模块的广泛重塑、选择性过滤器的扩张、中央腔的扩张以及 S6 的张开以形成宽的细胞内门。我们的单通道记录揭示了与捕获的导电状态一致的本构活动。总之，这些发现揭示了四聚体通道中的 6-TM 折叠，并为理解 TRPM1 门控、疾病相关功能障碍和相关药理学提供了框架。

title: Nuclear localization of the glutaminyl-tRNA synthetase QARS reveals its role in DNA damage response in ovarian cancer
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Uncovering novel mechanisms controlling DNA damage response (DDR) is essential to better understand the molecular features of high-grade serous ovarian cancers (HGSOC), which remain a clinical challenge. Here, we demonstrate that the glutaminyl-tRNA-synthetase QARS is a key player in DDR. We show that QARS is regulated at translational level by the MAPK pathway in HGSOC and controls homologous recombination (HR) through a translation-independent mechanism. Analyses combining RNA sequencing, immunohistochemistry, proteomic data and functional assays from HGSOC patient cohorts and relevant cellular models reveal that QARS promotes DNA repair via the HR pathway. Interestingly, we uncover that QARS is located in the nucleus and is enriched at chromatin upon DNA damage. Nuclear QARS controls HR by interacting with the nuclear autoantigen SP100, a major component of PML-nuclear bodies (PML-NB), that are regulatory hubs for DNA repair proteins. Our data highlight nuclear functions and mechanisms for QARS involving SP100, PML-NB and MRE11 that enhance HR in HGSOC.
title_zh: 谷氨酰胺酰-tRNA合成酶QARS的核定位揭示了其在卵巢癌DNA损伤反应中的作用
abstract_zh: 揭示控制 DNA 损伤反应 (DDR) 的新机制对于更好地了解高级别浆液性卵巢癌 (HGSOC) 的分子特征至关重要，这仍然是一个临床挑战。在这里，我们证明谷氨酰胺酰-tRNA-合成酶 QARS 是 DDR 中的关键角色。我们发现 QARS 在翻译水平上受到 HGSOC 中 MAPK 通路的调节，并通过翻译独立机制控制同源重组（HR）。结合来自 HGSOC 患者群体和相关细胞模型的 RNA 测序、免疫组织化学、蛋白质组数据和功能测定的分析表明，QARS 通过 HR 途径促进 DNA 修复。有趣的是，我们发现 QARS 位于细胞核中，并且在 DNA 损伤时在染色质处富集。核 QARS 通过与核自身抗原 SP100 相互作用来控制 HR，SP100 是 PML 核体 (PML-NB) 的主要组成部分，是 DNA 修复蛋白的调节中心。我们的数据强调了 QARS 的核功能和机制，涉及 SP100、PML-NB 和 MRE11，可增强 HGSOC 中的 HR。

title: Facile mechanical refinement of sulfide solid electrolytes for stable all-solid-state Li metal batteries
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: All-solid-state lithium metal batteries offer high energy density and enhanced safety, yet mechanical instability at both positive electrode/solid electrolyte and Li metal/solid electrolyte interfaces severely limits cycling stability and rate performance, particularly at a low stacking pressure. Here, we report a facile, industry-compatible strategy to refine polycrystalline Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 grains using Al4C3 abrasives. The resulting Al4C3-engineered Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 exhibits reduced average particle size and a narrowed size distribution. The refined electrolyte grains enable a high relative density in both anolytes and composite positive electrodes. Beyond particle refinement, Al4C3 in the anolyte stabilizes the Li/electrolyte interface through its high modulus, low electronic conductivity, and favorable interfacial mechanics, enabling a high critical current density/capacity of 3.2 mA cm‒2/3.2 mAh cm−2. Leveraging our designed electrolyte as both anolyte and catholyte, the all-solid-state lithium metal batteries demonstrate stable cycling performance under a low stack pressure of 4 MPa and a positive electrode loading of 1.4 mAh cm−2, sustaining over 1500 cycles at 1.4 mA cm‒2. This study provides a potentially simple and scalable approach to optimize solid electrolyte particles and interfacial mechanics.
title_zh: 硫化物固体电解质的简易机械精炼用于稳定的全固态锂金属电池
abstract_zh: 全固态锂金属电池具有高能量密度和增强的安全性，但正极/固体电解质和锂金属/固体电解质界面的机械不稳定性严重限制了循环稳定性和倍率性能，特别是在低堆叠压力下。在这里，我们报告了一种简单的、行业兼容的策略，使用 Al4C3 磨料精炼多晶 Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 晶粒。所得的 Al4C3 工程 Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 表现出降低的平均粒径和变窄的尺寸分布。精制的电解质颗粒使阳极电解液和复合正极具有较高的相对密度。除了颗粒细化之外，阳极电解液中的 Al4C3 通过其高模量、低电子电导率和有利的界面力学稳定了锂/电解质界面，从而实现了 3.2 mA cm−2/3.2 mAh cm−2 的高临界电流密度/容量。利用我们设计的电解质作为阳极电解液和阴极电解液，全固态锂金属电池在4 MPa的低堆压和1.4 mAh cm−2的正极负载下表现出稳定的循环性能，在1.4 mA cm−2下维持超过1500次循环。这项研究提供了一种潜在的简单且可扩展的方法来优化固体电解质颗粒和界面力学。

title: Design of a live-attenuated bacterial vaccine using effector network engineering
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Enteropathogenic Escherichia coli (EPEC) and Citrobacter rodentium (CR) are extracellular enteric attaching and effacing (A/E) pathogens of humans and mice, respectively. Their virulence relies on intimate bacterial attachment and a network of type III secretion system effectors. Here, through systematic reduction and redesign of the effector network in CR, we develop an attenuated strain, CRV (CR Vaccine), encoding a subset of ten effectors. CRV colonises C57BL/6 mice ~100-fold lower than wild type CR (CRWT) without causing overt pathogenesis. Moreover, C3H/HeN mice, which succumb to CRWT infection, survive CRV challenge. Vaccination with CRV confers protection against subsequent CRWT infection in both mouse strains. Serological analysis reveals a repertoire of dominant CR antigens, including the O-antigen, the virulence factors intimin, EspA and Tir and the outer membrane proteins Lpp, OmpA, MetQ and CARC (an AIDA-like autotransporter). We show that CRWT and CRV immunisation elicits comparable B cell and antibody responses, which is contingent on intimate bacterial attachment. A corresponding EPEC strain (E. coli Vaccine, ECV) effectively colonises epithelial cells in a gut-on-chip model. These findings establish effector network minimisation as a generalisable strategy for rational bacterial attenuation and live-attenuated vaccine design.
title_zh: 利用效应器网络工程设计减毒活细菌疫苗
abstract_zh: 肠致病性大肠杆菌 (EPEC) 和啮齿类柠檬酸杆菌 (CR) 分别是人类和小鼠的细胞外肠附着和消除 (A/E) 病原体。它们的毒力依赖于紧密的细菌附着和 III 型分泌系统效应器网络。在这里，通过系统地减少和重新设计 CR 中的效应器网络，我们开发了一种减毒株 CRV（CR 疫苗），编码十个效应器的子集。 CRV 在 C57BL/6 小鼠中的定植率比野生型 CR (CRWT) 低约 100 倍，但不会引起明显的发病机制。此外，死于 CRWT 感染的 C3H/HeN 小鼠能够在 CRV 攻击中存活下来。 CRV 疫苗接种可以为两种小鼠品系提供针对后续 CRWT 感染的保护。血清学分析揭示了一系列主要的 CR 抗原，包括 O 抗原、毒力因子 intimin、EspA 和 Tir 以及外膜蛋白 Lpp、OmpA、MetQ 和 CARC（一种 AIDA 样自转运蛋白）。我们发现 CRWT 和 CRV 免疫引起类似的 B 细胞和抗体反应，这取决于紧密的细菌附着。相应的 EPEC 菌株（大肠杆菌疫苗，ECV）可有效地在芯片肠道模型中定植上皮细胞。这些发现将效应网络最小化确立为合理细菌减毒和活减毒疫苗设计的通用策略。

title: Energy-sensing kinase OsSnRK1b and its regulator OsCTK1 promote chilling-induced stomatal closure and cold tolerance
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Low temperatures can present a major challenge to plant growth and development. Here we report that low energy response and stomatal closure are two important responses for plant cold tolerance. The rice SNF1-Related Kinase 1b (OsSnRK1b) has an evolutionarily conserved function in low energy response. Its protein abundance is positively regulated by a cold tolerance regulator Chilling Tolerance Kinase 1 (OsCTK1) through phosphorylation. Both OsCTK1 and OsSnRK1b promote chilling-induced stomatal closure and chilling tolerance, while overexpression of OsSnRK1b enhances stomatal closure and chilling tolerance in an OsCTK1-dependent manner. In addition, chilling induces low energy response which is largely dependent on OsSnRK1b. Both OsCTK1 and OsSnRK1b are required for the induction of stress response gene Abscisic Acid Insensitive 5 (OsABI5) and the inhibition of growth-associated processes under chilling. CTK1 homologs in Arabidopsis and maize also positively regulate cold tolerance and cold induced stomatal closure, indicating a conserved role of low energy response and stomatal aperture control in plant cold tolerance.
title_zh: 能量感应激酶 OsSnRK1b 及其调节因子 OsCTK1 促进寒冷诱导的气孔关闭和耐冷性
abstract_zh: 低温会给植物生长和发育带来重大挑战。在这里，我们报告低能量反应和气孔关闭是植物耐寒性的两个重要反应。水稻 SNF1 相关激酶 1b (OsSnRK1b) 在低能量响应中具有进化保守的功能。其蛋白质丰度由耐冷调节剂耐冷激酶 1 (OsCTK1) 通过磷酸化进行正向调节。 OsCTK1和OsSnRK1b都促进冷诱导的气孔关闭和冷耐受性，而OsSnRK1b的过表达以OsCTK1依赖性方式增强气孔关闭和冷耐受性。此外，冷却会引起低能量响应，这在很大程度上取决于 OsSnRK1b。 OsCTK1 和 OsSnRK1b 都是诱导应激反应基因脱落酸不敏感 5 (OsABI5) 和抑制低温下生长相关过程所必需的。拟南芥和玉米中的 CTK1 同源物也正向调节耐冷性和冷诱导的气孔关闭，表明低能量响应和气孔孔径控制在植物耐冷性中的保守作用。

title: A functional atlas of transposon-encoded products and their integration into host networks
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Transposable elements (TEs) are pervasive genomic components that propagate via self-encoded factors, yet the nature, regulation, and function of these factors remain largely unresolved. Here, we integrated extensive long- and short-read transcriptome data, regulatory network analyses, deep proteomics, and structural predictions to construct a comprehensive atlas of TE products in Arabidopsis. We show that TE expression is embedded within host regulatory circuits, with DNA methylation and transcription factors jointly shaping TE transcriptional activity. Proteomic analyses confirm the production of over a hundred of high-confidence TE-encoded proteins, and structure-guided analyses of the transcript-informed TE proteome predict previously uncharacterized structural folds, multimerization capacity, and host protein interaction potential. Structural alignments further uncover cryptic homologies between TE-encoded proteins and host factors, including cases of domestications and co-options. Together, our study reveals the functional integration of TEs into cellular pathways and underscores the role of TEs as active drivers of genome function and innovation.
title_zh: 转座子编码产品的功能图谱及其与宿主网络的集成
abstract_zh: 转座元件（TE）是普遍存在的基因组成分，通过自编码因子传播，但这些因子的性质、调控和功能在很大程度上仍未解决。在这里，我们整合了广泛的长读和短读转录组数据、调控网络分析、深层蛋白质组学和结构预测，构建了拟南芥中 TE 产品的综合图谱。我们发现 TE 表达嵌入宿主调节回路中，DNA 甲基化和转录因子共同塑造 TE 转录活性。蛋白质组学分析证实了一百多种高置信度 TE 编码蛋白质的产生，并且对转录本信息的 TE 蛋白质组进行结构引导分析，预测了以前未表征的结构折叠、多聚化能力和宿主蛋白质相互作用潜力。结构比对进一步揭示了 TE 编码的蛋白质和宿主因子之间的神秘同源性，包括驯化和共同选择的情况。总之，我们的研究揭示了 TE 在细胞通路中的功能整合，并强调了 TE 作为基因组功能和创新的积极驱动因素的作用。

title: Modulation of habenula axon terminals supports action-outcome associations in larval zebrafish
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Improving behavioral performance relies on the ability to associate decisions with their positive and negative outcomes. Although neurons that associate actions with their consequences have been identified across multiple brain regions, the circuit-level mechanisms underlying this integration remain poorly understood. Here, using an operant thermoregulatory assay in larval zebrafish, we show that the dorsal habenula-interpeduncular nucleus (dHb-IPN) pathway is necessary for associating actions with subsequent thermal reward. A population of intermediate IPN (iIPN) neurons encodes actions only when they lead to reward, suggesting a role in establishing action-outcome associations. This integration is temporally precise, requiring actions and their outcomes to occur within approximately one second in both the behavioral assay and iIPN responses. We then combine circuit mapping and axon imaging to show that actions and reward signals are conveyed by GABAergic prepontine and glutamatergic dHb neurons, respectively. Finally, the integration between action and reward signals relies on presynaptic GABAB receptor-mediated modulation of dHb axon terminals by prepontine neurons. These results link a crucial computation for adaptive behavior to a specific circuit mechanism.
title_zh: 缰核轴突末端的调节支持斑马鱼幼虫的行动结果关联
abstract_zh: 改善行为绩效依赖于将决策与其积极和消极结果联系起来的能力。尽管已经在多个大脑区域中识别出将行为与其后果相关联的神经元，但这种整合背后的电路级机制仍然知之甚少。在这里，通过对斑马鱼幼虫进行操作性温度调节测定，我们发现背侧缰核-脚间核（dHb-IPN）途径对于将行为与随后的热奖励相关联是必要的。一群中间 IPN (iIPN) 神经元仅在导致奖励时才对动作进行编码，这表明它们在建立动作与结果关联中发挥着作用。这种集成在时间上是精确的，要求行为测定和 iIPN 响应中的操作及其结果在大约一秒内发生。然后，我们结合电路映射和轴突成像来表明，动作和奖励信号分别由 GABA 能前桥和谷氨酸能 dHb 神经元传递。最后，动作和奖励信号之间的整合依赖于突触前 GABAB 受体介导的桥前​​神经元对 dHb 轴突末端的调节。这些结果将自适应行为的关键计算与特定的电路机制联系起来。

title: Glycosylation orchestrates megakaryocytic fate of hematopoietic stem cells via Wnt-MUC13 signaling
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) sustain blood production through tightly regulated fate decisions. Disruption of this control underlies disorders such as myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS), myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPN), and inherited thrombocytopenias. While transcriptional and epigenetic regulation of HSPCs is well established, the contribution of glycosylation has remained largely unexplored. Here, we identify the glycosyltransferase B4GALT1 as a central regulator of hematopoiesis that integrates extrinsic niche cues with intrinsic transcriptional programs. B4GALT1 shapes the bone marrow microenvironment by generating complex glycan niches that support HSPC function. However, its deficiency produces oncogenic glycan signatures, disrupts HSPC niche integrity, and induces aberrant expression of Mucin 13 (MUC13). These changes expand stem and progenitor pools, enforce megakaryocyte lineage bias, and activate the Wnt–MUC13/β-catenin signaling axis, a pathway tightly linked to proliferation and malignant transformation. Consequently, B4GALT1 loss uncouples proliferation from self-renewal, altering key regulators of stem cell quiescence, lineage balance, and marrow homeostasis. Our findings define a previously unrecognized glycan-dependent regulatory axis that directs HSPC fate through coordinated transcriptional reprogramming, signaling modulation, and niche remodeling. This work establishes aberrant glycosylation as a driver of hematopoietic dysfunction and highlights B4GALT1 as a potential therapeutic target in stem cell–driven blood disorders.
title_zh: 糖基化通过 Wnt-MUC13 信号传导协调造血干细胞的巨核细胞命运
abstract_zh: 造血干细胞和祖细胞 (HSPC) 通过严格调控的命运决定来维持血液生产。这种控制的破坏是骨髓增生异常综合征 (MDS)、骨髓增生性肿瘤 (MPN) 和遗传性血小板减少症等疾病的基础。虽然 HSPC 的转录和表观遗传调控已得到充分证实，但糖基化的贡献在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们将糖基转移酶 B4GALT1 确定为造血的中央调节因子，它将外在的生态位线索与内在的转录程序整合在一起。 B4GALT1 通过生成支持 HSPC 功能的复杂聚糖生态位来塑造骨髓微环境。然而，它的缺陷会产生致癌聚糖特征，破坏 HSPC 生态位完整性，并诱导粘蛋白 13 (MUC13) 的异常表达。这些变化扩大了干细胞和祖细胞池，强制巨核细胞谱系偏向，并激活 Wnt-MUC13/β-连环蛋白信号轴，这是一条与增殖和恶性转化密切相关的途径。因此，B4GALT1 的缺失使增殖与自我更新脱钩，改变干细胞静止、谱系平衡和骨髓稳态的关键调节因子。我们的研究结果定义了一个以前未被认识的聚糖依赖性调节轴，该轴通过协调转录重编程、信号调节和生态位重塑来指导 HSPC 的命运。这项工作将异常糖基化确定为造血功能障碍的驱动因素，并强调 B4GALT1 作为干细胞驱动的血液疾病的潜在治疗靶点。

title: Bulk delivery of a preassembled apical surface initiates epithelial lumen formation
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: During de novo lumenogenesis, epithelial cells establish luminal identity by directing apical cargo to an apical membrane initiation site (AMIS). Although this process has been widely studied, the mechanisms governing AMIS formation and its progression into a luminal precursor remain poorly understood. Here we combine quantitative light and electron microscopy with proximity proteomics to demonstrate that apical cargo is delivered to the AMIS in large apical precursor organelles, termed vacuolar apical compartments (VACs). VACs possess a microvilli-rich cortex and undergo exocytic fusion at the AMIS to generate a nascent lumen. Lumen initiation is tightly coordinated with the assembly and rearrangement of apical cell junctions and requires the Crumbs complex protein PatJ. Together, our results show that PatJ is a key structural determinant of the apical-lateral interface and indicate that VACs act as specialized transport organelles that deliver a preassembled apical surface to the AMIS, enabling rapid and efficient lumen initiation.
title_zh: 预组装顶端表面的大量输送启动上皮腔形成
abstract_zh: 在从头管腔生成过程中，上皮细胞通过将顶端货物引导至顶膜起始位点（AMIS）来建立管腔身份。尽管这一过程已被广泛研究，但控制 AMIS 形成及其进展为管腔前体的机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们将定量光学和电子显微镜与邻近蛋白质组学结合起来，证明顶端货物在大型顶端前体细胞器（称为液泡顶端室（VAC））中被传递到 AMIS。 VAC 具有富含微绒毛的皮质，并在 AMIS 处进行胞吐融合以产生新生管腔。管腔起始与顶端细胞连接的组装和重排紧密协调，并且需要 Crumbs 复合蛋白 PatJ。总之，我们的结果表明 PatJ 是顶端-外侧界面的关键结构决定因素，并表明 VAC 作为专门的运输细胞器，将预组装的顶端表面传递到 AMIS，从而实现快速有效的管腔启动。

title: DNTTIP2 coordinates RNA exosome activities to ensure fidelity of human ribosome assembly
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The RNA exosome-associated helicase Mtr4/MTR4 (yeast/human) is recruited by adaptor proteins bearing Arch-Interacting Motifs (AIMs) to selectively degrade RNA substrates. Although the exosome targets diverse RNAs, only a few adaptors have been identified. Here, we extend the inventory of human adaptors to include a pre-tRNA splicing-ligase complex component, a spliceosome-associated factor, and DNTTIP2, a constituent of the small ribosomal subunit (40S) precursor, the 90S pre-ribosome. Structure-guided studies reveal how the DNTTIP2AIM-docked processive exosome core and its associated distributive exonuclease EXOSC10, which contact distant sites on the 90S pre-ribosome, cooperate to degrade part of the 5′-external transcribed spacer (5’-ETS), a key RNA scaffold that coordinates early 40S assembly. By contrast, productive pre-ribosomal RNA trimming within the 90S pre-ribosome necessitates EXOSC10, which safeguards against uncontrolled processive degradation by the DNTTIP2AIM-docked exosome core. We propose that multivalent contacts provide a mechanistic framework by which the RNA exosome coordinates its distinct enzymatic activities, ensuring selective processing and surveillance during ribonucleoprotein particle maturation.
title_zh: DNTTIP2 协调 RNA 外泌体活性以确保人类核糖体组装的保真度
abstract_zh: RNA 外泌体相关解旋酶 Mtr4/MTR4（酵母/人）由带有 Arch 相互作用基序 (AIM) 的接头蛋白招募，选择性降解 RNA 底物。尽管外泌体靶向多种 RNA，但仅鉴定出少数接头。在这里，我们扩展了人类接头的库存，包括前 tRNA 剪接连接酶复合物成分、剪接体相关因子和 DNTTIP2，小核糖体亚基 (40S) 前体（90S 前核糖体）的组成部分。结构引导研究揭示了 DNTTIP2AIM 对接的持续性外泌体核心及其相关的分布式核酸外切酶 EXOSC10（接触 90S 前核糖体上的远处位点）如何合作降解部分 5'-外部转录间隔区 (5'-ETS)，这是协调早期 40S 组装的关键 RNA 支架。相比之下，90S 前核糖体内的高效前核糖体 RNA 修剪需要 EXOSC10，它可以防止 DNTTIP2AIM 对接的外泌体核心发生不受控制的持续降解。我们认为多价接触提供了一个机制框架，RNA 外泌体通过该框架协调其独特的酶活性，确保核糖核蛋白颗粒成熟过程中的选择性加工和监视。

title: Systematic profiling of growth interactions in human gut microbiome species
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Microbial interactions shape the composition and stability of the human gut microbiome. Yet, few studies have systematically investigated species-species growth interactions and the mechanisms behind these. Here we show that among 36 representative gut bacterial strains, when two species interact, the interactions are mostly inhibitory. To provide biological insight into specific interactions, we further investigate the basis of a positive interaction, showing that Clostridium perfringens promotes the growth of Mediterraneibacter gnavus through extracellular vesicles. Additionally, we identify Veillonella parvula as a species capable of modulating environmental pH, thereby enabling the growth of Parabacteroides merdae, a strain highly sensitive to acidic conditions. This pH-increasing effect is enhanced by guanine supplementation and persists in multi-species communities containing different pH-lowering strains from diverse bacterial phyla. Although V. parvula is commonly present in human gut microbiomes, it is generally found at low levels. Given the spatial organization of bacteria in the gut, the local pH modulation by V. parvula might support the growth of acid-sensitive strains. Overall, the comprehensive dataset and mechanistic insights presented here provide a starting point to predict microbiome composition by integrating growth interactions.
title_zh: 人类肠道微生物组生长相互作用的系统分析
abstract_zh: 微生物相互作用影响人类肠道微生物群的组成和稳定性。然而，很少有研究系统地研究物种与物种生长的相互作用及其背后的机制。在这里，我们发现，在 36 种代表性肠道细菌菌株中，当两个物种相互作用时，相互作用大多是抑制性的。为了提供对特定相互作用的生物学见解，我们进一步研究了积极相互作用的基础，结果表明产气荚膜梭菌通过细胞外囊泡促进地中海杆菌的生长。此外，我们将小韦荣球菌 (Veillonella parvula) 确定为一种能够调节环境 pH 值的物种，从而使副杆菌 (Parabacteroides merdae) 能够生长，这是一种对酸性条件高度敏感的菌株。这种增加 pH 值的作用可通过补充鸟嘌呤得到增强，并且在含有来自不同细菌门的不同 pH 降低菌株的多物种群落中持续存在。尽管小弧菌普遍存在于人类肠道微生物组中，但其含量通常较低。考虑到肠道细菌的空间组织，小弧菌对局部 pH 值的调节可能支持酸敏感菌株的生长。总的来说，这里提供的综合数据集和机制见解为通过整合生长相互作用来预测微生物组组成提供了一个起点。

title: Synthesis of Less-Substituted Borirenes Enabled by a Crystalline Arylhalohydroborane Reagent
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract As the smallest boron-containing Hückel 2π-aromatic rings, borirenes (i.e., boracyclopropene) are isoelectronic with the all-carbon cyclopropenyl cation. However, their structural diversity has long been confined to fully substituted scaffolds due to the stringent requirement for kinetic stabilization and limited synthetic methods, which hampers the exploration of their chemical space. Herein, we report an efficient synthetic route to a variety of less-substituted borirenes, enabled by a crystalline arylchlorohydroborane reagent featuring dual B–H and B–Cl functionalities (aryl = 2,6-(CF3)2phenyl, XylF). The protocol comprises a selective 1,1-hydroboration of alkynes, followed by cooperative NHC- and base-promoted ring-closure. The enhanced “push–pull” effect induced by the π-donating group on carbon and the electron-withdrawing XylF group on boron stabilizes these less-sterically protected aromatic borirenes, facilitating their isolation and structural characterization. Consequently, these borirenes readily undergo ring expansion into five- and six-membered boracycles via multiple isocyanide insertions into the polar C–B σ bond.
title_zh: 通过结晶芳基卤代氢硼烷试剂合成较少取代的硼烯
abstract_zh: 摘要 硼杂环丙烯（boracyclopropene）是最小的含硼 Hückel 2π-芳环，与全碳环丙烯基阳离子等电子。然而，由于对动力学稳定性的严格要求和有限的合成方法，它们的结构多样性长期以来仅限于完全取代的支架，这阻碍了对其化学空间的探索。在此，我们报告了一种有效合成各种低取代硼烯的路线，该路线由具有 B-H 和 B-Cl 双官能团的结晶芳基氯氢硼烷试剂实现（芳基 = 2,6-(CF3)2 苯基，XylF）。该方案包括炔烃的选择性 1,1-硼氢化反应，然后是 NHC 和碱基促进的合作闭环。碳上的 π 供体基团和硼上的吸电子 XylF 基团引起​​的增强的“推拉”效应稳定了这些空间保护较少的芳香硼烯，从而促进了它们的分离和结构表征。因此，这些硼烯很容易通过多个异氰化物插入极性 C-B σ 键而扩环成五元和六元硼环。

title: The critical challenges of energy diversification and environmental sustainability in the European Green Deal: Empirical evidence from European countries
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Energy Policy
abstract: The European Green Deal identifies energy diversification and environmental sustainability as two central pillars for achieving a secure, resilient, and climate-neutral energy system. Although previous studies have examined the determinants of environmental sustainability and the energy transition separately, limited evidence exists on how energy diversification, globalization, financial development, natural capital, and structural change jointly shape environmental sustainability within the European Green Deal framework. This study addresses this gap by investigating the macroeconomic determinants of environmental sustainability across 26 European countries during 1995-2023. The analysis employs dynamic System GMM as the primary estimation method, complemented by CS-ARDL to examine long-run relationships and machine-learning models with SHAP explainability to assess the relative importance of the explanatory variables. The results reveal strong persistence in environmental sustainability over time. Structural change is the only significant short-run determinant, while energy diversification and political globalization exhibit significant negative long-run effects, whereas financial development and natural capital show no robust long-run influence on environmental sustainability. These findings suggest that energy diversification alone does not guarantee environmental sustainability unless supported by renewable energy deployment, technological innovation, and effective environmental governance. By integrating dynamic econometric techniques with explainable machine learning, this study provides new evidence on the macroeconomic drivers of environmental sustainability and offers policy insights for implementing the European Green Deal more effectively.
title_zh: 欧洲绿色新政中能源多元化和环境可持续性的关键挑战：来自欧洲国家的经验证据
abstract_zh: 《欧洲绿色协议》将能源多样化和环境可持续性确定为实现安全、有弹性和气候中性的能源系统的两个核心支柱。尽管之前的研究分别考察了环境可持续性和能源转型的决定因素，但关于能源多样化、全球化、金融发展、自然资本和结构变革如何在欧洲绿色新政框架内共同塑造环境可持续性的证据有限。本研究通过调查 1995 年至 2023 年期间 26 个欧洲国家环境可持续性的宏观经济决定因素来弥补这一差距。该分析采用动态系统 GMM 作为主要估计方法，并辅以 CS-ARDL 来检查长期关系，并采用具有 SHAP 可解释性的机器学习模型来评估解释变量的相对重要性。结果表明，随着时间的推移，环境可持续性具有很强的持久性。结构变化是唯一重要的短期决定因素，而能源多样化和政治全球化则表现出显着的负面长期影响，而金融发展和自然资本对环境可持续性没有表现出强大的长期影响。这些发现表明，除非有可再生能源部署、技术创新和有效的环境治理的支持，否则单靠能源多样化并不能保证环境的可持续性。通过将动态计量经济学技术与可解释的机器学习相结合

title: Electron delocalization in a fullerene-dumbbell triad: synergistically optimizing carrier dynamics for boosting photocatalytic hydrogen evolution
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Organic photocatalysts typically suffer from compromised carrier dynamics due to inherently low electron mobility and high exciton binding energy, limiting efficient photoconversion. Herein, we synergistically optimize carrier dynamics by modulating electron delocalization using a fullerene-based dumbbell-triad, B2, consisting of a dithienopyrrolobenzothiadiazole donor and two C60 acceptors. Steady-state and transient photoelectrochemical measurements confirm that, compared to the mono-fullerene-based B1 and the dodecyl-modified dumbbell-counterpart B3, B2 nanoparticles exhibit pronounced electron delocalization. This effect significantly reduces the exciton binding energy, enhances the electron mobility, prolongs the carrier lifetime and extends its intermolecular diffusion length, thereby synergistically optimizing charge-carrier generation, transport, and utilization. Consequently, B2 exhibits a markedly improved photocatalytic hydrogen evolution rate (136 mmol g−1 h−1), surpassing B1 by 17.4 times, positioning it competitively among high-performing single-component photocatalysts. This work provides a novel strategy for optimizing photogenerated carrier dynamics, and elucidates the critical role of electron delocalization in boosting photoconversion.
title_zh: 富勒烯-哑铃三联体中的电子离域：协同优化载流子动力学以促进光催化析氢
abstract_zh: 由于固有的低电子迁移率和高激子结合能，有机光催化剂通常会受到载流子动力学的影响，从而限制了有效的光转换。在此，我们通过使用基于富勒烯的哑铃三联体 B2（由二噻吩并吡咯并苯并噻二唑供体和两个 C60 受体组成）调节电子离域来协同优化载流子动力学。稳态和瞬态光电化学测量证实，与单富勒烯基 B1 和十二烷基改性哑铃对应物 B3 相比，B2 纳米颗粒表现出明显的电子离域性。这种效应显着降低了激子结合能，增强了电子迁移率，延长了载流子寿命并延长了其分子间扩散长度，从而协同优化了载流子的产生、传输和利用。因此，B2的光催化析氢速率显着提高（136 mmol g−1 h−1），是B1的17.4倍，在高性能单组分光催化剂中具有竞争力。这项工作提供了一种优化光生载流子动力学的新策略，并阐明了电子离域在促进光转换中的关键作用。

title: Wafer-scale subwavelength excimer lithography enabled by dry-transferable photoresist
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: The rapid development of micro- and nanoscale devices has driven demand for wafer-scale, high-resolution nanostructure fabrication, which remains challenging for current nanolithography technologies. Here, we develop a cost-effective and high-throughput lithographic strategy for patterning sub-wavelength nanostructures over wafer-scale areas. This strategy is based on perfect conformal contact lithography combined with vacuum ultraviolet excimer irradiation at 172 nm. Using specially modified, transferable polymethyl methacrylate as a photoresist, the resulting approach enables high-fidelity, wafer-scale (8 inch) replication and fabrication of nanoscale (100 nm) patterns on both rigid and flexible substrates. We further develop a physical pattern-transfer method enabling high-resolution, solvent-free lift-off over large areas with 100% yield. The applicability of the lithography and pattern transfer strategy is demonstrated by the fabrication of 6560 nano-gap electrode structures over an area of 4 cm2 for MoS₂ transistor fabrication. Together with the demonstration of 12 representative transistors exhibiting on/off ratios approximately 108 and a large-aperture (10 cm) metalens enabling high-quality long-distance imaging, these results confirm the applicability of the proposed lithography and pattern transfer strategy across both electronic and optical devices.
title_zh: 通过干转移光刻胶实现晶圆级亚波长准分子光刻
abstract_zh: 微米级和纳米级器件的快速发展推动了对晶圆级、高分辨率纳米结构制造的需求，这对当前的纳米光刻技术仍然是一个挑战。在这里，我们开发了一种经济高效且高通量的光刻策略，用于在晶圆级区域上图案化亚波长纳米结构。该策略基于完美的保形接触光刻与 172 nm 真空紫外准分子照射相结合。使用经过特殊改性、可转移的聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯作为光致抗蚀剂，所得到的方法能够在刚性和柔性基板上实现高保真度、晶圆级（8英寸）复制和纳米级（100纳米）图案的制造。我们进一步开发了一种物理图案转移方法，可实现大面积高分辨率、无溶剂剥离，且产率 100%。通过在 4 cm2 面积上制造用于 MoS2 晶体管制造的 6560 个纳米间隙电极结构，证明了光刻和图案转移策略的适用性。结合展示开/关比约为 108 的 12 个代表性晶体管和可实现高质量长距离成像的大孔径 (10 cm) 超透镜，这些结果证实了所提出的光刻和图案转移策略在电子和光学器件中的适用性。
