title: Harnessing Host–Guest Conformational Matching for Efficient Near-Infrared Phosphorescence
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Near-infrared room-temperature phosphorescence holds significant promise for applications in bioimaging, diagnosis, and treatment. However, their development is constrained by the energy gap law; especially, systems that combine structural simplicity with high efficiency remain extremely scarce. Herein, a “conformation matching” strategy based on aromatic thioketone units is proposed, enabling the rational construction of highly efficient host–guest near-infrared phosphorescent materials. This high efficiency is attributed to the conformation match between the guest and host, whereby the molecular stacking and conformation could be optimized to realize exciton localization. The longest emission peak of the obtained material is at 715 nm, and the maximum phosphorescence quantum yield is as high as 55.5%. Mechanistic studies further reveal that “conformation matching” can simultaneously regulate nonradiative decay, radiative transition rates, and triplet–triplet energy transfer processes, leading to a synergistic enhancement of performance. This work not only provides a new design strategy for highly efficient and compact near-infrared phosphorescent materials but also establishes conformation engineering as a crucial new dimension for tuning host–guest phosphorescence properties.
title_zh: 利用主客体构象匹配实现高效的近红外磷光
abstract_zh: 摘要 近红外室温磷光在生物成像、诊断和治疗方面具有重要的应用前景。然而，它们的发展受到能隙定律的限制；特别是，结构简单且效率高的系统仍然极其稀缺。在此，提出了基于芳香硫酮单元的“构象匹配”策略，使得能够合理构建高效主客体近红外磷光材料。这种高效率归因于客体和主体之间的构象匹配，从而可以优化分子堆叠和构象以实现激子局域化。所得材料的最长发射峰在715 nm，最大磷光量子产率高达55.5%。机理研究进一步表明，“构象匹配”可以同时调节非辐射衰变、辐射跃迁速率和三重态-三重态能量转移过程，从而协同增强性能。这项工作不仅为高效、紧凑的近红外磷光材料提供了一种新的设计策略，而且将构象工程确立为调节主客体磷光性能的重要新维度。

title: Control regimes of nitrate air pollution reconciled by multiphase dissociation equilibrium
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Particulate nitrate is a major component of haze pollution, yet substantial debate exists regarding its effective control policies. Here, we develop a multiphase dissociation equilibrium equation, based on which the influence of meteorological conditions and chemical profiles can be decoupled, and the analytical expression of nitrate sensitivity to different species can be derived. With this framework, four nitrate control regimes are identified, namely the nitric-acid-control, ammonia-control, transition, and meteorology regimes. The framework also explains the trade-offs between sulfate and nitrate, and elucidates the influence of sulfate and non-volatile cations on the regime transitions. Across most Northern Hemisphere continental regions, and nearly all of China, particulate nitrate is generally more sensitive to nitric acid than to ammonia due to the universal NH3 excess. The framework provides transparent criteria for interpreting nitrate sensitivity and control regime classifications, serving as an important scientific basis for nitrate control policies and reactive nitrogen interactions.
title_zh: 通过多相解离平衡调节硝酸盐空气污染的控制机制
abstract_zh: 颗粒物硝酸盐是雾霾污染的主要组成部分，但对其有效的控制政策存在大量争议。在这里，我们建立了一个多相解离平衡方程，基于该方程可以解耦气象条件和化学剖面的影响，并可以导出硝酸盐对不同物种敏感性的解析表达式。在此框架下，确定了四种硝酸盐控制机制，即硝酸控制、氨控制、过渡和气象机制。该框架还解释了硫酸盐和硝酸盐之间的权衡，并阐明了硫酸盐和非挥发性阳离子对状态转变的影响。在北半球大部分大陆地区以及几乎整个中国，由于氨普遍过量，颗粒硝酸盐通常对硝酸比对氨更敏感。该框架为解释硝酸盐敏感性和控制制度分类提供了透明的标准，为硝酸盐控制政策和活性氮相互作用提供了重要的科学基础。

title: Understanding the Ultrafast Crystallization Kinetics of Donor–Acceptor Semiconducting Polymers
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The crystallization of donor–acceptor semiconducting polymers occurs on subsecond time scales at elevated temperatures (>300 °C), preventing a rigorous kinetic description using conventional experimental approaches. Here, we use a single-step fast scanning calorimetry (FSC) methodology that enables investigating the fast isothermal crystallization kinetics of advanced donor–acceptor semiconducting polymers such as PTQ10 and D18. This approach overcomes the intrinsic limitations of the indirect “by-step” method and provides reliable kinetic data within tenths of a second. Furthermore, we demonstrate that a modified version of the Malkin model, which we also introduce here, successfully captures the entire kinetic evolution and provides important information about how crystallization develops in these polymers. For example, we observe two well-differentiated crystallization regimes as a function of the crystallization temperature. A newly introduced geometrical parameter of the kinetic model reveals that the distinct crystallization kinetics result in different crystalline morphologies, which were further confirmed by X-ray diffraction, melting analysis, and electron microscopy. Our analysis suggests that crystallization proceeds via a nearly instantaneous formation of a dense population of nanoscopic crystallites and is effectively governed by a single dominant kinetic step that must therefore be strongly linked to nucleation. However, self-nucleation experiments reveal that this process does not conform to the classical nucleation behavior typically observed in semicrystalline polymers. These findings allow establishing a new framework for the understanding and control of the solid-state microstructure of semicrystalline polymers.
title_zh: 了解供体-受体半导体聚合物的超快结晶动力学
abstract_zh: 摘要：在高温（>300 °C）下，供体-受体半导体聚合物的结晶发生在亚秒级时间尺度上，这妨碍了使用传统实验方法进行严格的动力学描述。在这里，我们使用单步快速扫描量热法 (FSC) 方法来研究先进的供体-受体半导体聚合物（如 PTQ10 和 D18）的快速等温结晶动力学。这种方法克服了间接“分步”方法的固有局限性，并在十分之一秒内提供可靠的动力学数据。此外，我们证明了马尔金模型的修改版本（我们也在此处介绍）成功地捕获了整个动力学演化，并提供了有关这些聚合物中结晶如何发展的重要信息。例如，我们观察到两种截然不同的结晶机制作为结晶温度的函数。新引入的动力学模型几何参数表明，不同的结晶动力学导致不同的晶体形貌，这通过X射线衍射、熔化分析和电子显微镜进一步证实。我们的分析表明，结晶是通过几乎瞬时形成密集的纳米级微晶来进行的，并且由单一的主导动力学步骤有效控制，因此必须与成核密切相关。然而，自成核实验表明，该过程不符合通常观察到的经典成核行为。

title: Enhanced Sodium-Ion Transport across Solid Electrolyte Interphase via Electric-Field Modulation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The ion transport properties of the solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) critically govern the kinetics and cycling stability of rechargeable batteries. However, a mechanistic understanding of ion transport within this dynamic, multicomponent interphase remains limited. In this study, we demonstrate that spatial variations in the internal electric field across the SEI dictates a fundamental transition in Na+ transport mechanisms. Within the thin SEI region adjacent to the electrode, a strong electric field dominates, enabling ballistic Na+ transport with minimal scattering and thus facilitating rapid ion migration. In contrast, in thicker SEI regions where the electric field is attenuated, frequent ion collisions dominate, resulting in diffusive transport and reduced ion mobility. To validate this mechanism, we combined molecular dynamics and density functional theory simulations to evaluate electrolyte reducibility based on salt–solvent interactions. These computational insights are complemented by in situ, nondestructive potentiostatic chronocoulometry technique to quantitatively determine SEI formation charge. A systematic evaluation of 23 representative electrolytes reveals a strong correlation between SEI formation charge and SEI resistance (RSEI), consistent with the electric-field-dependent ion transport model (R2 = 0.993). Notably, eight electrolytes exhibit SEI formation charges below 50% and low RSEI, proving suppressed SEI formation promotes ballistic Na+ migration. The optimal electrolyte, 1 M NaPF6 in tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether (TEGDME), forms a ∼21 nm SEI with merely 31.7% charge loss. Na||hard carbon cells using this electrolyte achieve 24.48 Ω cm2 interfacial impedance and retain 99.4% capacity after 1200 cycles. This work offers a mechanistic framework for designing high-performance interphases through electrolyte engineering.
title_zh: 通过电场调制增强钠离子跨固体电解质界面的传输
abstract_zh: 摘要 固体电解质界面（SEI）的离子传输特性关键控制着可充电电池的动力学和循环稳定性。然而，对这种动态多组分界面内离子传输的机制理解仍然有限。在这项研究中，我们证明了 SEI 内部电场的空间变化决定了 Na+ 传输机制的根本转变。在靠近电极的薄 SEI 区域内，强电场占主导地位，使 Na+ 能够以最小的散射进行弹道传输，从而促进离子快速迁移。相反，在电场减弱的较厚 SEI 区域，频繁的离子碰撞占主导地位，导致扩散传输和离子迁移率降低。为了验证这一机制，我们结合分子动力学和密度泛函理论模拟来评估基于盐-溶剂相互作用的电解质还原性。这些计算见解得到原位、无损恒电位计时库仑技术的补充，以定量确定 SEI 形成电荷。对 23 种代表性电解质的系统评估揭示了 SEI 形成电荷和 SEI 电阻 (RSEI) 之间的强相关性，与电场依赖的离子传输模型 (R2 = 0.993) 一致。值得注意的是，八种电解质的 SEI 形成电荷低于 50% 且 RSEI 较低，证明抑制 SEI 形成可促进弹道式 Na+ 迁移。最佳电解质是 1 M NaPF6 的四乙二醇二甲醚 (TEGDME) 溶液，可形成

title: Photoinduced Reductive Elimination from Sulfur Enables a Unique Synthetic Valorization of Sulfonamides
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract A photochemical desulfonylation of sulfonamides has been discovered. Sulfonamides are abundant in medicinal-chemistry libraries. Strategies for their synthetic valorization remain relatively sparse, however, and their known reactions overwhelmingly retain the sulfonyl group, limiting the chemical space accessible from sulfonamides. Using this new method, an extensive array of aromatic sulfonamides bearing a selection of N-heteroaryl substituents was converted into the corresponding N-heteroaryl anilines, which are also medicinally important substructures. This reaction involves a unique photoinduced C–N reductive elimination from sulfur, which is proposed mainly to involve an excited-state, desulfonylative S-to-N aryl migration. An analogous polar aryl migration from a higher-energy, photogenerated sulfonamide tautomer was also identified, which likely serves as a minor pathway.
title_zh: 硫的光诱导还原消除实现了磺酰胺的独特合成增值
abstract_zh: 摘要 已发现磺酰胺的光化学脱磺酰化反应。磺胺类药物在药物化学库中含量丰富。然而，其合成增值策略仍然相对稀疏，并且它们已知的反应绝大多数保留了磺酰基，限制了磺酰胺可利用的化学空间。利用这种新方法，一系列带有精选 N-杂芳基取代基的芳香族磺​​酰胺被转化为相应的 N-杂芳基苯胺，这也是医学上重要的子结构。该反应涉及硫上独特的光诱导 C-N 还原消除，该反应主要涉及激发态、脱磺酰化的 S-N 芳基迁移。还鉴定出来自较高能量的光生磺酰胺互变异构体的类似极性芳基迁移，这可能是次要途径。

title: A missing continental impact melt sheet signal in the early Earth detrital zircon record
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Impact-derived melting has been proposed as a significant process in the formation of Earth’s early crust which could mean that impact melts are a source for Earth’s oldest minerals including ancient zircons. However, the source lithology of many Archean and Hadean zircons is unclear because many grains are detrital. Therefore, in this work, we develop a machine learning model trained on the U/Yb, Th/U, Yb, and Gd/Yb values of zircons from the 1.85 Ga Sudbury impact melt sheet and more typical igneous processes, so that it could distinguish between them. Here, we show that ancient zircons from three >3.2Ga localities did not crystallize from impact melt sheets. Our results support the hypothesis that early earth zircons are not sourced directly from impact melt sheets, especially one produced by impacting continental crust and indicate no evidence for a late heavy bombardment implying a more habitable Hadean.
title_zh: 早期地球碎屑锆石记录中缺失的大陆撞击熔融片信号
abstract_zh: 撞击引起的熔化被认为是地球早期地壳形成的一个重要过程，这可能意味着撞击熔化是地球最古老矿物（包括古代锆石）的来源。然而，许多太古代和太古宙锆石的来源岩性尚不清楚，因为许多颗粒是碎屑。因此，在这项工作中，我们开发了一种机器学习模型，对来自 1.85 Ga Sudbury 冲击熔片和更典型火成岩过程的锆石的 U/Yb、Th/U、Yb 和 Gd/Yb 值进行训练，以便能够区分它们。在这里，我们表明来自三个 >3.2Ga 地点的古代锆石并未从冲击熔化片中结晶。我们的研究结果支持这样的假设，即早期地球锆石并非直接来自撞击熔片，尤其是撞击大陆地壳产生的熔片，并且没有证据表明晚期猛烈轰击意味着存在更适宜居住的冥古宙。

title: Unveiling dominant toroidal magnetic fields in a protostellar outflow
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Magnetic fields play a fundamental role in the formation of protostellar winds. In the magneto-centrifugal models, poloidal magnetic fields launch winds from accretion disks, and fast-rotating gas twists the fields into toroidal geometry that collimates and accelerates winds through magnetic hoop stress. However, toroidal fields in protostellar winds remain observationally unresolved. Here we report polarization observations of carbon monoxide emission toward the NGC1333 IRAS 4A protostellar outflow. The inferred magnetic fields are perpendicular to the outflow axis and aligned with the rotational structure of the outflow, indicating toroidal fields with strengths of a few milligauss, sufficient to collimate and accelerate the outflow at several hundred astronomical units from the protostar. A linear correlation is found between the curl of plane-of-the-sky magnetic field and the line-of-sight electric current density. Our analysis provides better constraints on ion-electron drift velocity in protostellar outflows and supports rotating outflows driven by the magneto-centrifugal mechanism.
title_zh: 揭示原恒星流出中的主导环形磁场
abstract_zh: 磁场在原恒星风的形成中发挥着重要作用。在磁离心模型中，极向磁场从吸积盘发射风，快速旋转的气体将磁场扭曲成环形几何形状，通过磁环应力准直并加速风。然而，原恒星风中的环形场在观测上仍未得到解决。在这里，我们报告了 NGC1333 IRAS 4A 原恒星流出的一氧化碳排放的偏振观测。推断出的磁场垂直于流出轴，并与流出的旋转结构对齐，表明环形场的强度为几毫高斯，足以准直并加速距原恒星数百天文单位的流出。天空平面磁场的旋度与视线电流密度之间存在线性相关性。我们的分析为原恒星流出中的离子电子漂移速度提供了更好的约束，并支持磁离心机制驱动的旋转流出。

title: 3D-local noisy shallow quantum circuits defeat unbounded fan-in classical circuits
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Although quantum computers are believed to be more powerful than classical ones, a convincing experimental demonstration of this fact remains elusive. Proposed schemes either rely on unproven complexity-theoretic hardness assumptions, and/or require universal, fault-tolerant scalable quantum computers to implement. This has motivated the study of restricted models of computation. Constant-depth quantum circuits are known to be more powerful than unbounded fan-in classical ({{\mathsf{AC}}}^{0}-)circuits. Here we ask if this advantage persists in the presence of noise and under locality constraints. We present a computational problem for which every instance can be solved with near-certainty, despite noise, by a constant-depth quantum circuit with local operations in 3D. In contrast, every {{\mathsf{AC}}}^{0}-circuit of size smaller than a certain (sub)exponential fails with near-certainty on a uniformly random instance. This constitutes a proposal with built-in fault-tolerance to experimentally observe the strongest known complexity-theoretic separation between classical and quantum computation.
title_zh: 3D 局部噪声浅量子电路击败无界扇入经典电路
abstract_zh: 尽管量子计算机被认为比经典计算机更强大，但这一事实的令人信服的实验证明仍然难以实现。所提出的方案要么依赖于未经证实的复杂性理论硬度假设，和/或需要通用的、容错的可扩展量子计算机来实施。这激发了对受限计算模型的研究。众所周知，恒定深度量子电路比无界扇入经典 ({{\mathsf{AC}}}^{0}-) 电路更强大。在这里，我们要问的是，在存在噪声和局部性限制的情况下，这种优势是否仍然存在。我们提出了一个计算问题，尽管存在噪声，但每个实例都可以通过具有 3D 局部操作的恒定深度量子电路近乎确定地解决。相比之下，每个尺寸小于某个（子）指数的 {{\mathsf{AC}}}^{0} 电路在均匀随机实例上几乎肯定会失败。这构成了一个具有内置容错能力的提议，可以通过实验观察经典计算和量子计算之间已知最强的复杂性理论分离。

title: Synergistic magneto-enzymatic propulsion enables multimodal nanomotor swarms
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Enzymatic nanomotors self-propel by converting free molecular energy from chemical reactions. While initially used mainly as individual particles, these systems are increasingly implemented as swarms, where collective effects enable adaptable navigation in complex environments, broader coverage and enhanced local agent concentration. However, most studies have focused on planar swarming, and collective systems that combine magnetic navigation with enzyme-powered motion remain largely underexplored. Here, as a mechanistic proof-of-principle, we introduce urease-powered nanomotors based on bioproduced magnetosomes that operate in two sequential collective modes: (i) magnetic localization of the ensemble and (ii) catalysis-triggered, interface-dependent expansion of that localized cloud. We investigate this catalytic collective phenomenon under varying conditions, including particle and substrate concentrations, media viscosity, and confinement, and devote particular attention to distinguishing urea-driven buoyant accumulation from catalysis-dependent interfacial spreading using combined top/side-view imaging and inactive particle controls. Finally, we examine the swarm under a magnetic field gradient to concentrate it in a target area and then trigger catalytic expansion. In confined environments, where the free-interface expansion is suppressed, magnetic localization and local enrichment remain operative. Rather than targeting a specific immediate application, this work establishes a two step collective strategy, clarifies the mechanism underlying a distinct catalytic swarm mode, and defines the physical conditions that may support future environmental and biomedical implementations of multimodal nanomotor swarms.
title_zh: 协同磁酶推进使多模式纳米马达群成为可能
abstract_zh: 酶纳米马达通过转化化学反应中的自由分子能来自我推进。虽然最初主要用作单个粒子，但这些系统越来越多地以群体的形式实施，集体效应可以在复杂的环境中实现适应性导航、更广泛的覆盖范围和增强的局部代理集中度。然而，大多数研究都集中在平面集群上，而将磁导航与酶动力运动相结合的集体系统在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。在这里，作为机械原理验证，我们引入了基于生物产生的磁小体的脲酶驱动的纳米电机，该纳米电机以两种连续的集体模式运行：（i）整体的磁定位和（ii）催化触发的、局部云的界面依赖性扩展。我们研究了不同条件下的这种催化集体现象，包括颗粒和底物浓度、介质粘度和限制，并特别注意使用组合的顶/侧视图成像和非活性颗粒控制来区分尿素驱动的浮力积累和催化依赖性界面扩散。最后，我们在磁场梯度下检查群体，将其集中在目标区域，然后触发催化扩张。在限制环境中，自由界面膨胀受到抑制，磁定位和局部富集仍然有效。这项工作不是针对特定的立即应用，而是建立了一个两步集体策略，阐明了不同催化群背后的机制

title: ESMDynamic: Fast and accurate prediction of protein dynamic contact maps from single sequences
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Understanding conformational dynamics is essential for elucidating protein function, yet most deep learning models in structural biology predict only static structures. Here, we present ESMDynamic, a deep learning model that predicts residue–residue contact dynamics directly from protein sequence. Built on the ESMFold architecture and trained on conformational variability from experimental structure ensembles and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, ESMDynamic predicts dynamic contact probabilities, contact occupancy fraction, and coarse-grained kinetics of contact formation and dissociation across multiple temperature conditions. On large-scale MD benchmarks (mdCATH and ATLAS), ESMDynamic matches or outperforms state-of-the-art ensemble prediction methods (AlphaFlow, ESMFlow, BioEmu) while requiring orders-of-magnitude less computation. We demonstrate generalization to diverse systems, including membrane transporters, a de novo designed protein, and a homodimer complex. We show that predicted dynamic contacts enable automated selection of collective variables for Markov state model construction. Applied to the human proteome, ESMDynamic generates predictions for over 18,000 proteins, enabling large-scale analysis of conformational variability. Overall, ESMDynamic provides a scalable, sequence-based representation of protein dynamics to inform simulation, analysis, and design workflows.
title_zh: ESMDynamic：从单个序列快速准确地预测蛋白质动态接触图
abstract_zh: 了解构象动力学对于阐明蛋白质功能至关重要，但结构生物学中的大多数深度学习模型仅预测静态结构。在这里，我们提出了 ESMDynamic，这是一种深度学习模型，可以直接根据蛋白质序列预测残基-残基接触动态。 ESMDynamic 以 ESMFold 架构为基础，并根据实验结构集合和分子动力学 (MD) 模拟的构象变异性进行训练，可预测动态接触概率、接触占有率以及多个温度条件下接触形成和解离的粗粒度动力学。在大规模 MD 基准（mdCATH 和 ATLAS）上，ESMDynamic 匹配或优于最先进的集成预测方法（AlphaFlow、ESMFlow、BioEmu），同时需要数量级的计算量。我们证明了对不同系统的泛化，包括膜转运蛋白、从头设计的蛋白质和同型二聚体复合物。我们表明，预测的动态接触可以自动选择用于马尔可夫状态模型构建的集体变量。 ESMDynamic 应用于人类蛋白质组，可以生成超过 18,000 种蛋白质的预测，从而能够大规模分析构象变异性。总体而言，ESMDynamic 提供了可扩展的、基于序列的蛋白质动力学表示，为模拟、分析和设计工作流程提供信息。

title: Blood metabolomic signatures linking air pollution to lung cancer in the Cancer Prevention Studies
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Air pollution is a leading environmental cause of lung cancer, yet the underlying biological pathways remain poorly understood. Identifying circulating biomarkers that capture early molecular responses may clarify how air pollutants contribute to carcinogenesis and help identify individuals at elevated risk. We conduct a prospective nested case-control study within two Cancer Prevention Study cohorts, profiling more than 1100 metabolites in pre-diagnostic plasma samples from 1357 participants. Residential concentrations of six major air pollutants are estimated at the time of blood draw. Here we show that eight circulating metabolites are associated with both air pollution exposure and subsequent lung cancer risk. title_zh: 癌症预防研究中将空气污染与肺癌联系起来的血液代谢组学特征
abstract_zh: 空气污染是肺癌的一个主要环境原因，但其潜在的生物学途径仍然知之甚少。识别捕获早期分子反应的循环生物标志物可能会阐明空气污染物如何导致致癌，并有助于识别高风险个体。我们在两个癌症预防研究队列中进行了一项前瞻性巢式病例对照研究，分析了 1357 名参与者的诊断前血浆样本中的 1100 多种代谢物。抽血时估计六种主要空气污染物的住宅浓度。在这里，我们表明八种循环代谢物与空气污染暴露和随后的肺癌风险相关。四种代谢物，包括 γ-谷氨酰谷氨酰胺、苯乙酰谷氨酸、N-(2-呋喃酰基)甘氨酸和 4-乙烯基愈创木酚葡萄糖醛酸，显着介导颗粒物和臭氧的关联（调整后的 q 值）

title: Dissecting root-specific non-conventional effector-triggered immunity and its role in defense and shifting the microbiome
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Plant roots are extremely heterogeneous and non-photosynthetic tissue that is drastically different from leaves. Pioneering studies have revealed the existence of pattern-triggered immune responses in roots; however, whether roots mount tissue-specific effector-triggered immunity (ETI) is a fundamental question in plant immunity. By utilizing inducible effector-expressing lines, we systematically characterize non-conventional physiological and molecular responses during ETI activation in roots. Root ETI seems to be weaker than leaf ETI, evidenced by restricted cell death in the transition zone and fewer number of differentially expressed genes (DEGs). Root ETI also shows much higher DEG overlap with Pep1-triggered immunity than with Flg22-triggered responses, which is the opposite trend in leaves. We find that both PEPR1/2 receptors and BIK1, WRKY42 are required for induced root ETI responses. By comparing root responses to wild type and the T3SS mutant of Ralstonia solanacearum in the Nd-1 ecotype, we confirm that natural root ETI responses show similarities to induced ETI. Our work reveals tissue-specific features of root ETI and provides new insights into engineering root disease resistance in agriculture.
title_zh: 剖析根特异性非传统效应子触发的免疫及其在防御和改变微生物组中的作用
abstract_zh: 植物根是极其异质且非光合作用的组织，与叶子截然不同。开创性的研究揭示了根部存在模式触发的免疫反应。然而，根是否具有组织特异性效应物触发免疫（ETI）是植物免疫中的一个基本问题。通过利用诱导效应子表达系，我们系统地表征了根中 ETI 激活过程中的非常规生理和分子反应。根 ETI 似乎比叶 ETI 弱，过渡区细胞死亡有限和差异表达基因 (DEG) 数量较少证明了这一点。根 ETI 还显示出与 Pep1 触发的免疫反应比与 Flg22 触发的反应更高的 DEG 重叠，这与叶子中的趋势相反。我们发现 PEPR1/2 受体和 BIK1、WRKY42 都是诱导根 ETI 反应所必需的。通过比较 Nd-1 生态型中青枯菌对野生型和 T3SS 突变体的根反应，我们确认自然根 ETI 反应与诱导 ETI 相似。我们的工作揭示了根部 ETI 的组织特异性特征，并为农业工程根部抗病性提供了新的见解。

title: A flexible repertoire of wound closure strategies precedes whole-body regeneration
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Wound closure is an essential aspect of regeneration, often serving as the first morphogenetic step preceding downstream events. Animals capable of whole-body regeneration can heal virtually any wound, but how the process of re-epithelialization compares across injury types remains understudied. Here, we investigate wound closure in the acoel Hofstenia miamia. We find that H. miamia deploy two distinct modes of closure, depending on which epithelial layers are injured. Regardless of geometry, wounds that injure the outer epidermis close by constriction. In contrast, damage to both the outer epidermis and pharyngeal epithelium induces long, actin-rich protrusions that form transient bridges across the wound prior to re-epithelialization. Muscle contraction is differentially required across conditions, and pharmacological inhibition of actomyosin contractility is sufficient to shift closure dynamics across epithelia. This work compares wound closure within the same animal, identifying a wide toolkit of repair strategies that appears independent of subsequent regenerative processes.
title_zh: 灵活的伤口闭合策略先于全身再生
abstract_zh: 伤口闭合是再生的一个重要方面，通常作为下游事件之前的第一个形态发生步骤。具有全身再生能力的动物几乎可以治愈任何伤口，但如何比较不同损伤类型的上皮再生过程仍有待研究。在这里，我们研究了 acoel Hofstenia miamia 的伤口闭合情况。我们发现 H. miamia 采用两种不同的闭合模式，具体取决于受损的上皮层。无论几何形状如何，损伤外表皮的伤口都会因收缩而闭合。相比之下，外表皮和咽上皮的损伤会诱导长的、富含肌动蛋白的突起，在上皮再生之前形成跨伤口的短暂桥。不同条件下对肌肉收缩的需求不同，并且对肌动球蛋白收缩性的药理抑制足以改变上皮细胞的闭合动态。这项工作比较了同一动物内的伤口闭合情况，确定了一系列似乎独立于后续再生过程的修复策略工具包。

title: Host-aware Identification of Intrinsic Gene Expression Biopart Parameters using Combinatorial Libraries
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Model-based design in synthetic biology is limited because bioparts are typically characterised by relative metrics that vary across genetic and physiological contexts. To address this, we introduce a host-aware framework for quantitatively characterising bioparts in combinatorial libraries of plasmid-based constitutive expression constructs. The approach integrates a digital twin of Escherichia coli, conditioned on measured growth rate, with model-in-the-loop parameter identification to separate biopart-associated properties from host-dependent effects. Using structured combinatorial libraries, we identify mechanistically interpretable, transferable parameters for plasmid origins, promoters and ribosome binding sites. In particular, we define an intrinsic translation initiation capacity that captures the dominant RBS-associated contribution to translation while context-dependent expression emerges from host physiology and local sequence context. The resulting parameterisation accurately predicts protein synthesis across physiological conditions, supports incremental library expansion, and reveals localised failures of modularity, providing a scalable foundation for predictive host-aware design in synthetic biology.
title_zh: 使用组合文库对内在基因表达生物部分参数进行宿主感知鉴定
abstract_zh: 合成生物学中基于模型的设计是有限的，因为生物部件通常由随遗传和生理背景而变化的相对指标来表征。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个宿主感知框架，用于定量表征基于质粒的组成型表达构建体的组合文库中的生物部分。该方法将大肠杆菌的数字双胞胎（以测量的生长速率为条件）与模型在环参数识别相结合，以将生物部分相关特性与宿主依赖性效应分开。使用结构化组合文库，我们确定了质粒起源、启动子和核糖体结合位点的机械上可解释的、可转移的参数。特别是，我们定义了一种内在的翻译起始能力，它捕获了 RBS 相关的翻译贡献，同时上下文相关的表达从宿主生理学和局部序列上下文中出现。由此产生的参数化可以准确预测跨生理条件下的蛋白质合成，支持增量库扩展，并揭示模块化的局部失败，为合成生物学中的预测性宿主感知设计提供可扩展的基础。

title: Ultra-sensitive profiling of CRISPR-Cas off-target effects with Tracking-seq2
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Accurate detection of off-target activity in primary human cells is crucial for ensuring the safety of gene therapies, yet existing methods often lack sufficient sensitivity. To address this limitation, we develop Tracking-seq2, an advanced technology that integrates exogenous 5′ → 3′ exonuclease treatment and non-homologous end joining (NHEJ) pathway inhibitors with the original Tracking-seq. Tracking-seq2 exhibits enhanced sensitivity in profiling off-target sites of diverse genome editors—including Cas9, Cas12a, cytosine base editors (CBEs), adenine base editors (ABEs), and prime editors (PEs). Critically, Tracking-seq2 is directly applicable to clinically relevant primary human cell types, such as T cells and CD34+ hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs). Furthermore, our findings reveal that genomic variations drive distinct off-target heterogeneity across different individuals, highlighting the necessity for personalized safety assessment in clinical genome editing applications. Tracking-seq2 provides a robust platform for sensitive off-target detection in primary cells, with sensitivity comparable to or exceeding current state-of-the-art methods.
title_zh: 使用 Tracking-seq2 对 CRISPR-Cas 脱靶效应进行超灵敏分析
abstract_zh: 准确检测原代人类细胞的脱靶活性对于确保基因治疗的安全性至关重要，但现有方法往往缺乏足够的灵敏度。为了解决这一限制，我们开发了 Tracking-seq2，这是一种先进的技术，将外源 5′ → 3′ 核酸外切酶处理和非同源末端连接 (NHEJ) 途径抑制剂与原始 Tracking-seq 相结合。 Tracking-seq2 在分析不同基因组编辑器（包括 Cas9、Cas12a、胞嘧啶碱基编辑器 (CBE)、腺嘌呤碱基编辑器 (ABE) 和 Prime 编辑器 (PE)）的脱靶位点方面表现出更高的灵敏度。重要的是，Tracking-seq2 可直接适用于临床相关的原代人类细胞类型，例如 T 细胞和 CD34+ 造血干细胞和祖细胞 (HSPC)。此外，我们的研究结果表明，基因组变异导致不同个体之间存在明显的脱靶异质性，这凸显了临床基因组编辑应用中个性化安全评估的必要性。 Tracking-seq2 为原代细胞中灵敏的脱靶检测提供了一个强大的平台，其灵敏度可与或超过当前最先进的方法。

title: Integrative structural analysis of human endosomal NHE6 reveals a lipid-associated gate and disordered C-terminus
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Human NHE6 (HsNHE6) is an endosomal Na⁺/H⁺ exchanger essential for maintaining luminal pH and endo-lysosomal trafficking in neurons. HsNHE6 mutations are implicated in devastating neurological syndromes, but mechanistically the transporter remains poorly understood. Here, we present the single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structure of HsNHE6 at 3.4 Å, captured in an inward-facing conformation. The structure reveals a homodimeric architecture with 13 transmembrane helices per protomer, with the conserved ion-binding site located at the interface of the core and dimerization domains. Functional assays demonstrate that HsNHE6 reconstituted in liposomes exchanges Na⁺, K⁺, Li⁺, and Rb+ for H+, with kinetic analysis revealing a preference for K⁺. A structured C-terminal helix interacts with the transmembrane core, jointly forming a hydrophobic cavity containing two non-protein cryo-EM densities consistent with bound lipids that may modulate cation access to the ion-binding site. The remaining distal C-terminus of HsNHE6 is intrinsically disordered, as revealed by NMR and small-angle X-ray scattering, and extends up to 170 Å into the cytosol. Our integrative structural model of full-length HsNHE6 provides a framework for understanding HsNHE6-mediated ion exchange and its disruption in Christianson syndrome.
title_zh: 人内体 NHE6 的整合结构分析揭示了脂质相关门和无序 C 末端
abstract_zh: 人 NHE6 (HsNHE6) 是一种内体 Na⁺/H⁺ 交换剂，对于维持神经元腔内 pH 值和内溶酶体运输至关重要。 HsNHE6 突变与破坏性神经系统综合征有关，但从机制上讲，转运蛋白仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们展示了 HsNHE6 3.4 Å 的单粒子冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 结构，以向内的构象捕获。该结构揭示了同源二聚体结构，每个原聚体具有 13 个跨膜螺旋，保守的离子结合位点位于核心和二聚化结构域的界面处。功能分析表明，在脂质体中重构的 HsNHE6 将 Na+、K+、Li+ 和 Rb+ 交换为 H+，动力学分析显示对 K+ 的偏好。结构化的 C 端螺旋与跨膜核心相互作用，共同形成一个疏水腔，其中包含两个与结合脂质一致的非蛋白质冷冻电镜密度，可以调节阳离子进入离子结合位点。 NMR 和小角 X 射线散射显示，HsNHE6 的剩余远端 C 末端本质上是无序的，并延伸至细胞质中达 170 Å。我们的全长 HsNHE6 综合结构模型为理解 HsNHE6 介导的离子交换及其在 Christianson 综合征中的破坏提供了一个框架。

title: Ectomesenchymal identity emerges via relief of Twist1 transcript destabilisation
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: During vertebrate development, a subset of cranial neural crest cells (CNCCs) termed ‘ectomesenchyme’ differentiates into cell types canonically associated with the mesoderm (cartilage, bone and muscle). While the molecular decisions that guide CNCCs toward ectomesenchymal identity remain incompletely understood, the transcription factor Twist1 plays a central role. Here, we show that while Twist1 transcripts accumulate in late migratory CNCCs as cells enter the pharyngeal arch environment, a Twist1 enhancer within Hdac9 is active in the neural tube and CNCCs. We reconcile the temporal discrepancy between enhancer activity and transcript accumulation by showing that the Twist1 3’ UTR from multiple vertebrate species (but not the non-vertebrate chordate Ciona intestinalis) destabilises transcripts in the ectoderm via a conserved AU-Rich Element. Together, these findings reveal a vertebrate-specific, two-tiered regulatory mechanism that uncouples enhancer activity from transcript accumulation, gating the onset of Twist1 expression and the acquisition of ectomesenchymal identity in vertebrate CNCCs.
title_zh: 通过缓解 Twist1 转录物不稳定而出现外间充质特性
abstract_zh: 在脊椎动物发育过程中，称为“外间质”的颅神经嵴细胞 (CNCC) 子集分化为与中胚层（软骨、骨骼和肌肉）典型相关的细胞类型。虽然引导 CNCC 走向外间充质特性的分子决定仍不完全清楚，但转录因子 Twist1 发挥着核心作用。在这里，我们发现，当细胞进入咽弓环境时，Twist1 转录物在晚期迁移 CNCC 中积累，而 Hdac9 内的 Twist1 增强子在神经管和 CNCC 中活跃。我们通过证明来自多个脊椎动物物种（但不是非脊椎动物脊索动物海鞘）的 Twist1 3' UTR 通过保守的富含 AU 元素破坏外胚层中转录本的稳定性，来协调增强子活性和转录本积累之间的时间差异。总之，这些发现揭示了脊椎动物特有的两层调控机制，该机制将增强子活性与转录物积累分开，门控 Twist1 表达的开始以及脊椎动物 CNCC 中外间充质身份的获得。

title: Towards efficient perturbation for the noncoding genome
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Deciphering the functionality of the noncoding genome, which includes important cis-regulatory elements (CREs) and transcribed noncoding RNA genes, remains technically challenging. Here, using massively parallel genetic screening, we systematically benchmark the performance of five representative loss-of-function perturbation tools, including single-guide RNA (gRNA) mediated SpCas9 cleavage or CRISPR interference, and paired gRNA (pgRNA) involved dual-SpCas9, Big Papi (paired SpCas9 and SaCas9) or dual-enAsCas12a fragment deletion methods, in decoding the roles of the noncoding genome. For targeting CREs such as enhancers, dual-SpCas9 outperforms other methods with superior efficiency in destroying functional genomic regions. For perturbing noncoding RNA genes, in addition to dual-SpCas9, other RNA-targeting methods such as RNA interference are recommended to discriminate transcript-dependent or -independent roles. A deep learning model, DeepDC, with an associated web server, is built to facilitate optimal dual-SpCas9 pgRNA design for efficiently deleting a genomic fragment. Together, our work provides practical guidance on selecting appropriate loss-of-function tools to resolve the functional complexity of the noncoding genome.
title_zh: 对非编码基因组进行有效的扰动
abstract_zh: 破译非编码基因组的功能，包括重要的顺式调控元件 (CRE) 和转录的非编码 RNA 基因，在技术上仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们使用大规模并行遗传筛选，系统地对五种代表性功能丧失扰动工具的性能进行了基准测试，包括单向导RNA（gRNA）介导的SpCas9切割或CRISPR干扰，以及涉及双SpCas9、Big Papi（配对SpCas9和SaCas9）或双enAsCas12a片段删除方法的配对gRNA（pgRNA）在解码非编码基因组的作用中的性能。对于靶向增强子等 CRE，双 SpCas9 在破坏功能基因组区域方面的效率优于其他方法。对于扰动非编码 RNA 基因，除了双 SpCas9 之外，还建议使用其他 RNA 靶向方法（例如 RNA 干扰）来区分转录依赖或独立的作用。深度学习模型 DeepDC 以及相关的网络服务器的构建是为了促进最佳的双 SpCas9 pgRNA 设计，从而有效地删除基因组片段。总之，我们的工作为选择适当的功能丧失工具来解决非编码基因组的功能复杂性提供了实用指导。

title: Low kinetochore-microtubule occupancy leaves a mitotic memory by delaying checkpoint silencing
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The spindle assembly checkpoint (SAC) promotes faithful chromosome segregation by delaying mitosis until all kinetochores attach to spindle microtubules. However, unusually prolonged mitoses block daughter cell proliferation through a p53-dependent memory mechanism—the “mitotic stopwatch”—suggesting a selective pressure to avoid significant mitotic delays. Here, we show that microtubule occupancy at kinetochores is a cornerstone linking SAC silencing with mitotic duration and memory. By combining live-cell with super-resolution microscopy, photobleaching and laser microsurgery in Indian muntjac fibroblasts, we demonstrate that SAC silencing is gradual and confined to microtubule attachments within kinetochores. Augmin promotes timely SAC silencing with high microtubule occupancy at kinetochores, whereas MPS1/CDK1 inhibition silences the SAC irrespective of microtubule occupancy. Conversely, low microtubule occupancy delays SAC silencing, increases segregation errors and blocks daughter cell proliferation due to mitotic stopwatch surveillance. Thus, timely SAC silencing with high microtubule occupancy avoids “bad memories” of mitosis to allow daughter cell proliferation.
title_zh: 着丝粒微管占用率低通过延迟检查点沉默留下有丝分裂记忆
abstract_zh: 纺锤体组装检查点（SAC）通过延迟有丝分裂直到所有着丝粒附着到纺锤体微管上来促进忠实的染色体分离。然而，异常延长的有丝分裂通过 p53 依赖性记忆机制（“有丝分裂秒表”）阻止子细胞增殖，这表明存在选择性压力以避免显着的有丝分裂延迟。在这里，我们发现着丝粒的微管占据是将 SAC 沉默与有丝分裂持续时间和记忆联系起来的基石。通过将活细胞与超分辨率显微镜、光漂白和激光显微手术相结合，研究印度麂成纤维细胞，我们证明 SAC 沉默是渐进的，并且仅限于动粒内的微管附着。 Augmin 促进 SAC 及时沉默，并在动粒处具有高微管占用率，而 MPS1/CDK1 抑制则使 SAC 沉默，而与微管占用率无关。相反，低微管占用率会延迟 SAC 沉默，增加分离错误，并由于有丝分裂秒表监视而阻止子细胞增殖。因此，及时的 SAC 沉默和高微管占用率可以避免有丝分裂的“不良记忆”，从而允许子细胞增殖。

title: Overcoming the conversion-selectivity trade-off in plasma catalytic conversion of methane to ethylene
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Non-thermal plasma (NTP) is a promising approach for activating methane at room temperature, enabling its direct conversion to ethylene under mild conditions. However, the high energy consumption and the trade-off between methane conversion and ethylene selectivity limit its industrial application. Herein, we report a pure-silica self-pillared pentasil (SPP) zeolite catalyst that enables efficient methane conversion to ethylene under non-thermal plasma activation at room temperature. This plasma-catalytic system achieves an exceptional ethylene selectivity of 58.8% with an energy yield of 52 mmol/MJ at atmospheric pressure. Mechanistic studies reveal that isolated hydroxyl groups on the self-pillared pentasil catalyst stabilize gaseous methyl radicals, promoting carbon–carbon coupling and methane dissociation. The confined plasma between catalyst granules selectively suppresses further hydrogenation and methylation of the key C2H5 intermediate, thereby achieving high ethylene selectivity. By systematically adjusting boundary conditions, an ethylene yield of 40% is achieved, surpassing the benchmarks of both plasma and thermal catalytic processes.
title_zh: 克服甲烷等离子催化转化为乙烯的转化-选择性权衡
abstract_zh: 非热等离子体（NTP）是一种在室温下活化甲烷的有前途的方法，使其能够在温和条件下直接转化为乙烯。然而，高能耗以及甲烷转化率和乙烯选择性之间的权衡限制了其工业应用。在此，我们报道了一种纯二氧化硅自柱五元硅（SPP）沸石催化剂，该催化剂能够在室温下非热等离子体活化下将甲烷有效转化为乙烯。该等离子体催化系统在大气压下可实现 58.8% 的优异乙烯选择性和 52 mmol/MJ 的能量产率。机理研究表明，自柱五元硅催化剂上的孤立羟基可以稳定气态甲基自由基，促进碳-碳偶联和甲烷解离。催化剂颗粒之间的受限等离子体选择性地抑制关键C2H5中间体的进一步氢化和甲基化，从而实现高乙烯选择性。通过系统地调整边界条件，乙烯收率达到 40%，超过了等离子体和热催化工艺的基准。

title: In-plane molecular cord bridging as a method for boosting MXene fiber strength and toughness
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: MXenes enable high-performance fibers with strength, toughness, and conductivity, yet weak edge-to-edge interactions between nanosheets remain a critical challenge. Inspired by the cord-bound architecture of lamellar armor, we use molecular cords of carboxymethyl cellulose-wrapped single-walled carbon nanotubes to bridge adjacent MXene nanosheets via ionic coordination. Through mild and continuous wet-spinning, crosslinking, and hot-pressing, we fabricate MXene fibers containing only 0.12 wt% of the molecular cords that deliver enhanced mechanical properties: a tensile strength of 1.48 ± 0.06 GPa (peak: 1.55 GPa), ductility of 17.7 ± 0.8%, and toughness of 131.0 ± 8.7 MJ m−3 (peak: 140 MJ m−3), representing enhancements of 480%, 300%, and 1620% over pristine MXene fibers, while retaining electrical conductivity above 10,400 S cm−1 and a volumetric capacitance of 1645 F cm−3. These molecular cords reinforce interlayer bonding and in-plane bridges, enabling efficient stress transfer and crack inhibition in 2D nanosheet fibers. This molecular cord strategy could potentially be applied to maximize the mechanical performance of fibers derived from other two-dimensional nanosheets.
title_zh: 面内分子线桥接作为提高 MXene 纤维强度和韧性的方法
abstract_zh: MXene 使高性能纤维具有强度、韧性和导电性，但纳米片之间较弱的边对边相互作用仍然是一个关键挑战。受层状装甲的绳索结构的启发，我们使用羧甲基纤维素包裹的单壁碳纳米管的分子绳通过离子配位桥接相邻的 MXene 纳米片。通过温和、连续的湿纺、交联和热压，我们制造了仅含有 0.12 wt% 分子线的 MXene 纤维，具有增强的机械性能：拉伸强度为 1.48 ± 0.06 GPa（峰值：1.55 GPa），延展性为 17.7 ± 0.8%，韧性为 131.0 ± 8.7 MJ m−3（峰值： 140 MJ m−3)，比原始 MXene 纤维增强了 480%、300% 和 1620%，同时保持高于 10,400 S cm−1 的电导率和 1645 F cm−3 的体积电容。这些分子线增强了层间粘合和面内桥接，从而在二维纳米片纤维中实现有效的应力传递和裂纹抑制。这种分子绳策略有可能用于最大限度地提高源自其他二维纳米片的纤维的机械性能。

title: Mechanism of K63-linked polyubiquitin recognition and cleavage by the BRCA1-A complex
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Deubiquitylases modulate cellular processes by removing monoubiquitin or cleaving polyubiquitin chains. The ARISC–RAP80 complex partners with BRCA1–BARD1 to form the BRCA1-A supercomplex, which recognises K63-linked ubiquitin chains at DNA damage sites. ARISC–RAP80 contains multiple ubiquitin-binding sites, yet how these influence recognition and cleavage of K63-polyubiquitylated substrates remains unknown. We discover that a composite three-subunit interface allows ARISC–RAP80 to position K63-linked polyubiquitin chains in its catalytic site. Substrate recognition is further supported by RAP80 and non-catalytic ubiquitin-binding sites that impose a compact conformation on K63-polyubiquitylated substrates. This mechanism exploits the inherent flexibility of long ubiquitin chains and differs considerably from other deubiquitylases. Structure-guided mutageneses validate ubiquitin chain interactions, and cell-based assays demonstrate a functional role of the observed interfaces in chromatin recruitment. Our findings define mechanisms of polyubiquitin chain decoding and cleavage by ARISC–RAP80, linking ubiquitin reading and erasing functions to BRCA1-A mediated DNA damage responses.
title_zh: BRCA1-A 复合物识别和切割 K63 连接的多聚泛素的机制
abstract_zh: 去泛素酶通过去除单泛素或裂解多泛素链来调节细胞过程。 ARISC-RAP80 复合体与 BRCA1-BARD1 结合形成 BRCA1-A 超级复合体，可识别 DNA 损伤位点处的 K63 连接泛素链。 ARISC–RAP80 包含多个泛素结合位点，但这些位点如何影响 K63 多泛素化底物的识别和切割仍然未知。我们发现复合三亚基界面允许 ARISC-RAP80 将 K63 连接的多聚泛素链定位在其催化位点。 RAP80 和非催化泛素结合位点进一步支持底物识别，这些位点在 K63 多泛素化底物上形成紧凑的构象。该机制利用长泛素链固有的灵活性，与其他去泛素化酶有很大不同。结构引导诱变验证了泛素链相互作用，基于细胞的测定证明了观察到的界面在染色质招募中的功能作用。我们的研究结果定义了 ARISC-RAP80 多聚泛素链解码和切割的机制，将泛素读取和擦除功能与 BRCA1-A 介导的 DNA 损伤反应联系起来。

title: PA200 modulates immunoproteasome structure and activity
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The proteasome activator PA200 binds to the catalytic core of both standard proteasome (s20S) and the immunoproteasome (i20S); however, whether PA200 uses the same mechanisms to activate i20S remains unknown. In this work, the cryo-EM structures of singly- and doubly-capped i20S–PA200 complexes, combined with complementary in vitro biochemical assays, show that binding of the first PA200 induces allosteric bending of the i20S and widens the opposite α-ring, promoting higher PA200 occupancy and stronger activation compared to the s20S. PA200 also selectively modulates i20S proteolytic activity by enhancing peptide production and shifting cleavage specificity toward caspase-like activity. In cells and tissues co-expressing PA200, s20S, and i20S, PA200 preferentially associates with the i20S. Moreover, PA200 and i20S catalytic subunits are differentially regulated, with PA200 playing a potential role in regulating the i20S subunits’ expression. Overall, these findings suggest that PA200 contributes to the regulation of i20S function and dynamics.
title_zh: PA200 调节免疫蛋白酶体结构和活性
abstract_zh: 蛋白酶体激活剂 PA200 与标准蛋白酶体 (s20S) 和免疫蛋白酶体 (i20S) 的催化核心结合；然而，PA200是否使用相同的机制来激活i20S仍然未知。在这项工作中，单端和双端 i20S-PA200 复合物的冷冻电镜结构，结合互补的体外生化测定，表明第一个 PA200 的结合诱导 i20S 的变构弯曲并加宽相反的 α 环，与 s20S 相比，促进更高的 PA200 占有率和更强的激活。 PA200 还通过增强肽生成并将切割特异性转向半胱天冬酶样活性来选择性调节 i20S 蛋白水解活性。在共表达 PA200、s20S 和 i20S 的细胞和组织中，PA200 优先与 i20S 结合。此外，PA200和i20S催化亚基受到差异性调节，其中PA200在调节i20S亚基的表达中发挥潜在作用。总的来说，这些发现表明 PA200 有助于调节 i20S 功能和动力学。

title: Structure of NHE6 and its lipid-mediated interactions regulating endosomal pH
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Sodium-proton exchangers (NHEs) are found in all cells to regulate intracellular pH, sodium levels and cell volume. In humans, there are nine different NHE transporters (SLC9A1-9), which vary in tissue distribution, kinetics and regulation. NHE6 localizes to endosomal membranes and mutations in the protein are known to cause the X-linked neurological disorder Christianson syndrome. Despite its importance, the structural basis of NHE6 function and regulation is unclear. Here we report four cryo-electron microscopy structures of rat NHE6 between 2.2 and 3.3 Å resolution, revealing its homodimeric structure, ion binding and remodelling by lipids. We characterize a lipid-binding site between the protomers that accommodates the endosomal-specific phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) lipid. Using solid-supported membrane (SSM)-based electrophysiology we demonstrate that NHE6 transports both Na+ and K+ ions and that PI3P enhances NHE6 stability and activity. Furthermore, we identify a phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PI(4,5)P2) lipid, which interacts with the C-terminal domain of NHE6 to stabilize an auto-inhibited state. We further demonstrate that NHE6 is non-functional when mislocalized to the plasma membrane where PI(4,5)P2 is primarily located. We propose the lipid-dependent regulation has evolved to shut-down NHE6 activity during recycling of endosomes at the plasma membrane.
title_zh: NHE6的结构及其脂质介导的相互作用调节内体pH
abstract_zh: 钠质子交换器 (NHE) 存在于所有细胞中，可调节细胞内 pH、钠水平和细胞体积。在人类中，有九种不同的 NHE 转运蛋白 (SLC9A1-9)，它们的组织分布、动力学和调节各不相同。 NHE6 定位于内体膜，并且该蛋白的突变已知会导致 X 连锁神经系统疾病克里斯蒂安森综合征。尽管 NHE6 很重要，但其功能和调节的结构基础尚不清楚。在这里，我们报告了大鼠 NHE6 的四种冷冻电子显微镜结构，分辨率为 2.2 至 3.3 Å，揭示了其同二聚体结构、离子结合和脂质重塑。我们表征了原聚体之间的脂质结合位点，该位点容纳内体特异性磷脂酰肌醇 3-磷酸 (PI3P) 脂质。使用基于固体支撑膜 (SSM) 的电生理学，我们证明 NHE6 可以转运 Na+ 和 K+ 离子，并且 PI3P 可以增强 NHE6 的稳定性和活性。此外，我们还发现了一种磷脂酰肌醇 4,5-二磷酸 (PI(4,5)P2) 脂质，它与 NHE6 的 C 末端结构域相互作用以稳定自身抑制状态。我们进一步证明，当 NHE6 错误定位到 PI(4,5)P2 主要所在的质膜时，NHE6 就失去功能。我们认为，脂质依赖性调节已经进化到在质膜内体循环过程中关闭 NHE6 活性。

title: A ubiquitin chain-feeding mechanism for BRCA1-A
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The BRCA1-A complex is a multi-subunit, metallo-deubiquitinating enzyme (metallo-DUB) involved in genome maintenance. BRCA1-A displays strict specificity for K63-linked ubiquitin, with a strong preference for long chains, but the mechanistic basis for this selectivity has remained unclear. To address this, we have developed an activity-based probe that is specific for metallo-DUBs and mimics di- or polyubiquitin chains of any linkage (di- and poly-ubiquitinATA). We have solved cryoEM structures of BRCA1-A bound to K63-linked probe chains of various length, capturing multiple conformational and catalytic states. The structures reveal how allosteric regulation of catalysis occurs within the complex and how BRCA1-A uses auxiliary ubiquitin-binding sites to engage substrate by avidity and to trigger processive cleavage. Crucially, avidity and processivity can only apply to long polyubiquitin chains, explaining BRCA1-A’s substrate preference. Together, these results establish BRCA1-A as a chain-shortening DUB specialised for trimming extended K63-linked polyubiquitin chains.
title_zh: BRCA1-A 的泛素链供给机制
abstract_zh: BRCA1-A 复合体是一种多亚基金属去泛素化酶 (metalo-DUB)，参与基因组维护。 BRCA1-A 对 K63 连接的泛素表现出严格的特异性，对长链具有强烈的偏好，但这种选择性的机制基础仍不清楚。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种基于活性的探针，该探针专门针对金属 DUB，并模拟任何连接的二泛素或多泛素链（二泛素和多泛素ATA）。我们已经解析了与不同长度的 K63 连接探针链结合的 BRCA1-A 的冷冻电镜结构，捕获了多种构象和催化状态。这些结构揭示了复合物内催化的变构调节如何发生，以及 BRCA1-A 如何使用辅助泛素结合位点通过亲和力与底物结合并触发持续裂解。至关重要的是，亲合力和持续合成能力仅适用于长多聚泛素链，这解释了 BRCA1-A 的底物偏好。总之，这些结果表明 BRCA1-A 是一种链缩短 DUB，专门用于修剪延长的 K63 连接的多聚泛素链。

title: Thalamocortical bursts encode reward contingencies and drive associative learning
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Learning requires adaptive changes in neuronal circuits, but how neurons encode learning content in their activity patterns to construct memories remains poorly understood. Using longitudinal multi-site recordings in freely moving male mice performing a sensory discrimination task, we discover the emergence of burst-coding neurons (BCNs) across cortical, thalamic, and extrathalamic regions. BCNs encoded task rules through the presence or absence of bursts, with their proportion increasing as learning progressed. Decoding analyses reveal that BCNs act as the principal carriers of rule information within the thalamocortical system. BCN burst rates scaled with stimulus valence, collapsed when contingencies were degraded, and inverted after repeated rule reversals, demonstrating that bursts dynamically track associative context during learning. Indeed, pharmacological and focal genetic suppression of thalamocortical bursting disrupted learning and task performance, establishing neuronal bursts as context-sensitive drivers of associative learning. These findings identify a burst-based neural code for stimulus–outcome associations in the thalamocortical system and provide causal evidence linking cellular firing dynamics to reward contingency learning.
title_zh: 丘脑皮质爆发编码奖励意外事件并驱动联想学习
abstract_zh: 学习需要神经元回路的适应性变化，但神经元如何在其活动模式中编码学习内容以构建记忆仍然知之甚少。通过对执行感觉辨别任务的自由活动的雄性小鼠进行纵向多部位记录，我们发现皮质、丘脑和丘脑外区域出现了突发编码神经元（BCN）。 BCN 通过是否存在突发来编码任务规则，其比例随着学习的进展而增加。解码分析表明，BCN 是丘脑皮质系统内规则信息的主要载体。 BCN 爆发率随刺激效价的变化而变化，当意外事件恶化时，BCN 爆发率会崩溃，并且在规则反复逆转后会发生反转，这表明爆发率在学习过程中动态跟踪关联上下文。事实上，丘脑皮质爆发的药理学和局部遗传抑制扰乱了学习和任务表现，将神经元爆发确立为联想学习的情境敏感驱动因素。这些发现确定了丘脑皮质系统中刺激-结果关联的基于突发的神经代码，并提供了将细胞放电动力学与奖励应急学习联系起来的因果证据。

title: Th17 effector cytokines induce shared and distinct microglial and endothelial cell responses in a mouse model for post-streptococcal encephalitis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Group A Streptococcus (GAS) infections cause neuropsychiatric complications in children, but the mechanisms linking peripheral infection to brain dysfunction remain unclear. Using mouse genetics, single-cell RNA sequencing, and spatial transcriptomics, we show that GAS infections induce inflammatory transcriptional programs in microglia and brain endothelial cells (BECs), accompanied by loss of blood-brain barrier (BBB) gene expression in female mice. Spatial transcriptomic analyses reveal that GAS-responsive microglia localize near infiltrating CD4+ T cells. Several microglial chemokines induced in mice are elevated in sera from affected patients. Deletion of GM-CSF in CD4⁺ T cells partially reduces microglial chemokine gene expression, without restoring BBB integrity. In contrast, IL-17A neutralization partially rescues BBB transcriptional changes, but not BBB dysfunction, and reduces microglial chemokine expression. Microglia-specific deletion of IL-17 receptor A partially restores BBB integrity after GAS infections. Our findings identify microglial IL-17A–IL17RA signaling as a potential mediator of BBB dysfunction and neuroinflammation after GAS infections.
title_zh: Th17 效应细胞因子在链球菌后脑炎小鼠模型中诱导共同且不同的小胶质细胞和内皮细胞反应
abstract_zh: A 族链球菌 (GAS) 感染会导致儿童神经精神并发症，但外周感染与脑功能障碍之间的联系机制仍不清楚。利用小鼠遗传学、单细胞 RNA 测序和空间转录组学，我们发现 GAS 感染会诱导小胶质细胞和脑内皮细胞 (BEC) 中的炎症转录程序，并伴有雌性小鼠血脑屏障 (BBB) 基因表达的丧失。空间转录组分析表明，GAS 反应性小胶质细胞位于浸润性 CD4+ T 细胞附近。在小鼠中诱导的几种小胶质细胞趋化因子在受影响患者的血清中升高。 CD4⁺ T 细胞中 GM-CSF 的缺失部分降低了小胶质细胞趋化因子基因的表达，但没有恢复 BBB 的完整性。相比之下，IL-17A 中和可以部分挽救 BBB 转录变化，但不能挽救 BBB 功能障碍，并减少小胶质细胞趋化因子的表达。小胶质细胞特异性删除 IL-17 受体 A 可部分恢复 GAS 感染后 BBB 的完整性。我们的研究结果表明，小胶质细胞 IL-17A–IL17RA 信号传导是 GAS 感染后 BBB 功能障碍和神经炎症的潜在介质。

title: Adipocyte-derived β-hydroxybutyrate confers metabolic resilience in multiple myeloma
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Multiple myeloma (MM) remains an incurable blood cancer. Obesity is a known risk factor, but how adipocytes promote MM progression is not fully understood. Here, we uncover a metabolic crosstalk between adipocytes and MM cells that promotes MM cell survival under glucose deprivation. We show that glucose restriction activates AMPK, disrupting HSP90-IRF4 binding and rendering IRF4 susceptible to TRIM21-mediated proteasomal degradation. Paradoxically, the same stress stimulates adipocytes to produce β-hydroxybutyrate (β-OHB). MM cells utilize β-OHB through OXCT1-mediated ketolysis, fueling NAT10-dependent acetylation of IRF4 at K87, which restores IRF4-HSP90 binding and sustains tumor cell survival. Genetic ablation of the rate-limiting ketogenic enzyme Hmgcs2 in adipocytes abrogates this protective effect. Importantly, combining an AMPK activator (metformin) with an OXCT1 inhibitor (pimozide) or a NAT10 inhibitor (remodelin) shows synergistic anti-tumor activity in vivo. Our findings position adipocyte-derived β-OHB as a critical metabolic adaptor and highlight a potential combination therapy for MM.
title_zh: 脂肪细胞衍生的 β-羟基丁酸赋予多发性骨髓瘤代谢弹性
abstract_zh: 多发性骨髓瘤 (MM) 仍然是一种无法治愈的血癌。肥胖是一个已知的危险因素，但脂肪细胞如何促进 MM 进展尚不完全清楚。在这里，我们发现脂肪细胞和 MM 细胞之间的代谢串扰能够促进 MM 细胞在葡萄糖剥夺下的存活。我们发现葡萄糖限制会激活 AMPK，破坏 HSP90-IRF4 结合并使 IRF4 容易受到 TRIM21 介导的蛋白酶体降解的影响。矛盾的是，同样的压力会刺激脂肪细胞产生β-羟基丁酸（β-OHB）。 MM细胞通过OXCT1介导的酮解作用利用β-OHB，促进IRF4在K87处的NAT10依赖性乙酰化，从而恢复IRF4-HSP90结合并维持肿瘤细胞存活。脂肪细胞中限速生酮酶 Hmgcs2 的基因消除消除了这种保护作用。重要的是，将 AMPK 激活剂（二甲双胍）与 OXCT1 抑制剂（匹莫齐特）或 NAT10 抑制剂（重塑蛋白）组合显示出体内协同抗肿瘤活性。我们的研究结果将脂肪细胞衍生的 β-OHB 定位为关键的代谢适配器，并强调了 MM​​ 的潜在联合疗法。

title: Natural variation in BRN1 enhances nitrogen sensitivity to improve rice nitrogen use efficiency
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Green Revolution rice varieties deliver high yields but require excessive nitrogen (N) fertilizer and show diminished N responsiveness, severely reducing nitrogen-use efficiency (NUE). To dissect the molecular basis of low N sensitivity in modern cultivars, we conducted a genome-wide association study (GWAS) for biomass response to N (BRN), a trait tightly linked to N sensitivity, using a diverse rice germplasm panel. We identified BRN1 as a key regulator of N-dependent biomass accumulation that regulates NLP3, a master transcription factor governing nitrate signaling. Under elevated N supply, the strigolactone signaling repressor D53 accumulates substantially and interacts with BRN1 to repress NLP3 transcription, thereby reducing rice N response. Notably, the high-response BRN1H allele encodes a more stable protein that alleviates D53-mediated suppression. Introgression of this allele into modern cultivars significantly enhanced N sensitivity and grain yield under both low and high N conditions. Our findings establish a D53-BRN1-NLP3 regulatory module controlling rice NUE, providing a target for rice breeding to sustain high productivity with improved resource sustainability.
title_zh: BRN1 的自然变异增强氮敏感性以提高水稻氮利用效率
abstract_zh: 绿色革命水稻品种产量高，但需要过量的氮 (N) 肥料，并且氮响应能力下降，严重降低了氮利用效率 (NUE)。为了剖析现代品种低氮敏感性的分子基础，我们使用多种水稻种质资源，针对氮（BRN）的生物量响应（BRN）进行了全基因组关联研究（GWAS），这是一种与氮敏感性密切相关的性状。我们确定 BRN1 是 N 依赖性生物量积累的关键调节因子，它调节 NLP3，NLP3 是控制硝酸盐信号传导的主要转录因子。在氮供应增加的情况下，独脚金内酯信号抑制子 D53 大量积累并与 BRN1 相互作用，抑制 NLP3 转录，从而降低水稻氮响应。值得注意的是，高反应 BRN1H 等位基因编码一种更稳定的蛋白质，可以减轻 D53 介导的抑制。该等位基因渗入现代品种显着增强了低氮和高氮条件下的氮敏感性和谷物产量。我们的研究结果建立了控制水稻 NUE 的 D53-BRN1-NLP3 调控模块，为水稻育种提供了一个目标，以维持高生产力并提高资源可持续性。

title: CAKR: commutative algebra k-mer representations for genomics
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Despite the availability of various sequence analysis models, comparative genomic analysis remains a challenge in genomics, genetics, and phylogenetics. Commutative algebra, a fundamental tool in algebraic geometry and number theory, has rarely been used in data and biological sciences. In this study, we introduce commutative algebra k-mer representations as a nonlinear algebraic framework for analyzing genomic sequences. This representation bridges commutative algebra, algebraic topology, combinatorics, and machine learning to establish a mathematical framework for comparative genomic analysis. We evaluate its effectiveness on three tasks including genetic variant classification, phylogenetic tree reconstruction, and viral classification, typically requiring alignment-based, alignment-free, and machine-learning approaches, respectively. In this work, we show that commutative algebra k-mer representations outperform five state-of-the-art sequence analysis methods across twelve primary datasets, with two additional supplementary fragment-placement benchmarks, especially in viral classification, and maintain relatively stable predictive accuracy as dataset size increases, underscoring scalability and robustness.
title_zh: CAKR：基因组学的交换代数 k-mer 表示
abstract_zh: 尽管有各种序列分析模型可用，但比较基因组分析仍然是基因组学、遗传学和系统发育学中的挑战。交换代数是代数几何和数论的基本工具，但很少在数据和生物科学中使用。在本研究中，我们引入交换代数 k-mer 表示作为分析基因组序列的非线性代数框架。这种表示将交换代数、代数拓扑、组合学和机器学习联系起来，为比较基因组分析建立了数学框架。我们评估其在三个任务上的有效性，包括遗传变异分类、系统发育树重建和病毒分类，通常分别需要基于比对、无比对和机器学习方法。在这项工作中，我们表明，交换代数 k-mer 表示在 12 个主要数据集上优于 5 种最先进的序列分析方法，并具有两个额外的补充片段放置基准，特别是在病毒分类中，并且随着数据集大小的增加保持相对稳定的预测准确性，强调了可扩展性和鲁棒性。

title: Secular change in orogenic duration reveals alternating tectonic regimes during the Archaean-Proterozoic
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Geological constraints and modelling results reveal major yet poorly understood changes in Earth’s tectonic regimes during the late Archaean and Proterozoic. These changes are associated with supercontinent cycles, a primary archive of lithosphere and convecting mantle behaviour, and impact orogen duration and thermal state. However, the lack of precise data on orogen duration during Columbia assembly limits our understanding of the long-term tectonic evolution and comparison with younger orogens. Through in-situ garnet Lu–Hf and monazite microdomain U–Pb geochronology, here we constrain a 220 Myr hot collisional orogen during Columbia assembly, significantly longer than contemporary cold orogens (110–160 Myr). Secular changes in collisional orogen duration indicate a non-monotonic trend from Neoarchaean to Neoproterozoic. This trend implies enhanced plate rigidity and mobility during Columbia assembly, followed by a marked decline during Rodinia assembly, consistent with inferred plate velocity proxies. These findings support evolving tectonic regimes alternating between sluggish lid and more active plate tectonics during the Neoarchaean-Proterozoic.
title_zh: 造山持续时间的长期变化揭示了太古代-元古代时期的交替构造状况
abstract_zh: 地质限制和建模结果揭示了太古宙晚期和元古代地球构造体系发生的重大但人们知之甚少的变化。这些变化与超大陆旋回有关，这是岩石圈和对流地幔行为的主要档案，并影响造山带持续时间和热状态。然而，缺乏关于哥伦比亚组装期间造山带持续时间的精确数据限制了我们对长期构造演化的理解以及与较年轻的造山带的比较。通过原位石榴石 Lu-Hf 和独居石微域 U-Pb 地质年代学，我们在哥伦比亚组装过程中限制了 220 Myr 的热碰撞造山带，明显长于当代的冷造山带（110-160 Myr）。碰撞造山带持续时间的长期变化表明从新太古代到新元古代的非单调趋势。这一趋势意味着哥伦比亚组装期间板的刚性和活动性增强，随后罗迪尼亚组装期间明显下降，与推断的板速度代理一致。这些发现支持新太古代-元古代期间缓慢的盖板构造和更活跃的板块构造之间不断变化的构造制度。

title: Performance and user response of android’s smartphone-based alerts in the 2025 Marmara Ereğlisi earthquake
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: This study presents a comprehensive evaluation of Google’s Android Earthquake Alert (AEA) system during the Mw 6.2 Marmara Ereğlisi, Türkiye earthquake. AEA detected the event 5.31 seconds after its initiation, alerting over 16 million users. Warning times for weak shaking (MMI III) reached up to 150 seconds, with a median of 56 seconds. While near-source warning windows were shorter, the system achieved 90% true positives and 99% precision overall. The high density of the phone network enabled faster detection than traditional stations, even for this offshore epicenter. Feedback data shows AEA recipients were highly likely to take protective actions, such as “drop, cover, and hold on,” or warn others. Timely alerts substantially increased user engagement, perceived usefulness, and future trust. These results highlight how crowd-sourced technology and behavioral insights can effectively enhance seismic resilience on a massive scale.
title_zh: 2025 年 Marmara Ereğlisi 地震中基于 Android 智能手机的警报的性能和用户响应
abstract_zh: 本研究对土耳其马尔马拉埃雷利西 6.2 级地震期间的 Google Android 地震警报 (AEA) 系统进行了全面评估。 AEA 在事件启动后 5.31 秒检测到该事件，向超过 1600 万用户发出警报。弱晃动（MMI III）的警告时间长达 150 秒，中位数为 56 秒。虽然近源警告窗口较短，但该系统的真阳性率和总体准确率达到 99%。电话网络的高密度使得检测速度比传统站点更快，即使对于这个离岸震中也是如此。反馈数据显示，AEA 接收者很有可能采取保护措施，例如“放下、掩护和抓住”或警告他人。及时的警报大大提高了用户参与度、感知有用性和未来信任。这些结果凸显了众包技术和行为洞察如何能够有效地大规模增强抗震能力。

title: APOBEC3-driven attenuation of the 2022 global outbreak monkeypox virus relative to its clade IIb ancestor
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) is a zoonotic virus endemic to Africa that has recently re-emerged, becoming the first orthopoxvirus with sustained human-to-human transmission since smallpox eradication. The 2022 global epidemic of MPXV was caused by Clade IIb virus (lineage B.1) that derived from the lineage A endemic to West Africa through APOBEC3 microevolution1–3. Here, comparison of lineage B.1 virus with its closest earlier A.1 ancestor reveals that despite only 46 nucleotide differences, lineage B.1 has attenuating phenotypic changes. Both viruses replicated equivalently in cell culture, but B.1 had defects in long-range spread, which mapped to APOBEC3 mutation E353K in OPG057 (F13L). MPXV B.1 was also defective in innate immune control, inducing higher IFNβ and innate immune signalling gene expression, and showing reduced capacity to suppress interleukin-1β-mediated responses, which mapped to APOBEC3 mutation R48C in OPG047 (F3L). Finally, MPXV B.1 had reduced virulence in a mouse model of MPXV infection relative to the ancestral A.1 strain. Our work demonstrates that the 2022 global outbreak MPXV was intrinsically attenuated, with attenuating mutations that are absent in concurrent, more severe clade IIb outbreaks. Our data also reveal that APOBEC3 editing is a mechanism of MPXV phenotypic variation, potentially contributing to clade evolution and competition.
title_zh: APOBEC3 驱动的 2022 年全球爆发猴痘病毒相对于其 IIb 分支祖先的减弱
abstract_zh: 猴痘病毒（MPXV）是一种非洲特有的人畜共患病毒，最近重新出现，成为自天花根除以来第一个在人与人之间持续传播的正痘病毒。 2022 年全球流行的 MPXV 是由 Clade IIb 病毒（B.1 谱系）引起的，该病毒通过 APOBEC3 微进化衍生自西非流行的 A 谱系 1-3。在这里，谱系 B.1 病毒与其最接近的早期 A.1 祖先的比较表明，尽管只有 46 个核苷酸差异，但谱系 B.1 具有减弱的表型变化。两种病毒在细胞培养物中复制效果相同，但 B.1 在远距离传播方面存在缺陷，这与 OPG057 (F13L) 中的 APOBEC3 突变 E353K 相对应。 MPXV B.1 在先天免疫控制方面也存在缺陷，会诱导较高的 IFNβ 和先天免疫信号基因表达，并表现出抑制白细胞介素 1β 介导的反应的能力降低，这与 OPG047 (F3L) 中的 APOBEC3 突变 R48C 相关。最后，相对于祖先 A.1 毒株，MPXV B.1 在 MPXV 感染小鼠模型中的毒力降低。我们的工作表明，2022 年全球爆发的 MPXV 本质上是减毒的，其减毒突变在同时发生的更严重的 IIb 分支爆发中并不存在。我们的数据还表明，APOBEC3 编辑是 MPXV 表型变异的一种机制，可能有助于进化枝的进化和竞争。

title: Heart rate control by listening to light
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The auditory-cardiac interplay enables sound perception to modulate cardiac rhythm and homeostasis. However, its underlying regulatory mechanism and therapeutic potential remain largely underexplored, due to fundamental limitations in acoustic stimulation precision. Here we present an opto-mechano-cardiac coupling strategy that bypasses the propagation constraints of sound wave to enable precise acoustic modulation of cardiac function. Utilizing dynamically reconfigurable optical traps (1064 nm, 100 kHz refresh rate), we translated musical rhythms into programmable otolith oscillation patterns, thus establishing deterministic input-output relationships between mechanical stimulation and cardiac responses. We found that hindbrain areas, primarily the vagal motor area, mediate this opto-mechano-cardiac modulation, through adrenergic activation and a shift in the balance between sympathetic and parasympathetic activity. Leveraging real-time rhythm transcoding, we precisely quantified the modulation capabilities of auditory stimuli with distinct spectral composition on cardiac rhythm, and successfully rescued the drug-induced pathological cardiac rhythm disorders. By bridging optical physics and autonomic cardiac physiology via optomechanical otolith oscillation, this work establishes a mechanistic framework to explore sensory-cardiac modulation and personalized arrhythmia management, paving the way for advancing music therapy from empirical practice to quantitative biomedicine.
title_zh: 通过听光控制心率
abstract_zh: 听觉与心脏的相互作用使声音感知能够调节心律和体内平衡。然而，由于声刺激精度的根本限制，其潜在的调节机制和治疗潜力在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。在这里，我们提出了一种光-机械-心脏耦合策略，该策略绕过声波的传播限制，从而实现心脏功能的精确声学调制。利用动态可重构光陷阱（1064 nm，100 kHz 刷新率），我们将音乐节奏转化为可编程耳石振荡模式，从而在机械刺激和心脏反应之间建立确定性的输入输出关系。我们发现后脑区域，主要是迷走神经运动区域，通过肾上腺素能激活以及交感神经和副交感神经活动之间平衡的转变来介导这种光机械心脏调节。利用实时节律转码，我们精确量化了具有不同频谱成分的听觉刺激对心律的调制能力，并成功挽救了药物引起的病理性心律紊乱。这项工作通过光机械耳石振荡连接光学物理学和自主心脏生理学，建立了一个探索感觉心脏调节和个性化心律失常管理的机械框架，为推进音乐治疗从经验实践到定量生物医学铺平了道路。

title: Synchronous Holocene thinning of Pine Island Glacier and its tributaries influenced by ice-shelf unpinning
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Glaciers in Antarctica’s Amundsen Sea sector are retreating and thinning due to warm ocean inflow beneath ice shelves that buttress (restrain) glacier flow, but their future trajectory and implications for ice-mass loss remain uncertain. Here we present detailed cosmogenic-nuclide exposure-age data from the Hudson Mountains that document concerted thinning of Pine Island Glacier and its tributaries 8–5 ka. We contextualise this thinning using numerical ice-sheet modelling of the last deglaciation to link grounding-line dynamics and thinning characteristics. The model reconstructions attribute pauses in overall rapid thinning to ice-shelf pinning on bedrock highs, underscoring the importance of such features for ice-shelf stabilisation. Ice-flow paths from the sample sites all converge in the same grounding/calving-line region throughout the deglaciation, implying a common buttressing history and response to marine-grounding-line retreat that propagated upstream, controlling thinning. Our results support a key role for ice-shelf buttressing in influencing ice-sheet thinning in this region through the Holocene and into the future.
title_zh: 冰架解钉影响松岛冰川及其支流同步全新世变薄
abstract_zh: 由于冰架下温暖的海洋流入支撑（抑制）冰川流动，南极洲阿蒙森海区的冰川正在退缩和变薄，但其未来的轨迹和对冰块损失的影响仍不确定。在这里，我们提供来自哈德逊山脉的详细宇宙成因核素暴露年龄数据，记录了松岛冰川及其支流 8-5 ka 的一致变薄。我们使用上次冰消期的数值冰盖模型将这种减薄联系起来，以将接地线动力学和减薄特征联系起来。模型重建将整体快速变薄的暂停归因于基岩高点上的冰架钉扎，强调了此类特征对于冰架稳定的重要性。在整个冰消过程中，来自样本点的冰流路径都汇聚在同一接地/崩解线区域，这意味着共同的支撑历史和对向上游传播的海洋接地线退缩的反应，从而控制了冰消减。我们的研究结果支持冰架支撑在影响该地区从全新世到未来的冰盖减薄方面发挥着关键作用。

title: Cycloaddition-Based Retrosynthetic Logic for the Diversification and Molecular Editing of Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons
source: Chemical Reviews: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Expanding the chemical and structural diversity of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) represents a significant aspirational goal in organic chemistry, materials science, and chemical biology, as it enables precise modulation of their molecular properties for a wide range of applications. Conventional approaches to PAH diversification typically rely on lengthy multistep sequences involving prefunctionalized aromatic substrates and strong oxidants, which limits efficiency and substrate generality. In contrast, retrosynthetic disconnection strategies based on cycloaddition–cycloreversion (retro-cycloaddition) or cycloaddition–rearomatization processes offer a conceptually distinct and streamlined approach to PAH construction and modification. These methods enable atom- and step-economical transformations directly from simple, unfunctionalized PAH templates, thereby circumventing the need for preinstalled functional groups. Recent advances have demonstrated that such disconnection strategies enable diverse transformations, including regioselective PAH growth via bay-, M- and L-region annulative π-extension (APEX) reactions, K-region aza-APEX reactions, formal C–H amination, ring-expansion through dearomative atom insertion, and π-extension via two-carbon fragment exchange. This review summarizes these developments and highlights the emerging potential of cycloaddition-based retrosynthetic logic as a unifying platform for the diversification and molecular editing of PAHs.
title_zh: 基于环加成的多环芳烃多样化和分子编辑逆合成逻辑
abstract_zh: 摘要 扩大多环芳烃 (PAH) 的化学和结构多样性是有机化学、材料科学和化学生物学领域的一个重要的理想目标，因为它能够精确调节其分子特性，以适应广泛的应用。 PAH 多样化的传统方法通常依赖于涉及预官能化芳香族底物和强氧化剂的冗长的多步骤序列，这限制了效率和底物通用性。相比之下，基于环加成-环化回复（逆环加成）或环加成-重芳构化过程的逆合成断开策略为 PAH 构建和修饰提供了概念上独特且简化的方法。这些方法能够直接从简单的非功能化 PAH 模板进行原子和步骤经济的转化，从而避免了对预装官能团的需要。最近的进展表明，这种断开策略可以实现多种转化，包括通过湾区、M区和L区环状π延伸(APEX)反应实现区域选择性PAH生长、K区氮杂-APEX反应、正式C-H胺化、通过脱芳香原子插入实现环扩张，以及通过两碳片段交换实现π延伸。本综述总结了这些进展，并强调了基于环加成的逆合成逻辑作为 PAH 多样化和分子编辑的统一平台的新兴潜力。

title: Disentangling surface and bulk properties of Ta3N5 photoanodes
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Understanding how material and defect characteristics govern photoelectrochemical performance is essential for developing efficient and stable photoelectrodes. Although bulk properties are often emphasized, surfaces and interfaces can equally determine activity and stability under operation. Here, we use depth-sensitive characterization to disentangle surface and bulk properties of Ta3N5 thin films. By preparing photoelectrodes from TaOx, TaNx, and Ta precursors, we systematically vary shallow and deep-level defect concentrations. Structural, compositional, and optoelectronic analyses show that the surfaces consistently exhibit oxygen enrichment, increased structural disorder, and higher deep-level defect densities than the bulk. However, the specific surface structure and its spatial extent depend strongly on precursor chemistry. Ta3N5 derived from TaOx forms an extended, amorphous, oxide-rich surface with fewer deep-level defects, whereas TaNx and Ta-derived Ta3N5 films exhibit thinner, more crystalline surfaces with increased mid-gap defect densities. A brief hydrofluoric acid treatment removes the disordered surface layer, improving crystallinity and hydrophilicity and enhancing photoelectrochemical performance and stability for ferrocyanide oxidation. These results highlight interfacial and defect engineering as routes toward durable, high-efficiency Ta3N5 photoelectrodes.
title_zh: 解开 Ta3N5 光阳极的表面和体特性
abstract_zh: 了解材料和缺陷特性如何控制光电化学性能对于开发高效稳定的光电极至关重要。尽管经常强调体积特性，但表面和界面同样可以决定操作下的活性和稳定性。在这里，我们使用深度敏感表征来解开 Ta3N5 薄膜的表面和体特性。通过用 TaOx、TaNx 和 Ta 前驱体制备光电极，我们系统地改变浅层和深层缺陷浓度。结构、成分和光电分析表明，表面始终表现出比本体更高的氧富集、结构无序性增加和更高的深层缺陷密度。然而，特定的表面结构及其空间范围很大程度上取决于前体化学。源自 TaOx 的 Ta3N5 形成扩展的、非晶的、富含氧化物的表面，具有较少的深层缺陷，而 TaNx 和 Ta 衍生的 Ta3N5 薄膜表现出更薄、更多的结晶表面，并增加了中间带隙缺陷密度。短暂的氢氟酸处理可去除无序的表面层，提高结晶度和亲水性，并增强亚铁氰化物氧化的光电化学性能和稳定性。这些结果强调了界面和缺陷工程是实现耐用、高效 Ta3N5 光电极的途径。

title: Artificial Photosynthetic Hydrogel Microspheres as a Versatile Platform for Programmable CO2 Valorization
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Carbon-negative biomanufacturing is essential for global sustainability. Artificial photosynthesis based on material-microbe hybrid systems holds promise but suffers from inefficient energy supply, phototoxicity, abiotic–biotic incompatibility, and limited product spectrum. Here, we present artificial photosynthetic hydrogel microspheres (APHM) as a versatile platform for efficient and programmable CO2 valorization. Within an alginate/carboxymethyl cellulose hydrogel matrix, spatial compartmentalization integrated a COF/Pt/Cr2O3 photocatalyst (for in situ hydrogen evolution) and a light-shielded acetogen (Acetobacterium woodii) in a tailored bifunctional medium, enabling CO2-to-acetate conversion. The system operated stably under high-intensity illumination (60 mW cm–2), achieving a near-stoichiometric H2-to-acetate coupling efficiency of 88.85%. The resulting acetate served as a well-defined carbon hub, enabling seamless interface with engineered yeast for programmable synthesis of diverse products, including glucose (316 mg L–1), myo-inositol (64 mg L–1), glucosamine (24 mg L–1), sucrose (609 mg L–1), and starch (256 mg L–1). Overall, this work presents a universal, efficient route to versatile solar-to-chemical synthesis.
title_zh: 人工光合水凝胶微球作为可编程二氧化碳增值的多功能平台
abstract_zh: 摘要 负碳生物制造对于全球可持续发展至关重要。基于材料-微生物混合系统的人工光合作用前景广阔，但面临能源供应效率低下、光毒性、非生物-生物不相容性和产品谱有限等问题。在这里，我们提出人工光合水凝胶微球（APHM）作为高效和可编程二氧化碳增值的多功能平台。在藻酸盐/羧甲基纤维素水凝胶基质内，空间分隔将 COF/Pt/Cr2O3 光催化剂（用于原位析氢）和遮光产乙酸菌（伍氏醋杆菌）集成在定制的双功能介质中，从而实现 CO2 向乙酸的转化。该系统在高强度照明（60 mW cm-2）下稳定运行，实现了 88.85% 的接近化学计量的 H2 与乙酸盐的耦合效率。由此产生的醋酸盐作为明确的碳中心，能够与工程酵母无缝连接，以可编程合成不同的产品，包括葡萄糖 (316 mg L–1)、肌醇 (64 mg L–1)、葡萄糖胺 (24 mg L–1)、蔗糖 (609 mg L–1) 和淀粉 (256 mg L–1)。总的来说，这项工作为多功能太阳能化学合成提供了一条通用、有效的途径。

title: Healing intervention for improving the efficiency and stability of tandem devices on industrial textured silicon
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Monolithic perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells are widely regarded as the next-generation, low-cost, high-efficiency photovoltaic technology. However, achieving high-quality wide-bandgap perovskite top cells on industrial textured silicon, particularly using hybrid two-step deposition methods that combine sequential co-evaporation and solution processing, remains a major challenge. In this work, we introduce a healing intervention strategy that significantly tailors perovskite film growth and enhances the film quality on textured silicon substrates. By applying an MASCN solution to heal the as-prepared films, which induces secondary crystal growth to enhance overall perovskite crystallization, we obtain a conformal perovskite layer characterized by columnar grains that extend through the full film thickness. The resulting 1.68 eV wide-bandgap perovskite solar cells achieve a champion efficiency of 21.1%, contributing to a certified stabilized tandem efficiency of 30.77% and an impressive Voc of 1.915 V over an active area of 1.164 cm². Notably, an encapsulated device retains its initial performance after 3400 hours of continuous maximum power point tracking under one-sun illumination in ambient conditions, representing the excellent stability in perovskite/silicon tandem cells reported to date.
title_zh: 用于提高工业织构硅上串联器件的效率和稳定性的修复干预
abstract_zh: 单片钙钛矿/硅串联太阳能电池被广泛认为是下一代、低成本、高效率的光伏技术。然而，在工业织构硅上实现高质量的宽带隙钙钛矿顶部电池，特别是使用结合顺序共蒸发和溶液处理的混合两步沉积方法，仍然是一个重大挑战。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种修复干预策略，可以显着调整钙钛矿薄膜的生长并提高纹理硅基板上的薄膜质量。通过应用 MASCN 溶液来修复所制备的薄膜，从而诱导二次晶体生长以增强整体钙钛矿结晶，我们获得了保形钙钛矿层，其特征是柱状晶粒延伸穿过整个薄膜厚度。由此产生的 1.68 eV 宽带隙钙钛矿太阳能电池实现了 21.1% 的冠军效率，在 1.164 cm² 的有源面积上实现了 30.77% 的认证稳定串联效率和 1.915 V 的令人印象深刻的 Voc。值得注意的是，在环境条件下的一个太阳照明下，封装器件在连续最大功率点跟踪 3400 小时后仍保持其初始性能，这代表了迄今为止报道的钙钛矿/硅串联电池的优异稳定性。

title: SynComs should be rigorously defined, not renamed
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Koch et al. propose replacing “synthetic microbial communities (SynComs)” with “defined microbial communities”. We argue that this substitution obscures the design-driven logic of SynCom research, and that the field needs clearer conceptual classification rather than a broader renaming of SynComs.
title_zh: SynCom 应该被严格定义，而不是重命名
abstract_zh: 科赫等人。建议用“定义的微生物群落”取代“合成微生物群落（SynComs）”。我们认为，这种替代模糊了 SynCom 研究的设计驱动逻辑，并且该领域需要更清晰的概念分类，而不是对 SynCom 进行更广泛的重命名。

title: In vitro reconstitution of chromatin replication recapitulates symmetric histone recycling
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Symmetric histone recycling is vital for maintaining epigenetic inheritance upon eukaryotic DNA replication. Recent genome-wide studies have uncovered key determinants of this process, but how these factors collectively support parental histone transfer remains incompletely understood. Here, we successfully reconstitute histone recycling with 24 purified proteins and analyze the products digested by Micrococcal nuclease with Repli-pore-seq, the newly developed pipeline combining nanopore sequencing and deep-learning-based classification. As a result, we identify histones symmetrically recycled as tetrasomes or hexasomes on nucleosome-favorable sequences. We also observe the discordance of the recycled position between lagging and leading strands on the GC-rich DNA sequences. Moreover, removal of Pol δ, Pol32, Dpb3/4, Ctf4, Csm3/Tof1, or Mrc1 disrupts the balance of histone recycling between the two daughter strands, whereas removal of Ctf4, Csm3/Tof1, or Mrc1 additionally alters the positions at which histones were recycled. Furthermore, addition of the lagging-strand maturation factors Fen1 and Cdc9 enhances histone recycling to the lagging strand. These findings provide critical insights into the molecular players and mechanisms underlying symmetric histone recycling.
title_zh: 染色质复制的体外重建概括了对称组蛋白回收
abstract_zh: 对称组蛋白回收对于维持真核 DNA 复制时的表观遗传至关重要。最近的全基因组研究发现了这一过程的关键决定因素，但这些因素如何共同支持亲本组蛋白转移仍不完全清楚。在这里，我们成功地用 24 种纯化蛋白重建组蛋白回收，并使用 Repli-pore-seq（新开发的结合纳米孔测序和基于深度学习的分类的管道）分析微球菌核酸酶消化的产物。结果，我们鉴定出在核小体有利序列上对称回收的组蛋白作为四体或六体。我们还观察到富含 GC 的 DNA 序列上滞后链和前导链之间的回收位置不一致。此外，去除 Pol δ、Pol32、Dpb3/4、Ctf4、Csm3/Tof1 或 Mrc1 会破坏两条子链之间的组蛋白回收平衡，而去除 Ctf4、Csm3/Tof1 或 Mrc1 还会另外改变组蛋白回收的位置。此外，添加滞后链成熟因子 Fen1 和 Cdc9 增强了组蛋白对滞后链的再循环。这些发现为对称组蛋白回收的分子参与者和机制提供了重要的见解。

title: Counterintuitive collision of exceptional points on nonorientable manifolds
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Band degeneracies, from Hermitian Dirac points to non-Hermitian exceptional points (EPs), are central to topological physics. Beyond individual topology, their interactions yield richer phenomena—such as non-annihilating collisions of pairwise-created point degeneracies, previously thought to occur only in non-Abelian multiband systems. Here, we theoretically and experimentally demonstrate that such nontrivial collisions can arise even in simple two-band Abelian systems, enabled by the nonorientability of momentum-space manifolds. By designing a mixed-dimensional non-Hermitian acoustic lattice, we measure two independent yet complementary topological invariants—band braid and Berry phase—to unambiguously show that two EPs, pairwise created from a hybrid point, merge into a distinct vortex point upon re-encounter, instead of annihilating. Using a path-squeezing criterion, we further confirm the underlying mechanism for such counterintiuitive collision: the braid charge of an EP inverts upon traversing a nonorientable boundary. Our findings identify the geometric nonorientability as a new arena for engineering interactions of band degeneracies, and pave the way for further exploring exceptional topology on nonorientable manifolds.
title_zh: 不可定向流形上异常点的反直觉碰撞
abstract_zh: 从厄米狄拉克点到非厄米特例外点（EP）的能带简并是拓扑物理学的核心。除了个体拓扑之外，它们的相互作用产生了更丰富的现象，例如成对创建的点简并的非湮灭碰撞，以前认为这种现象只发生在非阿贝尔多带系统中。在这里，我们从理论上和实验上证明，即使在简单的双带阿贝尔系统中，由于动量空间流形的不可定向性，这种非平凡的碰撞也可能发生。通过设计混合维非厄米特声晶格，我们测量了两个独立但互补的拓扑不变量——带状辫状体和贝里相——以明确地表明，从混合点成对创建的两个EP在重新相遇时合并成一个不同的涡旋点，而不是湮灭。使用路径压缩准则，我们进一步确认了这种违反直觉的碰撞的基本机制：EP 的编织电荷在穿过不可定向边界时反转。我们的研究结果将几何不可定向性确定为能带简并工程相互作用的新领域，并为进一步探索不可定向流形上的特殊拓扑铺平了道路。

title: Segment any tumour: an uncertainty-aware vision foundation model for whole-body analysis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Prompt-driven vision foundation models, such as the Segment Anything Model, have shown adaptability in computer vision, but their use in medical imaging remains challenging due to heterogeneous anatomy, artefacts, and low-contrast tumour boundaries. This is particularly difficult in whole-body tumour analysis, where models must transfer across modalities, anatomies, and tumour appearances. Here, we present Segment Any Tumour 3D (SAT3D), a lightweight volumetric foundation model for generalisable tumour segmentation across diverse medical imaging modalities, organs, and cohorts. SAT3D integrates a shifted-window vision transformer with critic-guided uncertainty-aware training, using confidence maps as dense prompts to guide boundary prediction in ambiguous regions. We benchmark SAT3D against vision foundation models, prompt-driven and task-specific methods across 11 public datasets. Trained on 17,075 three-dimensional volume-mask pairs, SAT3D shows robust generalisation, including in out-of-distribution settings, and is supported by a 3D-Slicer plugin for interactive segmentation, underscoring SAT3D’s potential as a scalable foundation model for medical image analysis.
title_zh: 分割任何肿瘤：用于全身分析的不确定性感知视觉基础模型
abstract_zh: 即时驱动的视觉基础模型（例如分段任意模型）已显示出在计算机视觉中的适应性，但由于异质解剖结构、伪影和低对比度肿瘤边界，它们在医学成像中的使用仍然具有挑战性。这在全身肿瘤分析中尤其困难，其中模型必须跨模式、解剖结构和肿瘤外观进行转移。在这里，我们提出了 Segment Any Tumor 3D (SAT3D)，这是一种轻量级体积基础模型，用于跨不同医学成像模式、器官和队列的通用肿瘤分割。 SAT3D 将平移窗口视觉变换器与评论家引导的不确定性感知训练相结合，使用置信图作为密集提示来指导模糊区域的边界预测。我们针对 11 个公共数据集的视觉基础模型、提示驱动和特定于任务的方法对 SAT3D 进行基准测试。 SAT3D 在 17,075 个三维体积掩模对上进行训练，显示出强大的泛化能力，包括在分布外设置中，并由用于交互式分割的 3D-Slicer 插件支持，强调了 SAT3D 作为医学图像分析的可扩展基础模型的潜力。

title: Ultra-broadband anti-jamming communication via a Rydberg atomic receiver
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Ultra-broadband anti-jamming communication can support secure information transfer through spread-spectrum techniques that resist interference and interception. Waveguide-coupled Rydberg atoms enable ultra-broadband spectrum sensing without conventional RF front-end components. This framework provides an experimental platform for ultra-wide anti-jamming communication. Here we demonstrate real-time signal demodulation based on frequency-hopping spread spectrum (FHSS) in a waveguide-coupled Rydberg receiver, achieving frequency hopping across 100 kHz to 20 GHz and a maximum hopping rate of 100 khop/s. Within the 2.4 GHz ISM band, our system achieves a channel density of ~ 8 channels per MHz. Beyond this, by leveraging its ultra-broad and continuous bandwidth, the system supports over 150,000 channels. Experimental results show a 51 dB improvement in narrowband interference tolerance compared with single-frequency systems, confirming its strong anti-jamming capability. The reported system demonstrates potential for secure communications based on quantum technology, particularly in complex electromagnetic environments.
title_zh: 通过里德堡原子接收器进行超宽带抗干扰通信
