title: Evolution of human IL4I1 preference for aromatic amino acids from a broad-specificity L-amino acid oxidase ancestor
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: IL4I1, a human L-amino acid oxidase (LAAO), has drawn considerable interest for its role in catabolism with implications for cancer biology and immune modulation. The function and activity of this enzyme in humans contrast with the cytotoxic effects exerted by LAAOs from snake venoms. The inherent instability of IL4I1 has hindered detailed biochemical characterization and its exploration as a drug target. In this study, we present a comprehensive biochemical and structural investigation of tetrapod LAAOs, with a focus on human IL4I1 and its evolutionary relationship to venomous snake proteins. By exploiting ancestral sequence reconstruction, we inferred, expressed, and characterized the tetrapodal ancestral LAAO and mammalian ancestral IL4I1 and compared their properties to recombinant human IL4I1 purified from human cells. The tetrapodal ancestor displays a broad substrate profile, acting on hydrophobic, polar, and positively charged amino acids, whereas human IL4I1 prefers aromatic amino acids. Guided by crystal structures, we engineered eight ancestral protein variants to mimic mammalian- and snake-like active site configurations. Kinetic analyses of these variants reveal distinct evolutionary trajectories: one leading to the high-activity venomous LAAOs of reptiles, and another to the aromatic-selective IL4I1 of mammals. Overall, our findings demonstrate that the functional divergence between human IL4I1 and venomous snake LAAOs is underpinned by evolutionary shifts in substrate specificity and catalytic efficiency.
title_zh: 人类 IL4I1 对芳香族氨基酸的偏好从广泛特异性 L-氨基酸氧化酶祖先的进化
abstract_zh: IL4I1 是一种人类 L-氨基酸氧化酶 (LAAO)，因其在分解代谢中的作用（对癌症生物学和免疫调节具有影响）而引起了人们极大的兴趣。这种酶在人体中的功能和活性与蛇毒中 LAAO 所产生的细胞毒性作用形成鲜明对比。 IL4I1 固有的不稳定性阻碍了详细的生化表征及其作为药物靶点的探索。在这项研究中，我们对四足动物 LAAO 进行了全面的生化和结构研究，重点关注人类 IL4I1 及其与毒蛇蛋白的进化关系。通过利用祖先序列重建，我们推断、表达和表征了四足祖先 LAAO 和哺乳动物祖先 IL4I1，并将它们的特性与从人类细胞纯化的重组人 IL4I1 进行了比较。四足动物祖先表现出广泛的底物特征，作用于疏水性、极性和带正电的氨基酸，而人 IL4I1 更喜欢芳香族氨基酸。在晶体结构的指导下，我们设计了八种祖先蛋白质变体来模仿哺乳动物和蛇样的活性位点配置。这些变体的动力学分析揭示了不同的进化轨迹：一个导致爬行动物的高活性有毒 LAAO，另一个导致哺乳动物的芳香选择性 IL4I1。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明，人类 IL4I1 和毒蛇 LAAO 之间的功能差异是由底物特异性和催化效率的进化变化所支撑的。

title: Petermann Glacier on the brink: Progress, challenges and insights
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Petermann Glacier (PG), the largest marine-terminating glacier in northern Greenland based on catchment area and ice discharge, plays a key role in modulating ice export from the Greenland Ice Sheet (GrIS). With an upstream catchment connected to the GrIS interior via a deep subglacial canyon, its future stability has major implications for sea level rise. This review synthesizes recent advances in understanding PG’s dynamics across three critical interfaces. At the surface, reanalysis data and regional climate models diverge from observations in estimates of air temperature and surface mass balance, underscoring the need for improved in situ data and models. At the ocean boundary, enhanced basal melting driven by subglacial runoff and Atlantic water intrusions is identified as dominant driver of recent mass loss of PG, with continued warming posing a serious threat to the stability of the floating tongue. At the bed, geophysical synthesis reveals complex geology, likely spatial variability in geothermal heat flux, and the megacanyon’s influence on seasonal hydrology and velocity fluctuations. An ongoing rifting event, initiated in September 2025, highlights PG’s vulnerability. The anticipated retreat reduces buttressing and brings the terminus closer to the grounding zone, where additional calving could trigger retreat and accelerate ice discharge. As one of Greenland’s largest floating ice tongues, PG may provide important insights into the stability of other marine-terminating glaciers across the GrIS. Improved observations, sustained monitoring of oceanographic and atmospheric parameters, and high-resolution modeling are critical for constraining projections of PG’s future and its role in GrIS stability.
title_zh: 濒临边缘的彼得曼冰川：进展、挑战和见解
abstract_zh: 彼得曼冰川（PG）是格陵兰岛北部最大的海洋终止冰川（根据集水面积和冰排放量），在调节格陵兰冰盖（GrIS）的冰输出方面发挥着关键作用。由于上游流域通过冰下峡谷与 GrIS 内部相连，其未来的稳定性对海平面上升具有重大影响。这篇综述综合了理解 PG 跨三个关键界面动态的最新进展。在地表，再分析数据和区域气候模型与气温和地表质量平衡估计的观测结果存在差异，这凸显了改进现场数据和模型的必要性。在海洋边界，由冰下径流和大西洋水入侵驱动的基底融化增强被认为是近期PG质量损失的主要驱动因素，而持续变暖对浮舌的稳定性构成严重威胁。在河床上，地球物理综合揭示了复杂的地质情况、地热热通量的可能空间变化以及大峡谷对季节性水文和速度波动的影响。 2025 年 9 月发起的一场持续的裂痕事件凸显了 PG 的脆弱性。预期的撤退减少了支撑，并使终点更接近接地区，在那里额外的崩解可能会引发撤退并加速冰的排放。作为格陵兰岛最大的浮冰舌之一，PG 可能为了解格陵兰岛其他海洋终止冰川的稳定性提供重要见解。改进观测，持续监测海洋和大气

title: Antenna photosystem I remodeling in the iron stress–induced complex from Anabaena sp. PCC 7120
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
The structure and oligomeric states of the photosystem I–iron stress–induced protein A (PSI-IsiA) supercomplex from several species have been investigated using cryo–electron microscopy (cryo-EM) and atomic force microscopy. The cryo-EM structure of the PSI-IsiA complex from cyanobacterium
                    Anabaena sp. PCC 7120
                    (7120) has been published previously. However, not all IsiA and PSI subunits were identified. In this work, we have structurally and spectroscopically characterized the PSI-IsiA supercomplex from 7120 using single-particle cryo-EM at a resolution of 2.2 angstroms. The data resolved all individual IsiA and PSI subunits, highlighting features that distinguish the 7120 PSI-IsiA from other complexes, including additional IsiA and a unique PsaK subunit specific for PSI-IsiA. Time-resolved fluorescence spectroscopy showed tight energetic coupling of IsiA to PSI, which may play a role in lowering antenna fluorescence yield and increasing the efficiency of energy transfer. This work extends the scope of PSI cellular remodeling in response to different stress conditions.
title_zh: 鱼腥藻铁胁迫诱导复合物中天线光系统 I 的重塑。 PCC 7120
abstract_zh:
使用冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 和原子力显微镜研究了多个物种的光系统 I-铁应激诱导蛋白 A (PSI-IsiA) 超复合物的结构和寡聚状态。蓝藻 PSI-IsiA 复合物的冷冻电镜结构
                    鱼腥藻属PCC 7120
                    (7120) 之前已发布。然而，并未识别出所有 IsiA 和 PSI 亚基。在这项工作中，我们使用单粒子冷冻电镜以 2.2 埃的分辨率对 7120 的 PSI-IsiA 超复合物进行了结构和光谱表征。该数据解析了所有单独的 IsiA 和 PSI 亚基，突出显示了 7120 PSI-IsiA 与其他复合物的区别特征，包括额外的 IsiA 和 PSI-IsiA 特有的独特 PsaK 亚基。时间分辨荧光光谱显示IsiA与PSI存在紧密的能量耦合，这可能在降低天线荧光产率和提高能量转移效率方面发挥作用。这项工作扩展了 PSI 细胞重塑的范围，以响应不同的应激条件。

title: Direct bacterial transcript visualization illuminates spatiotemporal environmental adaptation of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in the lung
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Spatiotemporal environmental variation results in marked heterogeneity in bacterial infection progression and disease outcome, with vital consequences for treatment success. For the globally important pathogen
                    Mycobacterium tuberculosis
                    (Mtb), while the pronounced intra-host spatial heterogeneity in lesion immune cell composition and phenotype has been well-described, the highly complex Mtb cell envelope has presented a particular challenge for the required equivalent insight into bacterial heterogeneity. Here, we develop hybridization chain reaction-fluorescence in situ hybridization (HCR-FISH)-based methodology for Mtb mRNA visualization in the context of intact lung and lesion architecture. In combination with an Mtb transcriptional/translational activity reporter, we reveal spatiotemporal differences in gene expression relating to Mtb lipid metabolism, response to key environmental signals, and the ESX-1 type VII secretion system. Our results establish a framework for in situ analysis of Mtb mRNA, opening the path to elucidating critical bacterial drivers that underlie the marked heterogeneity in Mtb-host interactions.
title_zh: 直接细菌转录本可视化阐明了肺结核分枝杆菌的时空环境适应
abstract_zh:
时空环境变化导致细菌感染进展和疾病结果的显着异质性，对治疗成功产生重大影响。对于全球重要的病原体
                    结核分枝杆菌
                    (Mtb)，虽然病变免疫细胞组成和表型中明显的宿主内空间异质性已经得到很好的描述，但高度复杂的 Mtb 细胞包膜对对细菌异质性所需的同等洞察力提出了特殊的挑战。在这里，我们开发了基于杂交链式反应-荧光原位杂交 (HCR-FISH) 的方法，用于在完整的肺和病变结构的背景下实现 Mtb mRNA 可视化。与 Mtb 转录/翻译活性报告基因相结合，我们揭示了与 Mtb 脂质代谢、对关键环境信号的响应以及 ESX-1 VII 型分泌系统相关的基因表达的时空差异。我们的结果建立了 Mtb mRNA 原位分析框架，为阐明 Mtb-宿主相互作用中显着异质性的关键细菌驱动因素开辟了道路。

title: aDISCO: A clearing method to enable 3D microscopy of large archival paraffin-embedded human tissue blocks
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Human surgery and autopsy specimens are routinely stored as formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissue blocks for decades, creating vast archives of healthy and diseased tissues. While tissue clearing and whole-mount microscopy enable 3D analysis, FFPE human tissue blocks are often unsuitable for clearing and immunolabeling due to their large size and extensive cross-linking. Here, we introduce “archival” DISCO (aDISCO), a clearing method designed to overcome these challenges. aDISCO achieves effective clearing and immunolabeling of large samples stored for 15 years or more. We applied aDISCO to human brain, spinal cord, peripheral nerve, skin, muscle, heart, kidney, liver, spleen, colon, and lung, using a broad range of antibodies. Combining aDISCO with deep learning–based analysis to study focal cortical dysplasia (FCD), we found disrupted cortical layering with both focal and global neuronal density variations, features likely to be overlooked by conventional histology. In summary, aDISCO delivers datasets suitable for deep learning–based processing, enabling the detection of subtle and sparse pathologies in large archival human tissue specimens.
title_zh: aDISCO：一种透明方法，可对大型档案石蜡包埋的人体组织块进行 3D 显微镜检查
abstract_zh: 人体手术和尸检标本通常以福尔马林固定石蜡包埋 (FFPE) 组织块的形式保存数十年，形成大量健康和患病组织档案。虽然组织透明化和整体显微镜可以实现 3D 分析，但 FFPE 人体组织块由于尺寸大且交联广泛，通常不适合透明化和免疫标记。在这里，我们介绍“档案”DISCO（aDISCO），这是一种旨在克服这些挑战的清算方法。 aDISCO实现了对储存15年或更长时间的大样本的有效清除和免疫标记。我们使用多种抗体将 aDISCO 应用于人脑、脊髓、周围神经、皮肤、肌肉、心脏、肾脏、肝脏、脾脏、结肠和肺。将 aDISCO 与基于深度学习的分析相结合来研究局灶性皮质发育不良 (FCD)，我们发现局灶性和整体神经元密度变化的皮质分层被破坏，这些特征可能被传统组织学忽视。总之，aDISCO 提供适合基于深度学习的处理的数据集，能够检测大型档案人体组织标本中微妙且稀疏的病理。

title: A transcription factor TOE3 simultaneously promotes growth and antiviral immunity by disrupting ABA core module in tobacco
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Plant immune activation often reduces growth, which is defined as “growth-defense trade-off” (GDT). Uncoupling GDT is promising for breeding of elite cultivars with strong growth and immunity. We previously identified that AP2 transcription factor TARGET OF EARLY3 (TOE3) promotes both growth and antiviral defense. However, the mechanism underlying this GDT uncoupling remains unknown. Here, we find that the amino-terminal domain of TOE3 (T3N) inhibits abscisic acid (ABA) signaling. Mechanistically, T3N binds to an ABA receptor PYL4 to interfere with PYL4-PP2C4 interaction. The PYL4-PP2C4 module regulates tobacco growth and antiviral immunity. Thus, under normal conditions, T3N enhances tobacco growth via down-regulating ABA response. Upon TMV infection, the phosphorylation of T3N is induced. Phosphorylated T3N exhibits stronger binding affinity to PYL4 to further amplify its disruptive effect on PYL4-PP2C4 module and strongly block ABA response, thereby boosting antiviral immunity. These findings reveal how TOE3 uncouples GDT to provide strategies for breeding crops with strong growth and antiviral immunity.
title_zh: 转录因子 TOE3 通过破坏烟草中的 ABA 核心模块同时促进生长和抗病毒免疫
abstract_zh: 植物免疫激活通常会抑制生长，这被定义为“生长-防御权衡”（GDT）。解偶联GDT有望培育出生长力强、免疫力强的优良品种。我们之前发现 AP2 转录因子 TARGET OF EARLY3 (TOE3) 可促进生长和抗病毒防御。然而，这种 GDT 解偶联的机制仍然未知。在这里，我们发现 TOE3 (T3N) 的氨基末端结构域抑制脱落酸 (ABA) 信号传导。从机制上讲，T3N 与 ABA 受体 PYL4 结合，干扰 PYL4-PP2C4 相互作用。 PYL4-PP2C4 模块调节烟草生长和抗病毒免疫。因此，在正常条件下，T3N 通过下调 ABA 反应来促进烟草生长。 TMV 感染后，T3N 磷酸化被诱导。磷酸化的T3N对PYL4表现出更强的结合亲和力，进一步放大其对PYL4-PP2C4模块的破坏作用，并强烈阻断ABA反应，从而增强抗病毒免疫力。这些发现揭示了 TOE3 如何解偶联 GDT，从而为培育具有强生长和抗病毒免疫力的作物提供策略。

title: Molecular basis of HACD-TECR complex mediated very-long-chain fatty acid elongation reveal a potential target in colorectal cancer
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Remodeling of fatty acid metabolism is increasingly recognized as a critical feature of tumor progression, yet the contribution of very long-chain fatty acid (VLCFA) remains incompletely understood. The elongation of VLCFAs, which is mediated by four consecutive enzymes in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER), has been implicated in tumor progression. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying VLCFA elongation enzymes and their specific contributions to tumorigenesis remain largely elusive. Here, we demonstrate that trans-2-enoyl-CoA reductase (TECR) is upregulated in colorectal cancer (CRC). Structural and biochemical analyses revealed a conserved catalytic mechanism for TECR-mediated trans-2-enoyl-CoA reduction. Moreover, we show that TECR forms a stable complex with 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydratase (HACD), to cooperatively drive VLCFA elongation. A unique U-shaped loop in HACD is critical for recognizing TECR. Disruption of the HACD–TECR interaction interface significantly suppresses CRC cell growth. Collectively, these findings elucidate the molecular mechanism of HACD–TECR-mediated VLCFA elongation and suggest a potential therapeutic strategy for CRC treatment by modulating VLCFA metabolism.
title_zh: HACD-TECR复合物介导的极长链脂肪酸延伸的分子基础揭示了结直肠癌的潜在靶点
abstract_zh: 人们越来越认识到脂肪酸代谢的重塑是肿瘤进展的一个关键特征，但极长链脂肪酸（VLCFA）的贡献仍不完全清楚。 VLCFA 的延长由内质网 (ER) 中的四种连续酶介导，与肿瘤进展有关。然而，VLCFA 延伸酶的分子机制及其对肿瘤发生的具体贡献仍然很大程度上难以捉摸。在这里，我们证明反式 2-烯酰辅酶 A 还原酶 (TECR) 在结直肠癌 (CRC) 中表达上调。结构和生化分析揭示了 TECR 介导的反式 2-烯酰辅酶 A 还原的保守催化机制。此外，我们发现 TECR 与 3-羟酰基辅酶 A 脱水酶 (HACD) 形成稳定的复合物，协同驱动 VLCFA 延伸。 HACD 中独特的 U 形环对于识别 TECR 至关重要。 HACD-TECR 相互作用界面的破坏可显着抑制 CRC 细胞的生长。总的来说，这些发现阐明了 HACD-TECR 介导的 VLCFA 延伸的分子机制，并提出了通过调节 VLCFA 代谢来治疗 CRC 的潜在治疗策略。

title: Interfacial amplifier: High-throughput visual protein detection via droplet dynamics
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Rapid, visual protein detection at ultralow cost remains a critical unmet need for scalable point-of-care testing. We introduce a high-throughput platform leveraging interfacial droplet dynamics on a slippery liquid-infused porous surface (SLIPS) to directly translate protein-specific adsorption into macroscopic behavior. Protein concentration and identity modulate the critical sliding angle of droplets via interfacial film formation, enabling pretreatment-free, instrument-free identification of clinically relevant targets like proteinuria within minutes. This approach achieves parallel analysis of 170 samples on a single A4-sized substrate (5 minutes, ∼$0.008 per sample), requiring only visual readout. By amplifying nanoscale interfacial interactions into intuitive visual outputs, our SLIPS-based technology establishes a scalable, user-friendly paradigm for decentralized diagnostics and continuous health monitoring across diverse settings.
title_zh: 界面放大器：通过液滴动力学进行高通量视觉蛋白质检测
abstract_zh: 以超低成本进行快速、可视化蛋白质检测仍然是可扩展的即时检测的一个关键的未满足需求。我们引入了一个高通量平台，利用光滑液体注入多孔表面（SLIPS）上的界面液滴动力学，将蛋白质特异性吸附直接转化为宏观行为。蛋白质浓度和身份通过界面膜的形成调节液滴的临界滑动角，从而无需预处理、无需仪器即可在几分钟内识别出蛋白尿等临床相关目标。该方法可在单个 A4 大小的基板上实现 170 个样品的并行分析（5 分钟，每个样品 ∼ $0.008），仅需要视觉读数。通过将纳米级界面相互作用放大为直观的视觉输出，我们基于 SLIPS 的技术建立了一个可扩展、用户友好的范例，用于跨不同设置的分散诊断和持续健康监测。

title: Fully dry-processed electrodes for highly reversible aqueous zinc powder-based batteries
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Aqueous zinc-ion batteries have advanced rapidly, but practical deployment is limited by excessive negative-to-positive (N/P) ratios (>50), decreasing the energy density. Zinc powder anodes can lower N/P, yet their high specific surface area accelerates parasitic reactions and shortens lifespan. Here we report a high-loading and highly reversible dry-processed zinc powder anode with a non-electrochemically driven solid-electrolyte interphase (SEI). The dry process retains a homogeneous distribution of a sodium phosphate SEI precursor throughout the anodes, triggering spontaneous formation of a zinc phosphate-based SEI upon electrolyte contact that suppresses hydrogen evolution and zinc corrosion. Coupling this anode with dry-processed cathodes (90 mg cm
                    −2
                    ; 12.5 mAh cm
                    −2
                    ) yields the fully dry-processed aqueous zinc battery. A pouch cell delivers 88.8% capacity retention after 530 cycles at N/P ∼ 3, outperforming prior zinc powder systems despite ∼20-fold higher cathode loadings and providing a scalable path to high-energy-density aqueous zinc batteries for practical grid-scale storage.
title_zh: 用于高度可逆水性锌粉电池的完全干法处理的电极
abstract_zh:
水系锌离子电池发展迅速，但实际部署受到过高的正负极（N/P）比（>50）的限制，从而降低了能量密度。锌粉阳极可以降低N/P，但其高比表面积会加速寄生反应并缩短使用寿命。在这里，我们报道了一种具有非电化学驱动的固体电解质界面（SEI）的高负载和高度可逆的干法锌粉阳极。干法工艺保留了磷酸钠 SEI 前体在整个阳极的均匀分布，在电解质接触时触发磷酸锌基 SEI 的自发形成，从而抑制析氢和锌腐蚀。将此阳极与干处理阴极（90 mg cm
                    −2
                    ; 12.5毫安厘米
                    −2
                    ）产生完全干燥处理的水性锌电池。软包电池在 N/P ~ 3 下循环 530 次后容量保持率为 88.8%，尽管阴极负载增加了约 20 倍，但其性能仍优于之前的锌粉系统，并为实际电网规模存储的高能量密度水性锌电池提供了一条可扩展的途径。

title: Mitochondrial stress activates ELT-2–dependent lysosomal proteostasis to extend lifespan in C. elegans
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Mild mitochondrial stress could extend lifespan across species, yet the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Here, we show that inhibition of mitochondrial respiration induces a sustained transcriptional program that enhances lysosomal proteolysis during aging in
                    Caenorhabditis elegans
                    . Mechanistically, this response is primarily regulated by the intestinal GATA transcription factor ELT-2, which retains high expression and directly binds to GATA motifs in the promoters of lysosomal protease genes to promote their transcriptional activation. Moreover, we identified R249 within the conserved zinc-finger DNA binding domain of ELT-2 as a key residue required for its transcriptional activity. Notably, this mitochondrion–ELT-2–lysosome axis operates largely independently of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPR
                    mt
                    ) to counteract aging. Furthermore, increased lysosomal activity, as well as the lysosomal proteases CPR-5 and CPR-8, is essential for mitochondrial stress–induced clearance of toxic polyglutamine (polyQ) aggregates and lifespan extension. Together, our findings reveal a previously unrecognized ELT-2–dependent lysosomal proteostasis pathway that acts downstream of mitochondrial stress to maintain protein homeostasis and promote longevity.
title_zh: 线粒体应激激活 ELT-2 依赖性溶酶体蛋白稳态以延长线虫寿命
abstract_zh:
轻度线粒体应激可以延长物种的寿命，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们发现，线粒体呼吸的抑制会诱导持续的转录程序，从而增强衰老过程中的溶酶体蛋白水解作用。
                    秀丽隐杆线虫
                    。从机制上讲，这种反应主要受到肠道 GATA 转录因子 ELT-2 的调节，ELT-2 保持高表达并直接与溶酶体蛋白酶基因启动子中的 GATA 基序结合，促进其转录激活。此外，我们还确定了 ELT-2 保守锌指 DNA 结合域内的 R249 是其转录活性所需的关键残基。值得注意的是，线粒体-ELT-2-溶酶体轴的运作很大程度上独立于线粒体未折叠蛋白反应（UPR
                    山
                    ）来对抗衰老。此外，溶酶体活性的增加以及溶酶体蛋白酶 CPR-5 和 CPR-8 对于线粒体应激诱导的有毒聚谷氨酰胺 (polyQ) 聚集体的清除和寿命的延长至关重要。总之，我们的研究结果揭示了一种先前未被认识的 ELT-2 依赖性溶酶体蛋白质稳态途径，该途径在线粒体应激下游发挥作用，以维持蛋白质稳态并促进寿命。

title: Faster, bigger, more severe: Extreme wildfire spread sets the stage for forest ecosystem change in western and boreal North America
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: A relatively small number of rapidly spreading wildfire events burn disproportionately large areas. But beyond area burned, do fast fires produce distinct postfire ecological outcomes? Here, we measure daily linear fire growth rates and assess relationships between fire spread, burn severity, and metrics of postfire landscape resilience from 3499 fires occurring between 2012 and 2023 in conifer-dominated forests of Canada and the western US. We find that as linear spread rate increases, so too does fire severity, proportion of area burned at high severity, and distance to surviving live tree seed sources. Thus, not only do the fastest fires burn outsized areas, but these areas have less remaining tree cover and reduced capacity for recovery, setting the stage for long-term vegetation shifts. Given anticipated increases in extreme fire spread as fire seasons lengthen and weather becomes more fire-conducive, our findings highlight growing needs to effectively reduce undesired impacts, manage postfire landscapes to sustain forest ecosystem functions, and foster social-ecological adaptation.
title_zh: 更快、更大、更严重：极端野火蔓延为北美西部和北部森林生态系统的变化奠定了基础
abstract_zh: 数量相对较少、迅速蔓延的野火事件烧毁的面积不成比例。但除了烧毁面积之外，快速火灾是否会产生明显的火灾后生态后果？在这里，我们测量了每日线性火灾增长率，并评估了 2012 年至 2023 年间加拿大和美国西部以针叶树为主的森林中发生的 3499 场火灾的火灾蔓延、烧伤严重程度和火灾后景观恢复力指标之间的关系。我们发现，随着线性蔓延率的增加，火灾严重程度、高严重程度烧毁面积的比例以及距幸存活树种子源的距离也会增加。因此，最快的火灾不仅会烧毁大片地区，而且这些地区的剩余树木覆盖率也会减少，恢复能力也会降低，从而为长期植被变化奠定了基础。鉴于预计随着火灾季节延长和天气变得更有利于火灾，极端火灾蔓延将会增加，我们的研究结果强调了有效减少不良影响、管理火灾后景观以维持森林生态系统功能以及促进社会生态适应的日益增长的需求。

title: TAL1 is indispensable in ETV2-primed human endothelial cell fate determination
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: ETS variant transcription factor 2 (ETV2) serves as a foundational transcription factor for endothelial lineage specification. However, the lineage-specific cofactors that orchestrate with ETV2 during endothelial fate commitment remain elusive. Here, we demonstrate that ETV2 drives the rapid forward programming of human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs) into endothelial cells (ECs) by direct remodeling of endothelial-specific enhancers. Crucially, we identify T cell acute lymphocytic leukemia protein 1 (TAL1), which is traditionally characterized as a hematopoietic regulator, as an indispensable cofactor for ETV2-mediated endothelial commitment. Distinct from its role in murine development, TAL1 deficiency in hPSCs not only aborts the endothelial program by impairing H3K27ac deposition at key enhancers but also triggers a profound lineage redirection toward a mesenchymal fate. Mechanistically, TAL1 physically interacts with ETV2 to recruit the p300, thereby facilitating a permissive chromatin environment for endothelial identity. By leveraging an hPSC-based differentiation model, our findings establish TAL1 as a master gatekeeper of human EC specification and provide a molecular blueprint for how ETV2-centric complexes synergistically govern human cell fate.
title_zh: TAL1 在 ETV2 引发的人内皮细胞命运决定中不可或缺
abstract_zh: ETS 变异转录因子 2 (ETV2) 是内皮谱系规范的基础转录因子。然而，在内皮命运决定过程中与 ETV2 协调的谱系特异性辅助因子仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们证明 ETV2 通过直接重塑内皮特异性增强子来驱动人类多能干细胞 (hPSC) 快速向前编程为内皮细胞 (EC)。至关重要的是，我们确定了 T 细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病蛋白 1 (TAL1)，传统上被认为是造血调节因子，也是 ETV2 介导的内皮细胞定型不可或缺的辅助因子。与其在小鼠发育中的作用不同，hPSC 中的 TAL1 缺陷不仅会通过损害关键增强子上的 H3K27ac 沉积来中止内皮细胞程序，还会引发向间充质命运的深刻谱系重定向。从机制上讲，TAL1 与 ETV2 物理相互作用以招募 p300，从而促进内皮细胞身份的许可染色质环境。通过利用基于 hPSC 的分化模型，我们的研究结果将 TAL1 确立为人类 EC 规范的主要看门人，并为以 ETV2 为中心的复合物如何协同控制人类细胞命运提供了分子蓝图。

title: Acoustic resonators as wireless actuators in air for small-scale robots
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: While acoustic resonators have been extensively studied in liquids for the realization of untethered microrobots, their implementation in air remains largely unexplored. Here, we revisit the classical principle of Helmholtz resonance and show that 3D printed cavities with sizes ranging from centimeter to micrometer generate spatiotemporally controlled thrust ranging from millinewton to micronewton upon resonance excitation. We provide a comprehensive design framework to efficiently harness acoustic and aerodynamic forces that are validated through analytical modeling, numerical simulations, and experiments. We show robotic navigation of small-scale boats powered by either air-borne or structure-borne sound, highlighting the versatility of the actuation scheme. We present one type of microflier propelled by vertical thrust that weighs only 150 micrograms with a thrust-to-weight ratio of 4.9 and another type of microflier propelled by a rotor that weighs only 184 micrograms and rotates as fast as 13,000 revolutions per minute. The actuation scheme is compatible with even further miniaturization, pushing the boundaries of robotics and aeronautics.
title_zh: 声谐振器作为小型机器人空气中的无线执行器
abstract_zh: 虽然声谐振器已在液体中进行了广泛研究，以实现不受束缚的微型机器人，但它们在空气中的实现在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们重新审视亥姆霍兹共振的经典原理，并表明尺寸从厘米到微米的 3D 打印空腔在共振激发时会产生从毫牛顿到微牛顿的时空控制推力。我们提供全面的设计框架，以有效利用声学和空气动力，并通过分析建模、数值模拟和实验进行验证。我们展示了由空气传播或结构传播声音驱动的小型船只的机器人导航，强调了驱动方案的多功能性。我们展示了一种由垂直推力驱动的微型飞行器，重量仅为 150 微克，推重比为 4.9，而另一种由转子驱动的微型飞行器，重量仅为 184 微克，转速为每分钟 13,000 转。该驱动方案与进一步的小型化兼容，突破了机器人和航空技术的界限。

title: A thiol-rich immunomodulatory injectable hydrogel suppresses endometrial fibrosis to restore fertilization
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Endometrial fibrosis disrupts the uterine microenvironment and is a major cause of intrauterine adhesion (IUA) and infertility. Postoperative barriers are commonly used after adhesiolysis, but most act as passive spacers and do not actively remodel the fibrotic inflammatory niche. Here, we report a thiol-rich immunomodulatory injectable hydrogel (TR-gel) that forms in situ through Michael addition between acrylated hyaluronic acid and thiolated hyaluronic acid. The hydrogel conformally adheres to injured endometrium, provides tissue-matched mechanics and controlled biodegradation, and retains abundant thiol groups that create a reductive microenvironment. TR-gel scavenged reactive oxygen species, suppressed nuclear factor κB activation, promoted macrophage polarization toward a proregenerative M2 phenotype, and reduced inflammatory and fibrotic signaling. In a rat IUA model, TR-gel decreased collagen deposition, promoted angiogenesis, restored glandular architecture and embryo receptivity, and improved the fertility rate from 25.0 to 62.5%. These findings provide preclinical evidence that a thiol-rich immunomodulatory hydrogel can combine physical barrier function with microenvironmental regulation to support endometrial regeneration.
title_zh: 富含硫醇的免疫调节可注射水凝胶抑制子宫内膜纤维化以恢复受精
abstract_zh: 子宫内膜纤维化破坏子宫微环境，是宫腔粘连（IUA）和不孕的主​​要原因。术后屏障通常在粘连松解后使用，但大多数充当被动间隔物，并且不会主动重塑纤维化炎症生态位。在这里，我们报道了一种富含硫醇的免疫调节可注射水凝胶（TR-gel），它通过丙烯酸化透明质酸和硫醇化透明质酸之间的迈克尔加成原位形成。水凝胶适形地粘附在受损的子宫内膜上，提供组织匹配的力学和受控的生物降解，并保留丰富的硫醇基团，从而创造一个还原性的微环境。 TR-gel 清除活性氧，抑制核因子 κB 激活，促进巨噬细胞极化向再生 M2 表型，并减少炎症和纤维化信号传导。在大鼠 IUA 模型中，TR-gel 减少胶原蛋白沉积，促进血管生成，恢复腺体结构和胚胎容受性，并将生育率从 25.0% 提高到 62.5%。这些发现提供了临床前证据，表明富含硫醇的免疫调节水凝胶可以将物理屏障功能与微环境调节相结合，以支持子宫内膜再生。

title: Ancestral proteins trace the emergence of substrate specificity and oligomerization within bacterial DEDDy dinucleases
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Nucleases are crucial for various bacterial processes, including genome maintenance and host defense. Deoxydinucleases (diDNases), a class of Gram-positive bacteria–specific nucleases associated with mobile genetic elements, are homologous to nanoRNase C (NrnC) in Gram-negative bacteria but exhibit notable differences: diDNases form dimers and cleave DNA dinucleotides, whereas NrnC forms octamers that process both RNA and DNA dinucleotides. The mechanism by which substrate specificity emerged, and whether it is linked to oligomerization, remained unknown. Here, we reconstructed a common ancestor of diDNases and NrnC orthologs that forms a dimer with intermediate preference for DNA. Structures of ancestral and extant dinucleases reveal gradual changes in conformation that gave rise to substrate preference, oligomeric state, and catalytic efficiency. These findings highlight how subtle, concerted structural modifications enable large-scale changes in molecular assembly and functional specialization, harnessing a conserved protein fold. DNA dinucleotide preference in the early ancestor and preservation of DNase activity in all extant enzymes strongly argue for a biological function of DNA dinucleotides.
title_zh: 祖先蛋白追踪细菌 DEDDy 双核酸酶内底物特异性和寡聚化的出现
abstract_zh: 核酸酶对于各种细菌过程至关重要，包括基因组维护和宿主防御。脱氧二核酸酶 (diDNase) 是一类与可移动遗传元件相关的革兰氏阳性菌特异性核酸酶，与革兰氏阴性菌中的 nanoRNase C (NrnC) 同源，但表现出显着差异：diDNase 形成二聚体并切割 DNA 二核苷酸，而 NrnC 形成八聚体，可同时处理 RNA 和 DNA 二核苷酸。底物特异性出现的机制以及它是否与寡聚化有关仍然未知。在这里，我们重建了 diDNase 和 NrnC 直向同源物的共同祖先，它们形成对 DNA 具有中间偏好的二聚体。祖先和现存双核酸酶的结构揭示了构象的逐渐变化，从而导致底物偏好、寡聚状态和催化效率。这些发现强调了如何利用保守的蛋白质折叠，通过微妙、协调的结构修饰来实现分子组装和功能专业化的大规模变化。早期祖先对 DNA 二核苷酸的偏好以及所有现存酶中 DNase 活性的保留有力地证明了 DNA 二核苷酸的生物学功能。

title: Odor tracking in flying Drosophila requires visual reafference and compass neurons
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Flying
                    Drosophila
                    critically depend on high-contrast visual surroundings to localize odor sources in still air, yet the neural mechanisms of visual integration for active odor tracking are unknown. We demonstrate that Ellipsoid body-Protocerebral bridge-Gall (E-PG) neurons—head direction cells in the central complex—work in concert with self-generated visual motion signals to maintain a stable heading metric during olfactory navigation in flight. Using a magnetic tether system and a digital “visual clamp,” we show that removing the visual feedback generated by a fly’s own turns (reafference) causes the animal to lose its heading within an odor plume. Thus, olfactory and mechanosensory signals alone are insufficient for plume stabilization. E-PG neurons have been shown to store visual changes in heading during flight. Genetically hyperpolarizing E-PG neurons significantly compromised the flies’ ability to both acquire and maintain heading toward a food odor. Notably, silencing these neurons did not disrupt basic visual reflexes, such as optomotor gaze stabilization or object tracking, indicating a specific role in odor-directed visual navigation rather than visual flight control. While odor was found to modulate the frequency and amplitude of turns independently, E-PG neurons are essential for directing the orientation of corrective saccades toward the plume center. These results establish that visual reafference engages the internal visual compass and associated control circuits to sustain a spatial working memory of heading changes between saccades, allowing flies to maintain a straight course and navigate effectively toward an invisible odor source in flight in still air.
title_zh: 飞行果蝇的气味追踪需要视觉再传入和罗盘神经元
abstract_zh:
飞行
                    果蝇
                    关键依赖于高对比度的视觉环境来定位静止空气中的气味源，但主动气味跟踪的视觉整合的神经机制尚不清楚。我们证明了椭球体-原脑桥-胆（E-PG）神经元（中央复合体中的头部方向细胞）与自身生成的视觉运动信号协同工作，以在飞行中的嗅觉导航过程中保持稳定的航向度量。使用磁性系绳系统和数字“视觉夹”，我们证明，消除果蝇自身转弯（再传入）产生的视觉反馈会导致动物在气味羽流中失去方向。因此，仅靠嗅觉和机械感觉信号不足以稳定羽流。 E-PG 神经元已被证明可以存储飞行过程中航向的视觉变化。基因超极化的 E-PG 神经元显着损害了果蝇获取和维持食物气味的能力。值得注意的是，沉默这些神经元并不会破坏基本的视觉反射，例如视运动凝视稳定或物体跟踪，这表明在气味导向的视觉导航而不是视觉飞行控制中具有特定作用。虽然发现气味可以独立调节转动的频率和幅度，但 E-PG 神经元对于将纠正性眼跳的方向引导至羽流中心至关重要。这些结果表明，视觉再传入会利用内部视觉罗盘和相关的控制电路来维持航向变化的空间工作记忆

title: Chromosomal inversions accelerate genetic evolution and drive ecological speciation across an island gradient
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Chromosomal rearrangements are hypothesized to facilitate speciation by suppressing recombination in locally adapted genomic regions, yet how they shape evolutionary rates during rapid divergence remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the genomic architecture of two sister
                    Carex
                    (Cyperaceae) species on Réunion Island, which rapidly diverged (∼0.5 Mya) to occupy contrasting tropical-montane and dry-subalpine habitats. Using chromosome-level assemblies and population genomics, we show that genomic divergence is not uniform across the genome but is concentrated within specific large-scale inversions. Crucially, genes within these structural variants exhibit significantly accelerated rates of protein evolution, as evidenced by elevated ω, compared to the collinear genome. This is consistent with recombination suppression and subsequent relaxation of purifying selection driving these patterns, which may complement or even outweigh the signal of positive selection. Functional analysis and environmental associations reveal that these “genomic accelerators” include key adaptive loci: Inversions on chromosomes 14 and 28 are enriched for mechanosensitive ion channels and auxin transport, which is consistent with facilitating the interspecific physiological shift to aridity. Partial redundancy analyses reveal that ongoing intraspecific ecological adaptation is highly polygenic across the collinear genome. Our results demonstrate that genomic architecture actively dictates evolutionary speed, suggesting that certain lineages boosted by structural variants may bypass the typical constraints of purifying selection to rapidly exploit vacant ecological opportunities.
title_zh: 染色体倒位加速遗传进化并驱动整个岛屿梯度的生态物种形成
abstract_zh:
假设染色体重排通过抑制局部适应基因组区域的重组来促进物种形成，但人们对它们在快速分化过程中如何影响进化速率仍知之甚少。在这里，我们研究了两姐妹的基因组结构
                    苔草
                    留尼汪岛上的莎草科（Cyperaceae）物种，迅速分化（∼0.5 Mya），占据截然不同的热带山地和干燥亚高山栖息地。使用染色体级组装和群体基因组学，我们表明基因组分歧在整个基因组中并不均匀，而是集中在特定的大规模倒位中。至关重要的是，与共线基因组相比，这些结构变体中的基因表现出显着加快的蛋白质进化速率，正如 ω 升高所证明的那样。这与重组抑制和随后驱动这些模式的纯化选择的放松是一致的，这可能补充甚至超过正选择的信号。功能分析和环境关联表明，这些“基因组加速器”包括关键的适应性位点：14 号和 28 号染色体上的倒位丰富了机械敏感离子通道和生长素运输，这与促进种间生理向干旱的转变是一致的。部分冗余分析表明，持续的种内生态适应在共线基因组中是高度多基因的。我们的结果表明，基因组结构主动决定了进化速度，这表明某些谱系是由基因促进的

title: MALT1 alternative splicing—A molecular rheostat for balancing immune activation and homeostasis
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: MALT1 (mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue lymphoma/leukemia protein 1)–TRAF6 [tumor necrosis factor receptor (TNFR)-associated factor 6] interaction drives lymphocyte activation and adaptive immunity, but it also contributes to maintaining immune homeostasis. MALT1 exists in two isoforms that differ only by either encoding two (MALT1A) or one (MALT1B) TRAF6 binding motif (T6BM). The human mutation MALT1 E806D in T6BM2, expressed in both MALT1A and MALT1B, has been associated with an immune disorder combining symptoms of immune deficiency and autoimmunity. Here, we report that the orthologous germline mutation MALT1 E814D is sufficient to induce a fatal autoimmune syndrome in mice. We demonstrate that species-specific differences in the effects of T6BM2 disruptions can be attributed to alterations in MALT1 splicing and that immune homeostasis is restored by genetically enforcing expression of MALT1A in MALT1 E814D mice. Thus, alternative MALT1 splicing allows tuning of TRAF6 association, thereby functioning as a molecular rheostat to balance between optimal immune activation and maintenance of peripheral tolerance.
title_zh: MALT1选择性剪接——平衡免疫激活和稳态的分子变阻器
abstract_zh: MALT1（粘膜相关淋巴组织淋巴瘤/白血病蛋白 1）–TRAF6 [肿瘤坏死因子受体 (TNFR) 相关因子 6] 相互作用可驱动淋巴细胞激活和适应性免疫，但也有助于维持免疫稳态。 MALT1 存在两种同工型，差异仅在于编码两种 (MALT1A) 或一种 (MALT1B) TRAF6 结合基序 (T6BM)。 T6BM2 中的人类突变 MALT1 E806D 在 MALT1A 和 MALT1B 中均表达，与免疫缺陷和自身免疫症状相结合的免疫疾病有关。在这里，我们报告直系同源种系突变 MALT1 E814D 足以在小鼠中诱发致命的自身免疫综合征。我们证明，T6BM2 破坏的影响的物种特异性差异可归因于 MALT1 剪接的改变，并且通过在 MALT1 E814D 小鼠中基因强制表达 MALT1A 来恢复免疫稳态。因此，选择性 MALT1 剪接允许调节 TRAF6 关联，从而起到分子变阻器的作用，以在最佳免疫激活和维持外周耐受之间取得平衡。

title: The relationship between officer misconduct and convictionless arrests
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: This paper examines whether officers with high prior alleged misconduct are more likely to make convictionless arrests (arrests that result in no or dismissed charges or where the defendant is found not guilty). Using the Chicago Police Department’s rotational duty calendar to obtain plausibly exogenous variation in the set of officers assigned to work on a particular day, we find that high-misconduct officers make statistically significantly more arrests for nonindex crimes and in situations involving high officer discretion, compared to their no-misconduct peers. Our findings also suggest that downstream legal actors, such as prosecutors and judges, may be partially “correcting” these arrests.
title_zh: 警员不当行为与无罪逮捕之间的关系
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了先前被指控不当行为的警官是否更有可能进行无罪逮捕（导致无罪或驳回指控或被告被判无罪的逮捕）。使用芝加哥警察局的轮换值班日历来获得在特定日期分配工作的警员组中看似合理的外生变化，我们发现，与没有不当行为的同行相比，行为不当的警官因非指数犯罪和涉及高级警官自由裁量权的情况而被捕的人数在统计上显着增加。我们的研究结果还表明，下游法律行为者，例如检察官和法官，可能部分地“纠正”了这些逮捕。

title: A programmed reset mechanism primes Clostridioides difficile virulence at the onset of infection
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Clostridioides difficile
                    is a major cause of antibiotic-associated diarrhea. This pathogen produces toxins essential for disease and flagella that promote intestinal colonization. Flagella and toxins are coregulated in an ON/OFF manner leading to a heterogeneous population of toxigenic, flagellated cells (
                    flg
                    -ON) and aflagellate cells with attenuated toxin production (
                    flg
                    -OFF). How selective pressures affect ON/OFF switching dynamics and overall population composition is unknown. Here, we use a mouse model of disease to evaluate the ON/OFF makeup of the
                    C. difficile
                    population in vivo. Two key results emerged: (i) Directional inversion of the
                    flg
                    switch to the “ON” orientation occurs during spore germination, and (ii) toxin-induced inflammation enriches for a
                    flg
                    -OFF population during infection. These findings reveal a cycle in which predominantly
                    flg
                    -OFF spores are disseminated into the environment, and spore germination in the next host resets
                    C. difficile
                    to a virulent population of motile, toxigenic cells at infection onset.
title_zh: 程序化重置机制在感染开始时启动艰难梭菌毒力
abstract_zh:
艰难梭菌
                    是抗生素相关性腹泻的主要原因。这种病原体产生疾病所必需的毒素和促进肠道定植的鞭毛。鞭毛和毒素以开/关方式共同调节，导致产毒鞭毛细胞的异质群体（
                    FLG
                    -ON）和毒素产生减弱的鞭毛细胞（
                    FLG
                    -关闭）。选择性压力如何影响开/关切换动态和总体种群构成尚不清楚。在这里，我们使用小鼠疾病模型来评估
                    艰难梭菌
                    体内群体。出现了两个关键结果：（i）
                    FLG
                    孢子萌发期间发生向“ON”方向的转变，并且（ii）毒素诱导的炎症加剧
                    FLG
                    -感染期间关闭人群。这些发现揭示了一个循环，其中主要
                    FLG
                    -OFF 孢子传播到环境中，下一个宿主中的孢子萌发重置
                    艰难梭菌
                    感染开始时，会形成一群有毒的活动性产毒细胞。

title: A solution to generalized learning from small training sets found in infants’ repeated visual experiences of individual objects
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: One-year-old infants rapidly form and generalize categories from idiosyncratic experiences of very few exemplars of those categories. Here we provide evidence on the statistics of infants’ daily-life visual experiences for 8 object categories. Using a corpus of infant head-camera images recorded at mealtimes (87 mealtimes,14 infants), we measure the frequency of the unique instances of each category and the variability of the visual experiences within and across instances of the same category. The frequency distributions of instances for individual infants are highly skewed, containing many images of the same few objects along with fewer images of other instances. Graph theoretic measures of individual category experiences for individual children reveal a “lumpy” mix of high similarity and high variability, organized into multiple but interconnected clusters of high-similarity images. In computational experiments, we show that artificially created training sets characterized by an interconnected mix of high and low similarity support generalization to novel instances after limited training. We discuss implications for category recognition, and for learning more generally, by both humans and machines.
title_zh: 从婴儿对单个物体的重复视觉体验中发现的小型训练集进行广义学习的解决方案
abstract_zh: 一岁大的婴儿会根据这些类别中极少数范例的特殊经历，迅速形成并概括类别。在这里，我们提供了婴儿日常生活视觉体验对 8 个物体类别的统计数据。使用在进餐时间记录的婴儿头部摄像头图像的语料库（87 个进餐时间，14 个婴儿），我们测量了每个类别的独特实例的频率以及同一类别实例内和实例之间视觉体验的变异性。个别婴儿的实例的频率分布高度倾斜，包含相同少数物体的许多图像以及其他实例的较少图像。对个体儿童的个体类别体验的图论测量揭示了高相似性和高变异性的“块状”混合，组织成多个但相互关联的高相似性图像簇。在计算实验中，我们表明，人工创建的训练集以高相似性和低相似性的互连混合为特征，支持在有限训练后泛化到新实例。我们讨论对类别识别以及对人类和机器更广泛的学习的影响。

title: RNA terminal uridylyl transferases are druggable vulnerabilities in AML but are dispensable for normal hematopoiesis
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is an aggressive hematological malignancy arising from hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs). Current treatments often fail to eradicate AML; therefore, new therapeutic strategies are essential. Here, we reveal that RNA terminal uridylyl transferase enzymes 4 and 7 (TUT4/7) are druggable therapeutic targets, whose genetic deletion suppresses AML growth, induces apoptosis, and improves the survival in leukemic mouse models. Notably, a preclinical TUT4/7 inhibitor promotes cell death in samples from patients with AML and synergizes with venetoclax. Mechanistically, TUT4/7 inactivation suppresses mevalonate pathway gene expression, compromising the cholesterol synthesis pathway. Current AML therapies often cause severe hematopoietic toxicity. Although
                    Tut4/7
                    deletion results in inflammatory activation throughout the hematopoietic system, this is permissive to a normal life span and
                    Tut4/7
                    deficiency does not compromise HSPC function. Together, these findings identify TUT4/7 as druggable targets, whose inactivation suppresses AML while sparing normal hematopoiesis. In combination with venetoclax, this represents a promising therapeutic strategy.
title_zh: RNA 末端尿嘧啶转移酶是 AML 中可药物治疗的弱点，但对于正常造血来说是可有可无的
abstract_zh:
急性髓系白血病（AML）是一种由造血干细胞和祖细胞（HSPC）引起的侵袭性血液恶性肿瘤。目前的治疗方法往往无法根除 AML；因此，新的治疗策略至关重要。在这里，我们揭示了 RNA 末端尿苷酰转移酶 4 和 7 (TUT4/7) 是可药物治疗靶点，其基因缺失可抑制 AML 生长，诱导细胞凋亡，并提高白血病小鼠模型的存活率。值得注意的是，临床前 TUT4/7 抑制剂可促进 AML 患者样本中的细胞死亡，并与 Venetoclax 具有协同作用。从机制上讲，TUT4/7 失活会抑制甲羟戊酸途径基因表达，从而损害胆固醇合成途径。目前的 AML 治疗经常引起严重的造血毒性。虽然
                    啧啧4/7
                    缺失导致整个造血系统的炎症激活，这允许正常的寿命和
                    啧啧4/7
                    缺陷不会损害 HSPC 功能。总之，这些发现将 TUT4/7 确定为可药物靶标，其失活可抑制 AML，同时保护正常造血功能。与维奈托克联合使用，这是一种有前途的治疗策略。

title: Proteogenomic characterization of pulmonary large-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma identifies molecular features and therapeutic strategy
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Pulmonary large-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (LCNEC) is a rare yet highly aggressive subtype of non-small cell lung carcinoma (NSCLC) with limited therapeutic options. We conduct a comprehensive proteogenomic analysis of LCNEC using tumors and paired normal adjacent tissues from 107 patients (81 pure LCNEC and 26 combined LCNEC). APOBEC mutational signatures strongly correlate processes of tumor initiation and immune suppression, and
                    KEAP1
                    mutations correlate with metabolic reprogramming in LCNEC combined with NSCLC. A conflicting relationship is observed between neuroendocrine and immune phenotypes. We identify three LCNEC subtypes with unique prognosis features, microenvironment dysregulation, genetic alterations, and potential therapeutic targets. Interleukin-33 (IL-33) emerges as a critical therapeutic biomarker associated with enhanced T cell infiltration and antitumor activity. We further optimize recombinant IL-33 (rIL33) with site-directed mutagenesis and develop PEGylated rIL33, demonstrating its prolonged circulation time in cynomolgus monkeys and superior immune agonist activity in mouse models. Overall, this study offers insights into LCNEC biology and provides promising innovative immunoagonist therapy strategies for lung cancer.
title_zh: 肺大细胞神经内分泌癌的蛋白质组学特征确定分子特征和治疗策略
abstract_zh:
肺大细胞神经内分泌癌（LCNEC）是一种罕见但高度侵袭性的非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）亚型，治疗选择有限。我们使用 107 名患者的肿瘤和配对的正常邻近组织（81 例纯 LCNEC 和 26 例组合 LCNEC）对 LCNEC 进行了全面的蛋白质组学分析。 APOBEC 突变特征与肿瘤发生和免疫抑制过程密切相关，并且
                    KEAP1
                    突变与 LCNEC 合并 NSCLC 中的代谢重编程相关。在神经内分泌和免疫表型之间观察到相互矛盾的关系。我们确定了三种具有独特预后特征、微环境失调、遗传改变和潜在治疗靶点的 LCNEC 亚型。白细胞介素 33 (IL-33) 成为与 T 细胞浸润增强和抗肿瘤活性相关的关键治疗生物标志物。我们通过定点诱变进一步优化重组 IL-33 (rIL33)，并开发了聚乙二醇化 rIL33，证明其在食蟹猴中的循环时间延长，并在小鼠模型中具有优异的免疫激动剂活性。总体而言，这项研究提供了对 LCNEC 生物学的见解，并为肺癌提供了有前途的创新免疫激动剂治疗策略。

title: Single-exposure holographic 3D printing via inverse-designed phase masks
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Additive manufacturing using light is commonly constrained by serial voxel-by-voxel or layer-by-layer processing, which fundamentally limits fabrication speed and scalability. Here, we introduce a single-exposure holographic three-dimensional (3D) printing approach that synthesizes an entire volumetric dose distribution optically in one step. The method combines inverse-designed microstructured phase masks with photopolymer resins engineered for controlled optical absorption. By precisely tailoring the phase-mask topography, we generate arbitrary 3D light-intensity distributions within the resin, including intentionally encoded dark regions that define hollow internal features. Simultaneously, the resin formulation is designed to balance optical penetration with sufficient local energy deposition to achieve high-fidelity polymerization throughout the volume. Using this approach, millimeter-scale architectures comprising more than 10
                    6
                    addressable voxels are fabricated in a single 7.5-second exposure, corresponding to a volumetric throughput of ∼1 cubic millimeters per second (>10
                    5
                    voxels per second). The demonstrated performance is presently limited by resin kinetics and illumination geometry rather than by the phase-mask framework itself. Because the volumetric information capacity scales with the space-bandwidth product of the phase mask, this approach provides a clear pathway toward substantially higher throughput, enabling scalable fabrication of micro-optical components, biomedical scaffolds, and other precision-engineered mesoscale systems.
title_zh: 通过逆向设计的相位掩模进行单次曝光全息 3D 打印
abstract_zh:
使用光的增材制造通常受到串行逐体素或逐层处理的限制，这从根本上限制了制造速度和可扩展性。在这里，我们介绍了一种单次曝光全息三维 (3D) 打印方法，该方法可以一步光学合成整个体积剂量分布。该方法将逆向设计的微结构相位掩模与专为控制光吸收而设计的光聚合物树脂相结合。通过精确定制相位掩模版形，我们在树脂内生成任意 3D 光强度分布，包括定义中空内部特征的有意编码的暗区域。同时，树脂配方旨在平衡光学渗透与足够的局部能量沉积，以在整个体积内实现高保真聚合。使用这种方法，毫米级架构包含超过 10 个
                    6
                    可寻址体素是在一次 7.5 秒的曝光中制造出来的，对应于每秒 ∼1 立方毫米的体积吞吐量（>10
                    5
                    每秒体素）。目前所展示的性能受到树脂动力学和照明几何形状的限制，而不是受到相位掩模框架本身的限制。由于体积信息容量随着相位掩模的空间带宽乘积而变化，因此这种方法提供了一条通向更高吞吐量的清晰途径，从而实现了微光学元件、生物医学支架的可扩展制造

title: Myasthenia thymus reprograms class-switched B cells into BAFF-dependent survivors
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Myasthenia gravis (MG) presents a clinical challenge where autoantibody titers poorly predict disease severity, and thymectomy provides inconsistent benefits. We hypothesized that thymic B cells acquire survival mechanisms that bypass canonical tolerance checkpoints, enabling persistence independent of antigen-specific selection. Using single-cell RNA sequencing, V(D)J repertoire analysis, and spatial transcriptomics to generate the largest MG atlas to date (237,661 cells), we identified a tolerance checkpoint swap in MG pathogenesis. Pathological class-switched B cells within thymic germinal centers exhibited reduced antigen presentation (
                    CD74
                    and
                    CD1C
                    ) and diminished
                    CD40
                    costimulation while up-regulating
                    TNFRSF17
                    to engage BAFF-driven survival. This shift allows polyclonal autoreactive B cells to evade stringent selection and seed peripheral sites. T follicular helper cells supported this reprogramming via increased
                    TNFSF13B
                    and
                    CHGB
                    expression, with the latter facilitating dopamine-mediated synaptic acceleration. These findings offer insight into clinical paradoxes in MG and point to the BAFF-BCMA axis as a potential therapeutic target and biomarkers for disease activity.
title_zh: 肌无力胸腺将类别转换的 B 细胞重新编程为依赖 BAFF 的幸存者
abstract_zh:
重症肌无力 (MG) 提出了临床挑战，自身抗体滴度很难预测疾病的严重程度，而胸腺切除术提供的益处不一致。我们假设胸腺 B 细胞获得了绕过经典耐受检查点的生存机制，从而能够独立于抗原特异性选择而持续存在。使用单细胞 RNA 测序、V(D)J 谱分析和空间转录组学生成迄今为止最大的 MG 图谱（237,661 个细胞），我们确定了 MG 发病机制中的耐受检查点交换。胸腺生发中心内的病理类别转换 B 细胞表现出抗原呈递减少（
                    CD74
                    和
                    CD1C
                    ）并减少
                    CD40
                    共刺激同时上调
                    肿瘤坏死因子RSF17
                    参与 BAFF 驱动的生存。这种转变使得多克隆自身反应性 B 细胞能够逃避严格的选择并在周围位点进行播种。滤泡辅助 T 细胞通过增加
                    TNFSF13B
                    和
                    CHGB
                    表达，后者促进多巴胺介导的突触加速。这些发现提供了对 MG 临床悖论的深入了解，并指出 BAFF-BCMA 轴作为潜在的治疗靶点和疾病活动的生物标志物。

title: First evaluation of wearable radiation protection for human deep space exploration, as flown on Artemis I
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: With preparations underway for extended-duration crewed deep space missions, the health risks of solar particle events (SPEs) to astronauts are becoming increasingly pertinent. To address this hazard, the AstroRad vest, a personal radiation shielding garment providing targeted organ protection, was tested during Artemis I. Two anthropomorphic female phantoms, equipped with internal and external passive and active dosimeters, were flown aboard the Orion spacecraft: one unshielded and the other wearing AstroRad. Inner Van Allen belt transit active dosimeter measurements were extrapolated to simulate SPE scenarios, predicting effective dose reductions of ∼60% for an August 1972–like SPE and nearly 40% for an October 1989–like SPE, varying slightly with anatomical model. Such reductions could spare astronauts the equivalent of up to 193 and 131 days of deep space radiation exposure, respectively. These findings demonstrate that wearable shielding such as AstroRad could serve as a vital element for safe and sustainable human deep space exploration.
title_zh: 首次评估用于载人深空探索的可穿戴辐射防护（在阿耳忒弥斯一号上飞行）
abstract_zh: 随着长时间载人深空任务的准备工作正在进行中，太阳粒子事件（SPE）对宇航员的健康风险变得越来越重要。为了解决这一危险，在阿耳忒弥斯一号期间对 AstroRad 背心（一种提供有针对性的器官保护的个人辐射屏蔽服装）进行了测试。两个配备有内部和外部被动和主动剂量计的拟人化女性模型在猎户座飞船上飞行：一个没有屏蔽，另一个穿着 AstroRad。内范艾伦带传输主动剂量计测量结果被推断以模拟 SPE 场景，预测 1972 年 8 月类似 SPE 的有效剂量减少约 60%，1989 年 10 月类似 SPE 的有效剂量减少近 40%，随解剖模型略有不同。这样的减少可以使宇航员分别免受相当于 193 天和 131 天的深空辐射暴露。这些发现表明，AstroRad 等可穿戴屏蔽可以成为安全、可持续的人类深空探索的重要元素。

title: Photonic time crystals assisted by quasi-bound states in the continuum
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Photonic time crystals (PTCs) are characterized by the rapid modulation of the material properties in time, causing a momentum bandgap for light. However, the observation of these bandgaps at optical frequencies remains elusive as the necessary temporal modulation amplitudes to show notable momentum bandgaps are relatively high, inaccessible with available materials. While it has been known that structuring PTCs at the subwavelength scale can improve the bandgap size, we push this concept to the extreme by leveraging the nanophotonic toolbox. Specifically, we demonstrate that structures composed of scatterers supporting quasi-bound states in the continuum can substantially reduce the required modulation amplitudes by enhancing the interaction time between light and time-varying matter. This allows us to observe noticeable momentum bandgaps despite the weak temporal modulation. Our approach bridges the concepts of bound states in the continuum and time-varying metamaterials, paving the way toward realizable PTCs at optical frequencies.
title_zh: 连续体中准束缚态辅助的光子时间晶体
abstract_zh: 光子时间晶体（PTC）的特点是材料特性随时间快速调制，从而产生光动量带隙。然而，在光频率下观察这些带隙仍然难以捉摸，因为显示显着动量带隙所需的时间调制幅度相对较高，可用材料无法达到。虽然众所周知，在亚波长尺度构建 PTC 可以改善带隙尺寸，但我们通过利用纳米光子工具箱将这一概念推向了极致。具体来说，我们证明了由支持连续体中准束缚态的散射体组成的结构可以通过增加光与时变物质之间的相互作用时间来显着降低所需的调制幅度。尽管时间调制较弱，这使我们能够观察到明显的动量带隙。我们的方法弥合了连续介质和时变超材料中束缚态的概念，为在光频率下实现 PTC 铺平了道路。

title: Phage-encoded NARP3 system rebuilds NAD+ to subvert bacterial immunity
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Phages deploy diverse countermeasures to evade bacterial nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD
                    +
                    )–directed immunity in a perpetual arms race. Known pathways include NAD
                    +
                    reconstitution pathway 1 (NARP1), which recycles adenosine 5′-diphosphate–ribose, and NARP2, which converts nicotinamide into NAD
                    +
                    via nicotinamide mononucleotide ligation. Whether additional NAD
                    +
                    -restoring strategies exist has remained unclear. Here, we identify NARP3, a conserved two-gene NAD
                    +
                    -restoring phage pathway widespread in Enterobacteriaceae-infecting phages. NARP3 encodes a pyridine nucleoside uptake system C (PnuC)-like nicotinamide riboside transporter (Bas30_87) and a bifunctional NAD
                    +
                    biosynthesis regulator (NadR)-like enzyme (Bas30_86). Bas30_87 imports nicotinamide riboside, and Bas30_86 converts it to NAD
                    +
                    through sequential phosphorylation and adenylation. NARP3 fully restores NAD
                    +
                    pools depleted by Sir2-HerA defenses, enabling robust phage replication. We solve x-ray crystal structures of Bas30_86 alone and bound to NAD
                    +
                    , revealing coordinated substrate capture, intermediate handling, and product formation. Mutational analyses confirm that both transport and enzymatic activities are essential. NARP3 functions as a metabolite-centered countermeasure, expands the phage arsenal, and underscores NAD
                    +
                    metabolism as a central battlefield in host-phage conflicts. Its discovery provides a blueprint for engineering phages to bypass NAD
                    +
                    -dependent bacterial immunity and offers a mechanistic framework to harness metabolite-guided viral strategies for biotechnological applications.
title_zh: 噬菌体编码的 NARP3 系统重建 NAD+ 颠覆细菌免疫力
abstract_zh:
噬菌体采取多种对策来逃避细菌烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD）

                    ）——永久军备竞赛中的定向豁免。已知的途径包括 NAD
                    +
                    重建途径 1 (NARP1)，回收腺苷 5'-二磷酸核糖，以及 NARP2，将烟酰胺转化为 NAD
                    +
                    通过烟酰胺单核苷酸连接。是否额外NAD
                    +
                    - 现有的恢复策略仍不清楚。在这里，我们鉴定出 NARP3，一种保守的双基因 NAD
                    +
                    -恢复肠杆菌感染噬菌体中广泛存在的噬菌体途径。 NARP3 编码吡啶核苷摄取系统 C (PnuC) 样烟酰胺核苷转运蛋白 (Bas30_87) 和双功能 NAD
                    +
                    生物合成调节剂 (NadR) 样酶 (Bas30_86)。 Bas30_87导入烟酰胺核苷，Bas30_86将其转化为NAD
                    +
                    通过顺序磷酸化和腺苷酸化。 NARP3完全恢复NAD

                    Sir2-HerA 防御耗尽的池，实现了强大的噬菌体复制。我们单独解析了 Bas30_86 并与 NAD 结合的 X 射线晶体结构
                    +
                    ，揭示协调的底物捕获、中间体处理和产物形成。突变分析证实运输和酶活性都是必不可少的。 NARP3 作为代谢物发挥作用

title: Structure and dynamics of confined water in amyloid protein fibril nanochannels
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Many fibrils of amyloid proteins are characterized by a dense core structure that largely excludes water. However, an increasing number of amyloid fibril structures are observed to contain water channels. Although water in membrane protein channels and pores has been studied, the structure and dynamics of water in amyloid protein fibril nanochannels is largely unexplored. In this computational study, we used molecular dynamics simulations to characterize the structure and dynamics of water inside the water channels of ex vivo human Serum Amyloid A (hSAA), ex vivo murine SAA (mSAA), and ex vivo feline SAA (fSAA) fibrils. Although these proteins are highly homologous, their fibril architectures differ substantially, providing an opportunity to understand how sequence-level variation influences interior water behavior. We find that water within the channels of all three fibrils exhibits damped translational and rotational diffusion relative to bulk water and adopts distinct ordered hydrogen-bonding networks. The water in fSAA and hSAA channels hydrates interior salt-bridges and hydrogen bonds with hydrophilic side chains, suggesting a stabilizing role. Confined water in mSAA channels engages in interactions with both the side chains and backbone of the residues, showing a unique trigonal arrangement and ice-like dynamics that has not been previously reported for confined water. Our results serve to elucidate the structural and dynamical role of water in the interior of amyloid protein fibrils.
title_zh: 淀粉样蛋白原纤维纳米通道中承压水的结构和动力学
abstract_zh: 许多淀粉样蛋白原纤维的特点是具有致密的核心结构，很大程度上排除了水。然而，越来越多的淀粉样原纤维结构被发现含有水通道。尽管已经研究了膜蛋白通道和孔中的水，但淀粉样蛋白原纤维纳米通道中水的结构和动力学在很大程度上尚未被探索。在这项计算研究中，我们使用分子动力学模拟来表征离体人血清淀粉样蛋白 A (hSAA)、离体鼠 SAA (mSAA) 和离体猫 SAA (fSAA) 原纤维水通道内的水的结构和动力学。尽管这些蛋白质高度同源，但它们的原纤维结构差异很大，这为了解序列水平变异如何影响内部水行为提供了机会。我们发现，所有三种原纤维通道内的水相对于大量水都表现出阻尼平移和旋转扩散，并采用不同的有序氢键网络。 fSAA 和 hSAA 通道中的水通过亲水侧链水合内部盐桥和氢键，表明具有稳定作用。 mSAA 通道中的承压水与残留物的侧链和主链相互作用，显示出独特的三角形排列和冰状动力学，这是以前未报道过的承压水。我们的结果有助于阐明水在淀粉样蛋白原纤维内部的结构和动力学作用。

title: CDT1 acts with the replisome to remodel replication forks
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Replication forks encounter problems during genome duplication that trigger replication stress. Fork reversal is a key stress tolerance pathway that helps mitigate replication challenges to facilitate DNA synthesis. Here, we report the function of origin licensing factor CDT1 in fork remodeling by replication fork reversal. Characterization of replication dynamics during early stages of origin reactivation revealed that CDT1 blocks fork progression without inducing DNA breaks. Notably, CDT1 mediates replication fork reversal under conditions of re-replication and genotoxic stress exposure, and this function is dependent on the interaction with the CMG helicase. Although proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA) sequesters CDT1 for proteolytic degradation under unperturbed conditions, ATAD5-mediated PCNA unloading at stressed forks releases CDT1 to interact with the CMG helicase and promote fork remodeling. Thus, contrary to the notion that CDT1 function must be inactivated in the S phase, our findings uncover a regulatory mechanism that facilitates fork remodeling function of CDT1 in response to replication stress.
title_zh: CDT1 与复制体一起重塑复制叉
abstract_zh: 复制叉在基因组复制过程中遇到问题，引发复制压力。分叉逆转是一种关键的应激耐受途径，有助于缓解复制挑战，促进 DNA 合成。在这里，我们报告了起源许可因子 CDT1 在通过复制叉逆转进行的叉重塑中的功能。起源重新激活早期阶段的复制动力学特征表明，CDT1 可以阻止分叉进展而不诱导 DNA 断裂。值得注意的是，CDT1 在再复制和基因毒性应激暴露的条件下介导复制叉逆转，并且该功能依赖于与 CMG 解旋酶的相互作用。尽管增殖细胞核抗原 (PCNA) 在不受干扰的条件下隔离 CDT1 进行蛋白水解降解，但 ATAD5 介导的 PCNA 在受压叉处卸载会释放 CDT1，与 CMG 解旋酶相互作用并促进叉重塑。因此，与 CDT1 功能必须在 S 期失活的观点相反，我们的研究结果揭示了一种调节机制，可促进 CDT1 响应复制应激的叉重塑功能。

title: CD5+ dendritic cell robots mediated in situ immunocyte activation
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Immune cell microbots with self-propelling and navigating capabilities have become an exciting field of research. Isolation, activation, and adoptive transfer of cytotoxic immune cells in vitro are some of the most common technical methods. However, the ex situ activation and adoptive transfer of cytotoxic immune cells carry the risk of systemic inflammatory responses and functional exhaustion. To address this bottleneck, we report a CD5
                    +
                    dendritic cell microbot (CD5
                    +
                    DC robot) constructed by engineering natural CD5
                    +
                    dendritic cells to phagocytose magnetic nanoparticles coated with tumor cell membranes. The PD-L1 on the surface of CD5
                    +
                    cells is preblocked to enhance immune activation capacity. Under switched exogenous rotating/conical magnetic fields, CD5
                    +
                    DC robots form chain-like clusters for upstream motion or ribbon-like clusters for downstream motion within the vasculature, enabling precise aggregation at intestinal targets. Then, they navigate along tumor chemokine gradients, penetrating the extracellular matrix barrier via positive chemotaxis to infiltrate deep into tumor tissues and trigger cascading activation of resident immune cells. Distinct from traditional cellular microbot therapies that rely on self-mediated cytotoxicity, this CD5
                    +
                    DC robot system activates durable antitumor immunity by reprogramming innate immune cells within the tumor microenvironment. This strategy offers a novel pathway toward precision-targeted therapy with excellent biocompatibility and functional stability.
title_zh: CD5+树突状细胞机器人介导的原位免疫细胞激活
abstract_zh:
具有自我推进和导航能力的免疫细胞微型机器人已成为一个令人兴奋的研究领域。体外细胞毒性免疫细胞的分离、激活和过继转移是一些最常见的技术方法。然而，细胞毒性免疫细胞的异位激活和过继转移存在全身炎症反应和功能衰竭的风险。为了解决这个瓶颈，我们报告了 CD5
                    +
                    树突状细胞微型机器人（CD5
                    +
                    DC机器人）由工程天然CD5构建
                    +
                    树突状细胞吞噬涂有肿瘤细胞膜的磁性纳米粒子。 CD5表面的PD-L1
                    +

                    +

                    +
                    DC机器人系统通过重新编程先天免疫细胞激活持久的抗肿瘤免疫力

title: Breaking solubility of metal-organic cages via polymer carrier for concentrated type II porous liquid to extract n-alkanes
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Type II porous liquids that exhibit host-guest properties derived from molecular cages are of potential utility in liquid-liquid separations; however, those with metal-organic cages (MOCs) as pore hosts are extremely rare due to the limited solubility of MOCs in cavity-excluded solvents. Here, we report the use of polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) to deliver polyoxovanadate-organic hybrid cages (HD) in polyethylene glycol (PEG) for a concentrated type II porous liquid (HD
                    PVP
                    /PEG). Structural characterizations and modeling studies collectively confirm that the PVP-PEG compatibility and the HD-PVP interaction enable the high HD concentration in PEG. The minimal loading of PVP coupled with the steric hindrance of PVP and PEG ensure the permanent porosity and room-temperature fluidity. HD
                    PVP
                    /PEG exhibits high uptake and selectivity toward C
                    5
                    –C
                    7
                    n

title: Retention of noble gases in the deep Earth: Kinetic trapping or stable bonding?
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: The bonding potential of noble gases in high-pressure silica-bearing solids and melts remains debated, yet it is a central question for understanding their retention behavior and evaluating the role of silicate-bearing phases in the transport and storage of noble gases originally present in the atmosphere. Here, we assess the chemical behavior of noble gases in three silicates: quartz, seifertite, and perovskite. Using the electron localization function and Bader charge analysis, we find no evidence of stable covalent or ionicbonding. The very slow intracrystalline diffusion of heavy noble gases governs their trapping in silicates during crystal growth. Noble gases are more likely to reside in melts or grain boundaries than in silicate crystal lattices.
title_zh: 惰性气体在地球深处的保留：动力学捕获还是稳定结合？
abstract_zh: 稀有气体在高压含二氧化硅固体和熔体中的键合潜力仍然存在争议，但这是了解其保留行为和评估含硅酸盐相在最初存在于大气中的稀有气体的运输和储存中的作用的核心问题。在这里，我们评估了三种硅酸盐中稀有气体的化学行为：石英、硒铁矿和钙钛矿。使用电子定位函数和巴德电荷分析，我们没有发现稳定共价键或离子键的证据。重惰性气体非常缓慢的晶内扩散决定了它们在晶体生长过程中被捕获在硅酸盐中。与硅酸盐晶格相比，稀有气体更可能存在于熔体或晶界中。

title: Prediction of mild cognitive impairment progression using time-sensitive multimodal biomarkers
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Alzheimer’s disease (AD) develops silently for years before symptoms emerge, making early identification of at-risk individuals essential for prevention trials and early intervention. We tested whether combining neurophysiological, imaging, and blood biomarkers improves prediction of progression to mild cognitive impairment (MCI) in cognitively unimpaired older adults with a family history of AD (
                    n
                     = 102; 31 progressors; mean follow-up of 5.9 years). Magnetoencephalography, magnetic resonance imaging, plasma biomarkers, and amyloid and tau positron emission tomography each captured complementary aspects of disease biology. Multimodal models predicted progression more accurately than demographic and genetic factors alone. Higher MEG alpha power was associated with increased near-term risk, whereas higher gamma activity predicted lower near-term risk; both effects weakened over time. Higher neocortical amyloid burden predicted increasing risk over follow-up, whereas plasma biomarkers and entorhinal tau predicted higher risk without significant time-varying effects. These findings support a time-sensitive multimodal framework for identifying cognitively unimpaired individuals at risk of MCI due to AD.

title: Mito-TEMPO improves survival rates in npc1-knockout zebrafish by reducing oxidative stress and enhancing mitophagy via Sod2
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Niemann-Pick type C (NPC) disease is a lysosomal storage disorder primarily caused by mutations in the
                    NPC1
                    gene. Most patients present with early-life symptoms including hepatosplenomegaly and digestive system impairment, followed by progressive neurodegeneration. However, effective therapeutic approaches to improve survival in NPC disease remain limited. In this study, using an
                    npc1
                    -knockout (NPC1-KO) zebrafish model established in our laboratory, our team suggests that
                    npc1
                    deficiency appears to correlate with marked down-regulation of superoxide dismutase 2 (Sod2) expression, concurrent with excessive oxidative stress (OS), mitochondrial dysfunction, and defective mitophagy. Treatment with Mito-TEMPO, a mitochondria-targeted antioxidant acting on SOD, increased survival rates and ameliorated cholesterol accumulation and liver function impairment in early-stage NPC1-KO zebrafish. The underlying mechanism may involve attenuation of OS and promotion of PINK1/Parkin-dependent mitophagic flux through SOD2 enhancement. Our findings support Mito-TEMPO as a potential therapeutic agent and SOD2 as a possible target for NPC disease.

title: Internal electric fields enhance reductive reactivity at MoS2 boundaries revealed by ultrafast near-field nanospectroscopy
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Monolayer MoS
                    2
                    is a promising low-cost and efficient catalyst for electrochemical or photochemical reduction reactions. Many previous works have demonstrated that 2D MoS
                    2
                    edges or boundaries are active reaction sites; however, their structural and electron dynamic origins remain unclear. Here we report an aperture-type near-field ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy to directly probe the electron dynamics at nanoscale MoS
                    2
                    boundaries. Near-field transient absorption imaging reveals a Stark effect signature at boundaries, where a built-in electric field of 1.93 MV/cm is intrinsically formed due to the oxidation of crystal boundaries. This field drives ultrafast electron injection and accumulation at the boundaries, enhancing boundary reactivity over the interior. These findings uncover the nanoscale structure-activity correlation for 2D MoS
                    2
                    and promote the rational design of catalysts based on transition metal dichalcogenides.

title: A prefrontal peptidergic circuit for psychogenic itch
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract: Psychological stress can evoke itch without a peripheral stimulus, yet the underlying mechanism remains undefined. Here, we demonstrate that a peptidergic circuit within the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) mediates this phenomenon. In mice under chronic restraint stress, stress-elicited scratching coincided with elevated gastrin-releasing peptide (GRP) release and heightened activity of GRP receptor (GRPR)–expressing neurons in the mPFC. Microinjection of GRP into the mPFC reproduced stress-induced itch, whereas ablation of GRPR neurons abolished it. Optogenetic activation of GRPR neurons or their GRP-expressing inputs from the ventromedial thalamus and basolateral amygdala evoked robust scratching; conversely, silencing these inputs or GRPR neurons attenuated scratching. Collectively, our findings establish a central peptidergic mechanism that transduces psychological stress into pruriceptive output, thereby identifying a critical neural substrate for psychogenic itch.
title_zh: 治疗心因性瘙痒的前额叶肽能回路
abstract_zh: 心理压力可以在没有外周刺激的情况下引起瘙痒，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）内的肽能回路介导了这种现象。在慢性束缚应激下的小鼠中，应激引起的抓挠与胃泌素释放肽（GRP）释放增加以及中皮层中表达 GRP 受体（GRPR）的神经元活性增强同时发生。将 GRP 显微注射到 mPFC 中会重现应激引起的瘙痒，而消融 GRPR 神经元则会消除这种瘙痒。 GRPR 神经元或其来自腹内侧丘脑和基底外侧杏仁核的 GRP 表达输入的光遗传学激活会引起强烈的抓挠；相反，抑制这些输入或 GRPR 神经元会减弱抓挠。总的来说，我们的研究结果建立了一种中央肽能机制，将心理压力转化为瘙痒输出，从而确定了心因性瘙痒的关键神经基质。

title: Fibroblasts resist Staphylococcus aureus on the skin surface by responding to interleukin-1 and recruiting neutrophils
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Staphylococcus aureus
                    can cause serious infections, yet it can also reside on the skin without causing disease. This apparent paradox implies a strong host defense system, which prevents
                    S. aureus
                    from invading the dermis. In this study, we investigate how the skin detects and responds to superficial
                    S. aureus
                    exposure. Using unbiased transcriptomic, biochemical, and phosphoproteomic analyses, followed by targeted validation in human and mouse models, we found that fibroblast recognition of interleukin-1 is essential for immune response. Deletion or blockade of the interleukin-1 receptor type 1 (IL-1R1) in fibroblasts in vitro abolished keratinocyte-driven changes in gene expression and reduced chemokine production. Furthermore, the skin of mice lacking fibroblast IL-1R1 had fewer neutrophils and higher bacterial load after topical
                    S. aureus
                    application. These findings show that fibroblasts actively participate in innate immunity and highlight an IL-1R1–dependent keratinocyte-fibroblast-neutrophil axis of communication. Understanding this pathway provides insights into mechanisms that initiate neutrophil recruitment to the skin and may help develop new approaches to therapy.

title: Lifestyles of Gypsy-family transposons shape their regulatory mechanisms
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Transposable elements (TEs) are a highly diverse group of selfish genomic elements, prevalent across the tree of life, whose uncontrolled propagation poses a threat to genome stability. Recent studies have explored the evolution of
                    Drosophila melanogaster
                    TEs, their coevolution with the host genome, and mechanisms that regulate their activity. However, little is known about their cross-species evolutionary patterns. Long terminal repeat (LTR) retrotransposons are the most active group of TEs in
                    Drosophila
                    . They are broadly separated into retroelements, which are active in the germline, and insect endogenous retroviruses that express in the gonadal soma. Somatic elements are hypothesized to infect the germline through their acquisition of virus-derived proteins such as Envelope and sORF2, thus multiplying through successive generations. In this study, we curated the sequences of LTR retrotransposons in 249 drosophilid genomes, allowing us to study their evolution across these species and highlight their varying degrees of conservation. Furthermore, we reveal multiple instances of Envelope protein loss or inactivation that suggest shifts in the expression pattern of these transposons, likely accompanied by adopting different transcriptional control mechanisms. We contrast this with the evolutionary history of sORF2, which we found to be much more stable. Lastly, we examine variations in transposon LTR regions responsible for transcriptional regulation and use predictive modeling to identify six transcription factors that may regulate their tissue-specific expression. Altogether, we reveal complex, interspecies evolutionary patterns of
                    Gypsy
                    -family LTR retrotransposons and highlight examples of their coevolution with their host genome.

title: GNPs-pIL-4 reprograms macrophage polarization and activates the OSM/GSNOR/ENG axis to improve angiogenesis in ischemic limbs
source: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
abstract:
Therapeutic angiogenesis based on gene therapies is a potential peripheral artery disease (PAD) treatment yet needs a more stable, efficient, and high-affinity delivery vector and an optimized delivery strategy. Here, we engineered three-dimensional graphene nanoparticles modified with folic acid and polyethyleneimine for macrophage-specific delivery of interleukin-4 plasmids (pIL-4), forming GNPs-pIL-4 for local intramuscular injection. GNPs-pIL-4 had uniform size, positive surface charge, and strong nucleic acid loading capacity (
                    K

Mediated by macrophages, GNPs-pIL-4 improved muscle contractility, delayed strength loss, and enhanced blood perfusion and oxygen saturation. These effects attributed to the down-regulated
