title: A language network in the individualized functional connectomes of 1199 human brains doing arbitrary tasks
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: A century and a half of neuroscience has yielded many divergent theories of the neurobiology of language. Two factors that likely contribute to this situation include (a) conceptual disagreement about language and its component processes, and (b) intrinsic inter-individual variability in the topography of language areas. Recent functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) studies of small numbers of intensively scanned individuals have argued that a language-selective brain network emerges bottom-up from correlations (individualized functional connectomics, iFC) in task-free (e.g., rest) or task-regressed activation timecourses. Here we tested this hypothesis at scale and evaluated its practical utility for task-agnostic language localization: we apply iFC separately to each of 1,957 (fMRI) scanning sessions (1,199 unique brains), each consisting of diverse tasks. We found that iFC indeed revealed a largely left-hemisphere-dominant frontotemporal network that was more stable within individuals than between them, robust to the granularity of the parcellation, and selective for language. These results support the hypothesis that this network is a key structure in the functional organization of the adult brain and show that it can be recovered retrospectively from arbitrary imaging data, with implications for neuroscience, neurosurgery, and neural engineering.
title_zh: 1199 个执行任意任务的人脑的个性化功能连接组中的语言网络
abstract_zh: 一个半世纪的神经科学已经产生了许多不同的语言神经生物学理论。可能导致这种情况的两个因素包括（a）关于语言及其组成过程的概念分歧，以及（b）语言区域地形的内在个体间差异。最近对少量集中扫描个体进行的功能磁共振成像（fMRI）研究表明，语言选择性大脑网络是从无任务（例如休息）或任务回归激活时间过程中的相关性（个性化功能连接组学，iFC）中自下而上出现的。在这里，我们大规模测试了这一假设，并评估了其对于与任务无关的语言本地化的实用性：我们将 iFC 分别应用于 1,957 个 (fMRI) 扫描会话（1,199 个独特的大脑）中的每一个，每个扫描会话都包含不同的任务。我们发现 iFC 确实揭示了一个很大程度上以左半球为主的额颞叶网络，该网络在个体内部比个体之间更稳定，对分割的粒度具有鲁棒性，并且对语言具有选择性。这些结果支持了这样的假设：该网络是成人大脑功能组织中的关键结构，并表明它可以从任意成像数据中回顾性地恢复，这对神经科学、神经外科和神经工程具有重要意义。

title: Structural basis of fatty acid activation and transport by human FATP2
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Fatty acid transport proteins (FATPs) are responsible for efficient uptake of fatty acids (FAs), essential biomolecules that play critical roles in development and growth. However, the lack of three-dimensional structures of FATPs has hindered our understanding of their mechanisms. Here, we report two cryo-EM structures of human FATP2a: wild-type (WT) FATP2a in intermediate state at 2.93 Å and a catalytic mutant of FATP2a in pre-catalytic state at 2.76 Å. In the two structures, both the oleoyl-AMP intermediate and ATP occupy the same central pocket with the acyl group of oleoyl-AMP pointing upwards and placed in a hydrophobic tunnel while the phosphate groups of ATP pointing downwards and interacting with a central loop. The structures also reveal that FAs from the membrane must undergo a two-step translocation to access the catalytic center. The binding of a new FA before the completion of a working cycle may be crucial to ensure the catalytic and transport efficiency. Furthermore, we demonstrate that FATP2a transport FAs, strictly dependent on the activation of FAs through the acyl-CoA synthetase activity. Our findings provide important insights into the working mechanism of FATPs and offer a structural basis for the development of inhibitors targeting FATPs to treat related diseases.
title_zh: 人FATP2激活和转运脂肪酸的结构基础
abstract_zh: 脂肪酸转运蛋白 (FATP) 负责有效摄取脂肪酸 (FA)，脂肪酸是在发育和生长中发挥关键作用的重要生物分子。然而，FATP 三维结构的缺乏阻碍了我们对其机制的理解。在这里，我们报告了人类 FATP2a 的两种冷冻电镜结构：2.93 Å 处于中间状态的野生型 (WT) FATP2a 和 2.76 Å 处于预催化状态的 FATP2a 催化突变体。在这两种结构中，油酰-AMP中间体和ATP占据相同的中央口袋，油酰-AMP的酰基指向上方并置于疏水通道中，而ATP的磷酸基指向下方并与中央环相互作用。这些结构还表明，来自膜的 FA 必须经历两步易位才能进入催化中心。在完成工作循环之前新的 FA 的结合对于确保催化和运输效率可能至关重要。此外，我们证明 FATP2a 转运 FA 严格依赖于通过酰基辅酶 A 合成酶活性激活 FA。我们的研究结果为了解 FATP 的工作机制提供了重要的见解，并为开发针对 FATP 的抑制剂治疗相关疾病提供了结构基础。

title: Modulating pressure in the Orbitrap improves sensitivity and mass resolution in charge detection mass spectrometry
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Native mass spectrometry has become a key method for studying macromolecular assemblies, providing insights into structures, stoichiometries, and binding interactions. A key aspect for the transmission of electrospray-generated bioparticles into the mass analyzer is the use of gas for collisional cooling and ion desolvation. However, in Orbitrap-based mass spectrometry, the elevated pressure may negatively affect ions, as collisions with background gas can destabilize ion trajectories, potentially leading to incorrect mass determination. These effects are amplified when the pressure in the collision cell is high, as required for large biological assemblies, and when ions are measured for (ultra)long acquisition times in the Orbitrap, as required for high-resolution mass spectrometry. To address these issues, we modified a standard Q Exactive™ UHMR by installing a pulsed valve to control gas flow and limit gas leakage into the Orbitrap. This way, ion transmission and desolvation are maintained while the ultrahigh vacuum in the mass analyzer is enhanced during acquisition. We show that this improves ion detection of various assemblies, including adeno-associated viruses, IgM, and plasmid DNA, with superior mass accuracy and resolving power. The pulsed valve implementation will benefit nearly all mass measurements, setting the stage for next-generation Orbitrap-based, single-ion mass spectrometry.
title_zh: Orbitrap 中的调节压力可提高电荷检测质谱的灵敏度和质量分辨率
abstract_zh: 天然质谱已成为研究大分子组装体的关键方法，提供对结构、化学计量和结合相互作用的见解。将电喷雾产生的生物颗粒传输到质量分析器中的一个关键方面是使用气体进行碰撞冷却和离子去溶剂化。然而，在基于 Orbitrap 的质谱分析中，升高的压力可能会对离子产生负面影响，因为与背景气体的碰撞可能会破坏离子轨迹的稳定性，可能导致错误的质量测定。当碰撞池中的压力较高时（如大型生物组件的要求），以及当离子在 Orbitrap 中测量（超）长采集时间（如高分辨率质谱的要求）时，这些效应会被放大。为了解决这些问题，我们修改了标准 Q Exactive™ UHMR，安装脉冲阀来控制气体流量并限制气体泄漏到 Orbitrap 中。这样，离子传输和去溶剂化得以维持，同时质量分析器中的超高真空在采集过程中得到增强。我们表明，这改善了各种组装体的离子检测，包括腺相关病毒、IgM 和质粒 DNA，具有卓越的质量精度和分辨率。脉冲阀的实施将有利于几乎所有质量测量，为下一代基于 Orbitrap 的单离子质谱奠定了基础。

title: Triple-reaction-center catalysis drives simultaneous oxidation-reduction towards diverse emerging contaminants under oxidant-free conditions
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Precisely designed self-driven single-atom catalysts (SACs) can achieve efficient degradation of emerging contaminants (ECs) without oxidants addition, but such systems often exhibited selectivity limited to electron-donating ECs, lacking broad-spectrum degradation capability. To address this limitation, a triple-reaction-center catalyst (Co0/CoN2-SAC) is designed in this study, integrating an electron-deficient region based on carbon framework and an electron-enriched region featuring both metallic cobalt (Co0) and atomically dispersed CoN2 sites. The electron-deficient region facilitates ECs adsorption through π–π interactions, and the CoN2 sites in the electron-enriched region serve as electron acceptors, extracting electrons from electron-donating ECs. While the Co0 sites in the electron-deficient region serve as the electron donor for donating the electron towards electron-withdrawing ECs accompanying with reactive atomic hydrogen (H*) and •OH attacking, enabling efficient reductive degradation of electron-withdrawing ECs. As a result, the Co0/CoN2-SAC system exhibits broad-spectrum degradation capability for both electron-donating and electron-withdrawing ECs, whereas the acid-leached counterpart lacking Co0 shows activity solely toward electron-donating species. Elucidation of this simultaneous oxidation-reduction mechanism provides critical insights for the rational design of adaptive catalytic systems capable of treating complex wastewater matrices, ensuring robust contaminant removal across diverse industrial and municipal water treatment applications.
title_zh: 三反应中心催化在无氧化剂条件下驱动同时氧化还原多种新兴污染物
abstract_zh: 精确设计的自驱动单原子催化剂（SAC）可以在不添加氧化剂的情况下实现新兴污染物（EC）的高效降解，但此类系统通常表现出仅限于供电子EC的选择性，缺乏广谱降解能力。为了解决这一限制，本研究设计了一种三重反应中心催化剂（Co0/CoN2-SAC），集成了基于碳骨架的缺电子区域和具有金属钴（Co0）和原子分散的CoN2位点的富电子区域。缺电子区域通过π-π相互作用促进EC的吸附，而富电子区域中的CoN2位点充当电子受体，从供电子的EC中提取电子。而缺电子区的Co0位点作为电子供体，向吸电子EC提供电子，同时伴随活性原子氢(H*)和·OH的攻击，从而实现吸电子EC的有效还原降解。因此，Co0/CoN2-SAC 系统对给电子和吸电子 EC 均表现出广谱降解能力，而缺乏 Co0 的酸浸对应物仅对给电子物质表现出活性。阐明这种同时氧化还原机制为合理设计能够处理复杂废水基质的自适应催化系统提供了重要见解，确保在不同的工业和市政水处理应用中稳健地去除污染物。

title: High costs of capital shape the mitigation effects of renewable energy deployment globally
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: High costs of capital are a major barrier to renewables deployment in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), impeding decarbonisation efforts despite strong renewable resources. Using grid carbon intensity trajectories, we show that renewable deployment in LMICs has mitigation potentials over 20 times larger per project than high-income countries, even before accounting for planned fossil projects. High costs of capital increase renewable levelised costs of electricity (LCOEs) in LMICs substantially, adding an average of US$26/MWh (solar) and US$24/MWh (onshore wind) relative to high-income financing terms. Financing costs account for up to 78% of the LCOE in LMICs, compared with 37-39% in high-income countries, restricting a large portion of global renewable potential. Under a scenario consistent with the target of tripling global renewable capacity by 2030, this corresponds to additional annual costs of US$245bn (solar) and US$329bn (wind). Our results highlight the importance of reducing financing costs in LMICs for a more equitable and efficient energy transition.
title_zh: 高资本成本影响全球可再生能源部署的缓解效果
abstract_zh: 尽管可再生资源丰富，但高资本成本是低收入和中等收入国家（LMIC）部署可再生能源的主要障碍，阻碍了脱碳工作。利用电网碳强度轨迹，我们发现中低收入国家的可再生能源部署的每个项目的减排潜力比高收入国家大 20 倍以上，甚至在考虑计划中的化石燃料项目之前也是如此。高资本成本大幅增加了中低收入国家的可再生能源平准化电力成本 (LCOE)，相对于高收入融资条件，平均增加了 26 美元/兆瓦时（太阳能）和 24 美元/兆瓦时（陆上风电）。融资成本占中低收入国家 LCOE 的比例高达 78%，而高收入国家这一比例为 37-39%，限制了全球可再生能源潜力的很大一部分。在与到 2030 年全球可再生能源发电量增加两倍的目标一致的情况下，这相当于每年增加 2,450 亿美元（太阳能）和 3,290 亿美元（风能）的成本。我们的结果凸显了降低中低收入国家融资成本以实现更加公平和高效的能源转型的重要性。

title: Commensal bacteria inhibit viral infections via a tryptophan metabolite
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Clinical outcomes following viral exposures exhibit substantial interindividual variability. Although developing evidence suggests commensal bacteria modulate viral infections, the specific bacteria and mechanisms remain underexplored. Here, we define a pathway by which viral infections are inhibited by specific tryptophan-catabolizing bacteria. Using HIV as a model, we bioinformatically associated and experimentally validated several bacterial species that inhibited viral replication. This activity required the aromatic amino acid aminotransferase (ArAT) to metabolize tryptophan into 3-indolelactic acid, which agonizes the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR). Given that AhR regulates multiple viral infections, we found that commensal bacteria also inhibit cytomegalovirus (CMV) in an ArAT-dependent manner. Finally, we used fecal shotgun metagenomic data to confirm that ArAT is associated with improved disease outcomes in three distinct human cohorts at-risk for HIV, CMV, or symptomatic COVID-19. Taken together, our results provide mechanistic insight into how commensal bacteria impact viral infections, thereby adding to an emerging field focused on host–commensal–virus interactions.
title_zh: 共生细菌通过色氨酸代谢物抑制病毒感染
abstract_zh: 病毒暴露后的临床结果表现出显着的个体差异。尽管越来越多的证据表明共生细菌可以调节病毒感染，但具体的细菌和机制仍未得到充分探索。在这里，我们定义了特定色氨酸分解代谢细菌抑制病毒感染的途径。我们以艾滋病毒为模型，通过生物信息学方法关联并实验验证了几种抑制病毒复制的细菌物种。该活性需要芳香族氨基酸转氨酶 (ArAT) 将色氨酸代谢为 3-吲哚乳酸，从而激动芳基烃受体 (AhR)。鉴于 AhR 调节多种病毒感染，我们发现共生细菌也以 ArAT 依赖性方式抑制巨细胞病毒 (CMV)。最后，我们使用粪便鸟枪法宏基因组数据证实，ArAT 与三个不同的 HIV、CMV 或有症状的 COVID-19 风险人群的疾病结果改善相关。总而言之，我们的结果提供了共生细菌如何影响病毒感染的机制见解，从而增加了一个专注于宿主-共生-病毒相互作用的新兴领域。

title: Assessing molecular, cellular and transcriptomic bases of laminar perfusion and cytoarchitecture coupling in the human cortex
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Understanding how cellular architecture shapes cortical function requires mesoscopic approaches that resolve structure-function relationships in vivo. Here we introduce the cerebral blood flow (CBF) – cell-body staining intensity (CSI) similarity index (CCSI), a quantitative measure of laminar perfusion-cytoarchitecture coupling derived from whole-brain 1-mm isotropic 7 T arterial spin labeling and cell-body staining intensity profiles from the BigBrain atlas. Across 30 participants, CCSI revealed reproducible, region-specific alignment between laminar perfusion and cellular density distributions. CCSI was selectively associated with mitochondrial respiratory capacity per mitochondrion and colocalized with capillary endothelial and end-state oligodendrocyte populations. Gene ontology enrichment converged on metabolic regulation, neurovascular organization, and mitochondrial homeostasis. A parallel control analysis using quantitative T1 yielded no significant associations, supporting the specificity of these findings. At the systems level, CCSI improved structure-function gradient correspondence in higher-hierarchy association cortices. These results support CCSI as a reproducible, non-invasive mesoscopic index linking cortical perfusion, microstructure, and metabolism.
title_zh: 评估人类皮质层流灌注和细胞结构耦合的分子、细胞和转录组学基础
abstract_zh: 了解细胞结构如何塑造皮质功能需要介观方法来解决体内结构与功能的关系。在这里，我们介绍脑血流量 (CBF) – 细胞体染色强度 (CSI) 相似性指数 (CCSI)，这是层流灌注-细胞结构耦合的定量测量，源自全脑 1-mm 各向同性 7 T 动脉自旋标记和 BigBrain 图谱的细胞体染色强度剖面。在 30 名参与者中，CCSI 揭示了层流灌注和细胞密度分布之间可重复的、区域特异性的一致性。 CCSI 选择性地与每个线粒体的线粒体呼吸能力相关，并与毛细血管内皮细胞和终态少突胶质细胞群共定位。基因本体丰富集中于代谢调节、神经血管组织和线粒体稳态。使用定量 T1 的平行对照分析没有产生显着的关联，支持了这些发现的特异性。在系统层面，CCSI 改进了更高层次关联皮质中的结构-功能梯度对应关系。这些结果支持 CCSI 作为一种可重复的、非侵入性的介观指数，将皮质灌注、微观结构和代谢联系起来。

title: Hypothalamic prolactin receptor+ dopaminergic neurons regulate energy metabolism and nociceptive threshold in mice during lactation
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Women during lactation undergo significant bone loss and metabolic changes. However, the underlying mechanisms in the brain remain unclear. Herein, we found that prolactin receptor (PRLR)+ neurons in the hypothalamus control lactation physiology and metabolism in mice. Prolactin induces tyrosine hydroxylase (Th) expression in PRLR+ dopaminergic neurons of the arcuate nucleus (ARC). Interestingly, neuropeptide Y (NPY) expression was elevated to alter energy demand and nociceptive threshold during lactation. Knocking down either PRLR or NPY in the ARC significantly reduced food demand and nociceptive threshold. Importantly, in addition, prolactin also induces Th expression in the hypothalamic paraventricular nucleus (PVN) to increase sympathetic outflow to mobilize Ca2+ in bone. Importantly, brain-derived osteoanabolic hormone communication network factor 3 (CCN3) is downstream of PRLR signaling in the dopaminergic neurons. Thus, hypothalamic PRLR+ neurons identified in the current study regulate bone and fat metabolism, nociceptive threshold, and energy demand in mice during lactation.
title_zh: 下丘脑催乳素受体+多巴胺能神经元调节小鼠哺乳期能量代谢和伤害性阈值
abstract_zh: 哺乳期的女性会经历显着的骨质流失和代谢变化。然而，大脑中的潜在机制仍不清楚。在此，我们发现下丘脑中的催乳素受体（PRLR）+神经元控制小鼠的泌乳生理和代谢。催乳素诱导弓状核 (ARC) 的 PRLR+ 多巴胺能神经元中酪氨酸羟化酶 (Th) 的表达。有趣的是，神经肽 Y (NPY) 表达升高会改变哺乳期间的能量需求和伤害性阈值。降低 ARC 中的 PRLR 或 NPY 显着降低食物需求和伤害阈值。此外，重要的是，催乳素还可诱导下丘脑室旁核 (PVN) 中 Th 的表达，从而增加交感神经流出，从而动员骨中的 Ca2+。重要的是，脑源性骨合成代谢激素通讯网络因子 3 (CCN3) 是多巴胺能神经元中 PRLR 信号传导的下游。因此，当前研究中发现的下丘脑 PRLR+ 神经元调节小鼠哺乳期间的骨和脂肪代谢、伤害感受阈值和能量需求。

title: The transmission-blocking dynamics of Plasmodium falciparum sexual-stage antibody responses in a six-year cohort of Ugandan children and adults
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Individuals naturally infected with Plasmodium can develop antibodies against the parasite’s sexual stages that may inhibit onward transmission when ingested they are during a mosquito vector’s blood meal. Our study reports immune signatures and longitudinal dynamics of naturally occurring transmission-reducing activity (TRA) in a Ugandan cohort. Combining data from 611 standard membrane feeding assays and up to 18 assessments per individual, we show that TRA arose naturally and persisted in a minority of naturally exposed individuals. We also show that prior history of parasite exposure is positively related to both TRA and antibodies against P. falciparum sexual-stage antigens. Antibodies against Pfs48/45 and Pfs230 appeared relatively short-lived and associated with high-level TRA. Finally, we report that naturally acquired antibodies against a further thirteen sexual-stage antigens are associated with high-level TRA. Together, our analysis shows that naturally acquired sexual-stage immune responses are dynamic and can inhibit onward parasite transmission.
title_zh: 乌干达儿童和成人六年队列中恶性疟原虫性阶段抗体反应的传播阻断动态
abstract_zh: 自然感染疟原虫的个体可以产生针对寄生虫性阶段的抗体，当他们在蚊子媒介的吸血过程中摄入这些抗体时，可能会抑制进一步传播。我们的研究报告了乌干达队列中自然发生的传播减少活性（TRA）的免疫特征和纵向动态。结合 611 项标准膜喂养测定和每个个体多达 18 次评估的数据，我们表明 TRA 自然产生并在少数自然暴露的个体中持续存在。我们还表明，既往寄生虫暴露史与 TRA 和针对恶性疟原虫性阶段抗原的抗体呈正相关。针对 Pfs48/45 和 Pfs230 的抗体似乎寿命相对较短，并且与高水平 TRA 相关。最后，我们报告说，自然获得的针对另外 13 种性阶段抗原的抗体与高水平 TRA 相关。总之，我们的分析表明，自然获得的性阶段免疫反应是动态的，可以抑制寄生虫的进一步传播。

title: Pop Rocks-Inspired Bubble Driven Exosome Propulsion via Microneedles for Synergistic Wound Healing
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Chronic nonhealing wounds remain a critical clinical challenge due to persistent bacterial infection, tissue hypoxia, and impaired cellular regeneration. Herein, inspired by the “popping” mechanism of Pop Rocks candy, we developed a multifunctional microneedle (MN) patch (Exo/ONB-MN) that integrates antibacterial hyperbranched polymer (HBPLT), mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomes (MSC-Exos), and oxygen nanobubbles (ONBs) into a single dissolvable platform. The HBPLT component provides potent broad-spectrum antibacterial activity through physical membrane disruption. Upon application, ONBs embedded in the needle bases explosively release oxygen, generating a directional pressure wave that actively propels exosomes from the needle tips deep into the wound bed—a mechanism termed bubble-driven exosome propulsion. Concurrently, oxygen release alleviates local hypoxia, enhancing exosome uptake and amplifying their proregenerative effects. In vitro studies demonstrated that the Exo/ONB-MN patch significantly promoted fibroblast proliferation and migration while achieving near-complete eradication of Staphylococcus aureus and Escherichia coli. In an S. aureus-infected full-thickness wound mouse model, the patch accelerated wound closure to nearly 100% within 14 days, promoted organized collagen deposition, reduced pro-inflammatory cytokine expression, and induced a phenotypic switch from M1 to M2 macrophages. This Pop Rocks-inspired platform addresses the key pathological barriers of chronic wounds—infection, hypoxia, and impaired healing—through a synergistic, all-in-one strategy, offering a promising and translatable approach for advanced wound management.
title_zh: 流行摇滚启发的气泡驱动外泌体通过微针推进以实现协同伤口愈合
abstract_zh: 摘要 由于持续的细菌感染、组织缺氧和细胞再生受损，慢性不愈合伤口仍然是一个严峻的临床挑战。在此，受 Pop Rocks 糖果“爆裂”机制的启发，我们开发了一种多功能微针 (MN) 贴片 (Exo/ONB-MN)，它将抗菌超支化聚合物 (HBPLT)、间充质干细胞衍生的外泌体 (MSC-Exos) 和氧纳米气泡 (ONB) 集成到单个可溶解平台中。 HBPLT 成分通过物理膜破坏提供有效的广谱抗菌活性。使用后，嵌入针基部的 ONB 会爆炸性释放氧气，产生定向压力波，主动将外泌体从针尖深入伤口床，这种机制称为气泡驱动外泌体推进。同时，氧气释放可缓解局部缺氧，增强外泌体的吸收并增强其促再生作用。体外研究表明，Exo/ONB-MN 贴片显着促进成纤维细胞增殖和迁移，同时几乎完全根除金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌。在金黄色葡萄球菌感染的全层伤口小鼠模型中，该贴片在 14 天内加速伤口闭合至近 100%，促进有组织的胶原蛋白沉积，减少促炎细胞因子的表达，并诱导从 M1 巨噬细胞向 M2 巨噬细胞的表型转变。这个受流行摇滚启发的平台通过协同、全面的方法解决了慢性伤口的关键病理障碍——感染、缺氧和愈合受损。

title: Peelable Antifouling Coating Based on Slow-Curing Polyurea
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Marine biofouling on the surface of underwater equipment severely impairs its operation. Conventional antifouling coatings can prevent biofouling; however, the removal of failed or temporary coatings during equipment repair is difficult and may damage the equipment surface. Herein, we report an antifouling coating consisting of polyaspartic ester-based polyurea modified with secondary amine oligosiloxane nanoclusters (NSs) as a crosslinker and a diisocyanate-terminated reactive amphiphilic polymer (RAP). In the resulting slow-curing polyurea coating, the RAP with low-surface-energy fluorinated side chains and polyethylene glycol (PEG) side chains migrates to the coating surface during drying, allowing PEG to inhibit biofouling. The coating demonstrates satisfactory adhesion strength (2–8 MPa) on diverse substrates, including steel, ceramic, copper, glass, and epoxy panels, as well as >90% reduction in fibrinogen adsorption and relative bacterial adhesion values below 10% against S. aureus, E. coli, and P. sp. In addition, the coating exhibits high cohesive strength and moderate interface adhesion. As a result, it can be readily peeled from various surfaces with a peel strength of 1–9 N·cm–1 without damaging the equipment surface. This polyurea coating demonstrates promising application potential as an antibiofouling coating for marine environments.
title_zh: 基于慢固化聚脲的可剥离防污涂料
abstract_zh: 摘要 水下设备表面的海洋生物污垢严重影响其运行。传统的防污涂料可以防止生物污损；然而，在设备维修过程中去除失效或临时涂层很困难，并且可能会损坏设备表面。在此，我们报道了一种防污涂料，由以仲胺低聚硅氧烷纳米簇（NSs）作为交联剂改性的聚天冬氨酸酯基聚脲和二异氰酸酯封端的反应性两亲聚合物（RAP）组成。在所得的慢固化聚脲涂层中，具有低表面能氟化侧链和聚乙二醇（PEG）侧链的RAP在干燥过程中迁移到涂层表面，使PEG能够抑制生物污垢。该涂层在不同基材（包括钢、陶瓷、铜、玻璃和环氧板）上表现出令人满意的粘附强度（2-8 MPa），并且对金黄色葡萄球菌、大肠杆菌和 P. sp 的纤维蛋白原吸附降低了 90% 以上，相对细菌粘附值低于 10%。此外，涂层具有高内聚强度和适度的界面附着力。因此，它可以很容易地从各种表面剥离，剥离强度为1-9 N·cm-1，而不损坏设备表面。这种聚脲涂层显示出作为海洋环境抗生物污损涂层的广阔应用潜力。

title: Integrating Long-Lasting Underwater Lubrication and Anti-Microbial Corrosion into A Semi-Solid Emulsion System Using Cu2O Nanosheet Surfactants
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Nanoparticle surfactants have shown great potential for developing semi-solid Pickering emulsion gels (PEGs), but achieving the application of gels under harsh marine conditions remains a challenge. Herein, water-in-oil lubricating and anti-microbial corrosion PEGs prepared by a simple and universal method are proposed. The mean coefficient of friction (CoF) of PEGs in artificial seawater is as low as 0.066, even after 719,300 friction cycles and under an external normal load of up to 200 N. Additionally, the PEGs containing amphiphilic Cu2O nanosheets (AC-NSs) exhibit outstanding long-lasting antibacterial activity against both Gram-positive (S. aureus) and Gram-negative (P. aeruginosa) bacteria, achieving antibacterial rates of 97.5 and 93.7% after 30 days, respectively. Notably, the PEGs establish anti-microbial corrosion protection through a synergistic effect of anti-swelling properties, physical barrier effects, and antibacterial activity. This work is anticipated to provide an effective strategy for constructing semi-solid emulsion systems using nanoparticle surfactants to achieve long-lasting lubrication and anti-microbial corrosion capabilities that prevent failure in marine equipment.
title_zh: 使用 Cu2O 纳米片表面活性剂将持久水下润滑和抗微生物腐蚀集成到半固体乳液体系中
abstract_zh: 摘要 纳米颗粒表面活性剂在开发半固体Pickering乳液凝胶（PEG）方面显示出巨大的潜力，但在恶劣的海洋条件下实现凝胶的应用仍然是一个挑战。在此，提出了一种通过简单且通用的方法制备的油包水润滑和抗微生物腐蚀的PEG。即使经过 719,300 次摩擦循环和高达 200 N 的外部正常载荷，PEG 在人造海水中的平均摩擦系数 (CoF) 仍低至 0.066。此外，含有两亲性 Cu2O 纳米片 (AC-NSs) 的 PEG 对革兰氏阳性菌 (S. aureus) 和革兰氏阴性菌 (P. aeruginosa) 均表现出出色的持久抗菌活性，实现了30天后抗菌率分别为97.5%和93.7%。值得注意的是，PEG 通过抗膨胀特性、物理屏障效应和抗菌活性的协同效应建立抗微生物腐蚀保护。这项工作预计将为使用纳米颗粒表面活性剂构建半固体乳液系统提供有效的策略，以实现持久的润滑和抗微生物腐蚀能力，从而防止船舶设备发生故障。

title: Oxidative Electrochemical Coupling Between Bi and Mn in Rechargeable Alkaline MnO2 Cathodes
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The Bi-modified MnO2 cathode is an enabling technology for rechargeable alkaline Zn batteries, which are under intense study for low-cost, sustainable, non-flammable grid-scale energy storage. Although the effect of Bi on MnO2 rechargeability has been known for decades, its mechanism has remained a longstanding challenge in the field. Here, we detail an oxidative electrochemical coupling between Bi and Mn in electrodes of commercially relevant areal capacity (12 mAh/cm2). Specifically, operando X-ray absorption spectroscopy and differential capacity analysis reveal that electrochemical capacity associated with Bi oxidation is shifted up into a voltage range where only Mn oxidation is expected. This oxidative coupling occurs precisely when failure by Mn3O4 formation is known to occur in the absence of Bi, and coincides with the potential range at which the β′-MnOOH intermediate exists during charge. The stabilization of β′-MnOOH by Bi-Mn coupling reveals its critical role in rechargeability, as this intermediate is the primary material source of Mn3O4 in unmodified electrodes. Only a small fraction of the total Bi capacity, corresponding to approximately 2 wt % Bi2O3, participates in this coupling, and it is demonstrated that the overall extent of rechargeability is controlled by the diffusion of dissolved Bi ions through the microporous structure of the MnO2 active material. Consistent with this transport-limited scenario, structurally incorporating Bi3+ directly into the MnO2 lattice is shown to be counterproductive, as it pillars the structure and impedes the electrochemical conversion it was intended to assist.
title_zh: 可充电碱性 MnO2 阴极中 Bi 和 Mn 之间的氧化电化学耦合
abstract_zh: 摘要 Bi改性MnO2阴极是可充电碱性锌电池的一项使能技术，目前正在深入研究低成本、可持续、不易燃的电网规模储能技术。尽管 Bi 对 MnO2 可充电性的影响已为人所知数十年，但其机制仍然是该领域长期面临的挑战。在这里，我们详细介绍了具有商业相关面积容量（12 mAh/cm2）的电极中 Bi 和 Mn 之间的氧化电化学耦合。具体来说，原位 X 射线吸收光谱和微分容量分析表明，与 Bi 氧化相关的电化学容量转移到预计仅发生 Mn 氧化的电压范围。当已知在没有 Bi 的情况下发生 Mn3O4 形成失败时，这种氧化偶联就会精确发生，并且与充电过程中 β'-MnOOH 中间体存在的电位范围一致。 Bi-Mn 偶联对 β'-MnOOH 的稳定作用揭示了其在可充电性中的关键作用，因为这种中间体是未改性电极中 Mn3O4 的主要材料来源。只有总 Bi 容量的一小部分（相当于大约 2 wt% Bi2O3）参与了这种耦合，并且证明了可充电性的总体程度是由溶解的 Bi 离子通过 MnO2 活性材料的微孔结构扩散来控制的。与这种传输受限的情况一致，在结构上将 Bi3+ 直接纳入 MnO2 晶格中被证明会适得其反，因为它支撑结构并阻碍电子

title: Defect Engineering of Mott–Schottky Heterostructure for Flexible High-Performance Energy Storage
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Nickel-based transition metal selenides are promising hybrid supercapacitor (HSC) cathodes owing to their high capacity yet suffer from structural degradation, poor conductivity, and sluggish charge transfer, limiting cycling stability and rate performance. Herein, this study employs a synergistic approach by engineering a built-in electric field (BIEF) and Se vacancies in the NiSe2@FeSe(VNSFS) Mott–Schottky heterojunction that enhances structural integrity during the intercalation/deintercalation of electrolyte ions, promotes faster ion diffusion kinetics, induces large electroactive sites, and reduces the activation energy barrier. In situ/ex situ analyses and galvanostatic intermittent titration technique confirm enhanced ion diffusion, while DRT analysis evidences improved charge transfer dynamics. Furthermore, a quasi-solid-state VNSFS//AC flexible HSC delivers a high energy density of 94.17 Wh kg–1, without compensating power density of 750 W kg–1, with prolonged stability of 50,000 cycles. The device advances sustainability by integrating a commercial solar module for energy harvesting and storage, enabling ∼2 min charging to power various electronic devices while supporting wireless charging and efficient AC-filtering. Thus, this work offers high-safety and flexible energy storage devices.
title_zh: 用于柔性高性能储能的莫特-肖特基异质结构的缺陷工程
abstract_zh: 摘要 镍基过渡金属硒化物由于其高容量而成为有前途的混合超级电容器（HSC）阴极，但其结构退化、导电性差和电荷转移缓慢，限制了循环稳定性和倍率性能。在此，本研究采用协同方法，在 NiSe2@FeSe(VNSFS) 莫特肖特基异质结中设计内置电场 (BIEF) 和 Se 空位，增强电解质离子嵌入/脱嵌过程中的结构完整性，促进更快的离子扩散动力学，诱导大的电活性位点，并降低激活能垒。原位/异位分析和恒电流间歇滴定技术证实了离子扩散的增强，而 DRT 分析则证明了电荷转移动力学的改善。此外，准固态VNSFS//AC柔性HSC可提供94.17 Wh kg-1的高能量密度，无需补偿功率密度为750 W kg-1，并具有5​​0,000次循环的长期稳定性。该设备通过集成用于能量收集和存储的商用太阳能模块来提高可持续性，能够在 2 分钟内充电为各种电子设备供电，同时支持无线充电和高效的交流滤波。因此，这项工作提供了高安全性和灵活的储能装置。

title: Bioinspired Magnetic Vision Synapse for Near-Sensor In-Memory Magnetic Information Encoding
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Animals use magnetoreception to sense magnetic cues for orientation and navigation.1 Inspired by this capability, artificial magnetic sensory hardware requires not only magnetic-field readout, but also a route for converting magnetic stimuli into internal device states that retain information about the input history. Here, we demonstrate a coupled magnetoelectric (ME)−VO2 magnetic-synapse prototype for magnetic-field-driven conductance-state modulation. A Metglas/PMN-PT/Metglas ME front end converts AC magnetic stimuli into voltage signals, which are processed through a signal-conditioning pathway and applied to the gate of an ionic-gel-gated VO2 transistor. The resulting gate modulation changes the VO2 channel conductance through volatile electrostatic modulation and more persistent proton-mediated electrochemical modulation. Under magnetic-field-pulse inputs, the coupled prototype exhibits transient current response, paired-pulse facilitation, and a transition from short-term to long-term plasticity, indicating that the VO2 conductance state can encode the amplitude, duration, and temporal history of magnetic stimuli. We further show that the ME front end can reconstruct a two-dimensional magnetic-field pattern generated by a coil array, providing a spatial magnetic input source for subsequent conductance-state encoding. This work should therefore be regarded as a prototype demonstration of magnetic-input-driven conductance modulation and conductance-state-based encoding, rather than a fully integrated magnetic-vision or autonomous neuromorphic computing system. The results suggest a possible route toward device-level front-end processing of magnetic information, while monolithic integration, low-power signal conditioning, and array-level implementation remain important directions for future development.
title_zh: 用于近传感器内存磁信息编码的仿生磁视觉突触
abstract_zh: 摘要 动物利用磁感受来感知磁线索，以进行定向和导航。1 受此功能的启发，人造磁传感硬件不仅需要磁场读出，还需要一种将磁刺激转换为保留输入历史信息的内部设备状态的路径。在这里，我们展示了用于磁场驱动电导状态调制的耦合磁电 (ME)−VO2 磁突触原型。 Metglas/PMN-PT/Metglas ME 前端将交流磁刺激转换为电压信号，该信号通过信号调节路径进行处理，并应用于离子凝胶门控 VO2 晶体管的栅极。由此产生的栅极调制通过挥发性静电调制和更持久的质子介导的电化学调制改变 VO2 通道电导。在磁场脉冲输入下，耦合原型表现出瞬态电流响应、成对脉冲促进以及从短期到长期可塑性的转变，表明 VO2 电导状态可以编码磁刺激的幅度、持续时间和时间历史。我们进一步表明，ME 前端可以重建由线圈阵列生成的二维磁场图案，为后续的电导状态编码提供空间磁输入源。因此，这项工作应被视为磁输入驱动的电导调制和基于电导状态的编码的原型演示，而不是完全集成的磁视觉或自主神经形态计算系统。

title: Slow growth as a strategy for plant longevity
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Ecological theories predict a fundamental trade-off between fast growth and the probability of achieving longevity, with far-reaching consequences for ecosystem resilience and carbon residence time. Tree-ring studies have revealed a globally consistent negative relationship between growth rate and lifespan, yet comparable large-scale evidence for such trade-offs beyond trees remains scarce, largely due to methodological limitations. Here, we exploit annual growth rings formed by secondary thickening in perennial herbaceous plants to test whether the growth–longevity trade-off represents a widespread axis of plant strategies extending across life forms. Using an extensive dataset of over 3100 herbaceous and small woody species, including lianas, sampled across five continents and ecosystems ranging from the Arctic to hot semideserts, we reveal a robust association between slow growth and longevity across life forms and environmental conditions. Moreover, the growth rate exhibited a strong temperature dependence, giving rise to an apparent longevity–temperature relationship, highlighting ecological relevance of growth–longevity coupling. Together, our findings identify the growth–longevity trade-off as a widespread constraint on plant strategies, with important implications for predicting vegetation dynamics, ecosystem stability, and the persistence of terrestrial carbon storage in a changing climate.
title_zh: 缓慢生长是植物长寿的策略
abstract_zh: 生态理论预测快速增长和实现长寿的可能性之间存在根本性的权衡，这对生态系统的恢复力和碳停留时间产生深远的影响。树木年轮研究揭示了生长率和寿命之间全球一致的负相关关系，但树木以外的这种权衡的可比大规模证据仍然很少，这主要是由于方法学的局限性。在这里，我们利用多年生草本植物二次增厚形成的年轮来测试生长与寿命的权衡是否代表了跨生命形式的植物策略的广泛轴。我们利用从五大洲和从北极到炎热的半沙漠的生态系统采样的超过 3100 种草本和小型木本物种（包括藤本植物）的广泛数据集，揭示了不同生命形式和环境条件下的缓慢生长与长寿之间的紧密关联。此外，生长速率表现出强烈的温度依赖性，产生明显的寿命-温度关系，凸显了生长-寿命耦合的生态相关性。总之，我们的研究结果表明，生长与寿命的权衡是对植物策略的广泛限制，对于预测植被动态、生态系统稳定性以及气候变化中陆地碳储存的持久性具有重要意义。

title: Reciprocal Coupling among Extracellular Matrix Mechanics, Mechanosensitive Ion Channels, and Cell Remodeling Behaviors
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Cells actively remodel the extracellular matrix (ECM) through a repertoire of mechanically driven behaviors, including traction force generation, migration, proteolysis, and long-term deposition. While these processes are often discussed separately, emerging evidence suggests that they are coordinated through shared mechanochemical signaling modules. In parallel, advances in hydrogel-based biomaterials have revealed that ECM mechanics, including stiffness, viscoelastic dissipation, degradability, and temporal dynamics, can systematically program cellular remodeling behaviors. In this review, we discuss the close interplay among ECM mechanics, mechanosensitive ion channels, and cell remodeling behaviors, with particular emphasis on ion channels as mechanochemical control nodes that connect material-defined mechanical cues to cytoskeletal tension, adhesion dynamics, and transcriptional reprogramming. Focusing on Piezo1, TRPV4, TRPM7, and TRPC6, we discuss how localized Ca2+ entry events decode extracellular mechanics into behavior-specific outputs across distinct remodeling modalities. We further discuss how engineered hydrogels define the mechanical environment that shapes channel-mediated signaling, thereby shaping when, where, and how ECM remodeling occurs. Together, this perspective positions mechanosensitive ion channels as a mechanochemical control layer that links dynamic material environments to coordinated cellular behaviors, highlighting their relevance to the design of biomaterials that actively direct tissue remodeling.
title_zh: 细胞外基质力学、机械敏感离子通道和细胞重塑行为之间的相互耦合
abstract_zh: 摘要 细胞通过一系列机械驱动行为主动重塑细胞外基质 (ECM)，包括牵引力产生、迁移、蛋白水解和长期沉积。虽然这些过程经常被单独讨论，但新出现的证据表明它们是通过共享的机械化学信号模块进行协调的。与此同时，基于水凝胶的生物材料的进展表明，ECM 力学，包括刚度、粘弹性耗散、降解性和时间动力学，可以系统地编程细胞重塑行为。在这篇综述中，我们讨论了 ECM 力学、机械敏感离子通道和细胞重塑行为之间的密切相互作用，特别强调离子通道作为机械化学控制节点，将材料定义的机械线索与细胞骨架张力、粘附动力学和转录重编程连接起来。我们重点关注 Piezo1、TRPV4、TRPM7 和 TRPC6，讨论局部 Ca2+ 进入事件如何通过不同的重塑模式将细胞外力学解码为行为特定的输出。我们进一步讨论工程水凝胶如何定义塑造通道介导信号传导的机械环境，从而塑造 ECM 重塑发生的时间、地点和方式。总之，这种观点将机械敏感离子通道定位为机械化学控制层，将动态材料环境与协调的细胞行为联系起来，突出了它们与主动指导组织重塑的生物材料设计的相关性。

title: Smart Biomimetic Microswimmers with Adaptive, Environmentally Responsive Motion
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Microswimmers have been designed to convert various forms of energy to mechanical motion. Their development has been driven by the desire to mimic the motion of biological systems as well as their many potential applications in sensing, drug delivery and environmental remediation. Chemically propelled swimmers show particular promise as microenvironmental sensors. While most current systems utilize metallic structures and hydrogen peroxide fuel, more biomimetic systems would employ organic fuels and possess soft, flexible bodies. Here, we report the development of autonomous soft microgel swimmers powered by the Belousov-Zhabotinsky (BZ) reaction, a nonlinear oscillatory reaction reminiscent of those utilized in biological systems, which consumes organic fuel and actuates motion via chemical waves. We demonstrate that these swimmers exhibit size-dependent and environmentally responsive motion, in which chemical wave patterns and propulsion characteristics systematically vary with chemical environment and microgel diameter. These smart swimmers adapt to variations in chemical inputs in either the reductant or oxidant concentrations, process them via the progress of the chemical reaction, and display multiple outputs, including variations in wave patterns, wave propagation speed, oscillation period, wavelength, and overall swimmer speed. This work establishes a versatile platform for soft, responsive microswimmers capable of complex, environment-responsive behaviors with relevance to adaptive soft robotics and to the future development of motility based chemical sensors.
title_zh: 具有自适应、环境响应运动的智能仿生微型游泳器
abstract_zh: 摘要 微型游泳器被设计用于将各种形式的能量转换为机械运动。它们的发展是由模拟生物系统运动的愿望及其在传感、药物输送和环境修复方面的许多潜在应用推动的。化学驱动的游泳器作为微环境传感器显示出特别的前景。虽然大多数当前系统使用金属结构和过氧化氢燃料，但更多仿生系统将使用有机燃料并拥有柔软、灵活的身体。在这里，我们报告了由 Belousov-Zhabotinsky (BZ) 反应驱动的自主软微凝胶游泳器的开发，这是一种非线性振荡反应，让人想起生物系统中使用的反应，它消耗有机燃料并通过化学波驱动运动。我们证明这些游泳者表现出尺寸依赖性和环境响应性运动，其中化学波模式和推进特性随着化学环境和微凝胶直径而系统地变化。这些智能游泳器适应还原剂或氧化剂浓度的化学输入的变化，通过化学反应的进程对其进行处理，并显示多个输出，包括波型、波传播速度、振荡周期、波长和整体游泳器速度的变化。这项工作为柔软、反应灵敏的微型游泳者建立了一个多功能平台，能够执行复杂的、环境响应的行为，与自适应软机器人技术和基于运动的化学传感器的未来发展相关

title: Bridging Mode-Specific Performance Gaps in Organic Charge-Modulated Transistor Platforms via Coupled Interfacial Boundary Engineering
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Organic charge-modulated field-effect transistors (OCMFETs) offer a powerful route to charge/potential-amplified sensing, yet their induced-gating operation readily magnifies dielectric/interfacial nonidealities, causing key metrics—field-effect mobility (μFET), threshold voltage (Vth), and subthreshold swing (SS)—to decouple from those obtained in organic field-effect transistor (OFET) mode on the same platform. Here, we establish a design framework that co-regulates dielectric bulk properties and the electrical boundary conditions at the dielectric/organic semiconductor interface to align effective gating across operational modes. By tuning the anodizing voltage, the thickness, surface state, and dielectric/insulating characteristics of anodized aluminum oxide (AlOx) are systematically controlled, while a tetradecylphosphonic acid (TDPA) self-assembled monolayer (SAM) suppresses surface polarity and trap-associated charge instability. Quantifying the mismatch as ΔμFET, ΔVth, and ΔSS (= OCMFET−OFET), we find that TDPA-SAM reduces both the magnitude and dispersion of Δ(parameters), indicating convergence of effective gating between induced and direct gating. Transfer hysteresis and bias-stress-induced drain current decay and threshold-voltage drift are concurrently alleviated. These results show that combining bulk dielectric control (thickness) with interfacial boundary-condition engineering converts the structural sensitivity of OCMFETs into a manageable design variable, thereby minimizing OFET−OCMFET performance mismatch and improving the reproducibility and interpretability of multimode transistor-based sensor platforms.
title_zh: 通过耦合界面边界工程弥合有机电荷调制晶体管平台中模式特定的性能差距
abstract_zh: 摘要：有机电荷调制场效应晶体管 (OCMFET) 为电荷/电势放大传感提供了强大的途径，但其感应栅极操作很容易放大介电/界面的非理想性，导致关键指标——场效应迁移率 (μFET)、阈值电压 (Vth) 和亚阈值摆幅 (SS)——与同一平台上有机场效应晶体管 (OFET) 模式获得的指标脱钩。在这里，我们建立了一个设计框架，共同调节介电体特性和介电/有机半导体界面的电气边界条件，以调整跨操作模式的有效选通。通过调节阳极氧化电压，可以系统地控制阳极氧化氧化铝 (AlOx) 的厚度、表面状态和介电/绝缘特性，而十四烷基膦酸 (TDPA) 自组装单层 (SAM) 则可抑制表面极性和与陷阱相关的电荷不稳定性。将失配量化为 ΔμFET、ΔVth 和 ΔSS (= OCMFET−OFET)，我们发现 TDPA-SAM 降低了 Δ（参数）的幅度和离散度，表明感应门控和直接门控之间有效门控的收敛。传输滞后和偏置应力引起的漏极电流衰减以及阈值电压漂移同时得到缓解。这些结果表明，将体介电控制（厚度）与界面边界条件工程相结合，可将 OCMFET 的结构敏感性转化为可管理的设计变量，从而最大限度地减少 OFET−OCMFET 性能失配，并提高再现性和完整性。

title: Synergistic Strategy of Oriented Structure and Nanofillers for High-Performance Triboelectric Composites in Harsh Environments
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) are prone to invalidity in harsh conditions, which presents a critical challenge for wearable electronics. Herein, a chemical-resistant triboelectric material (OP/CM3), with a synergistic effect achieved by oriented structure (polyvinylidene fluoride, PVDF) and nanofiller (carboxylated multiwalled carbon nanotubes, C-MWCNT), is constructed via high-speed electrospinning. The OP/CM3 exhibits outstanding triboelectric performance (105.21 V) and tensile strength (5.73 MPa) due to high β-phase content formed by mechanical stretching and hydrogen bond interactions, which are 1.49 and 3.18 times higher than those of the random PVDF/C-MWCNT. Meanwhile, the OP/CM3 self-extinguishes within 1 s after leaving the flame, which demonstrates excellent flame retardance. In addition, the open-circuit voltage of the OP/CM3-TENG maintains 46.12% at 200 °C and 16.43% after burning for 30 s and is higher than most flame-retardant triboelectric materials. Ultimately, the device not only outputs stable signals after being immersed in solutions of NaOH, ethyl acetate, and NaCl for 30 min but also triggers an alarm instantly at 200 °C and monitors firefighters’ real-time status. This work provides a method for synergistically enhancing triboelectric material properties, which expands its utilities in multiple harsh environments.
title_zh: 恶劣环境下高性能摩擦电复合材料的定向结构和纳米填料的协同策略
abstract_zh: 摘要 摩擦纳米发电机（TENG）在恶劣条件下容易失效，这对可穿戴电子产品提出了严峻的挑战。在此，通过高速静电纺丝构建了一种耐化学摩擦电材料（OP/CM3），该材料通过取向结构（聚偏二氟乙烯，PVDF）和纳米填料（羧化多壁碳纳米管，C-MWCNT）实现协同效应。由于机械拉伸和氢键相互作用形成的高β相含量，OP/CM3表现出出色的摩擦电性能（105.21 V）和拉伸强度（5.73 MPa），比无规PVDF/C-MWCNT高1.49和3.18倍。同时，OP/CM3在离开火焰后1秒内自熄，表现出优异的阻燃性。此外，OP/CM3-TENG的开路电压在200℃时保持46.12%，燃烧30s后保持16.43%，高于大多数阻燃摩擦电材料。最终，该装置在NaOH、醋酸乙酯、氯化钠溶液中浸泡30分钟后不仅能输出稳定的信号，而且在200℃的温度下能立即触发警报，监控消防员的实时状态。这项工作提供了一种协同增强摩擦电材料性能的方法，从而扩展了其在多种恶劣环境中的效用。

title: Dual-Radical Gardenia Blue Conjugated Polymers with High Relaxivity and Bioreductive Stability as Metal-Free MRI Contrast Agents
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract T 1-weighted MRI contrast agents are essential for accurate diagnosis. However, clinical gadolinium-based contrast agents (Gd-CAs) are increasingly questioned because of risks of nephrogenic systemic fibrosis (NSF) and long-term tissue accumulation. Metal-free organic nitroxides like TEMPO emerge as safer alternatives but are limited by rapid in vivo bioreduction and suboptimal r1 relaxivity. Here, we report TEMPO-PROXY@pGen, a dual-radical, bio-based, π-conjugated polymer synthesized through mechanochemical copolymerization of 4-amino-TEMPO with 4-amino-PROXYL (3,3,5,5-tetramethyl-1-pyrroline N-oxide) on genipin-crosslinked scaffolds. TEMPO-PROXY@pGen integrates rigid π-conjugated backbone anchoring with possible intramolecular biradical interactions, causing the apparent rotational correlation time (τR,app) to approach the regime where Solomon–Bloembergen–Morgan (SBM) theory predicts enhanced relaxivity for simple monoradical systems while preserving high effective spin density (>80 radicals per chain). This yields a longitudinal relaxivity (r1) of 4.35 mM–1s–1 at 1.4 T and 3.69 mM–1s–1 at 3.0 T, 33.5-fold higher than TEMPO and comparable per-molecule r1 to clinically approved gadobutrol at the same field strength. The polymeric architecture confers high resistance to bioreduction and lower cell toxicity. Preliminary biosafety evaluation, including histopathology, serum biomarkers, and functional imaging, in both healthy and cisplatin-induced renal impairment models, suggests an improved safety profile relative to Gd-CAs under the tested conditions. This work establishes a rational molecular engineering framework for fully organic, metal-free MRI contrast agents that separates high relaxivity from heavy metal dependence for safe imaging in patients with compromised renal function.
title_zh: 具有高弛豫率和生物还原稳定性的双自由基栀子蓝共轭聚合物作为无金属 MRI 造影剂
abstract_zh: 摘要 T 1 加权MRI造影剂对于准确诊断至关重要。然而，由于肾源性系统性纤维化（NSF）和长期组织积累的风险，临床钆基造影剂（Gd-CA）受到越来越多的质疑。像 TEMPO 这样的无金属有机氮氧化合物成为更安全的替代品，但受到快速体内生物还原和次优 r1 弛豫的限制。在这里，我们报道了 TEMPO-PROXY@pGen，一种双自由基、生物基、π-共轭聚合物，通过 4-氨基-TEMPO 与 4-氨基-PROXYL（3,3,5,5-四甲基-1-吡咯啉 N-氧化物）在京尼平交联支架上的机械化学共聚而合成。 TEMPO-PROXY@pGen 将刚性 π 共轭主链锚定与可能的分子内双自由基相互作用相结合，使表观旋转相关时间 (τR,app) 接近 Solomon-Bloembergen-Morgan (SBM) 理论预测简单单自由基系统的弛豫性增强的状态，同时保持高有效自旋密度（每链 >80 个自由基）。这样产生的纵向弛豫率 (r1) 在 1.4 T 时为 4.35 mM–1s–1，在 3.0 T 时为 3.69 mM–1s–1，比 TEMPO 高 33.5 倍，并且在相同场强下每分子 r1 与临床批准的钆布醇相当。聚合物结构具有高抗生物还原性和较低的细胞毒性。在健康和顺铂诱导的肾损伤模型中进行的初步生物安全性评估（包括组织病理学、血清生物标志物和功能成像）表明，在测试条件下，相对于 Gd-CA 而言，安全性有所改善。这部作品

title: A unified mechano-ionic skin for resolving native electromechanical coupling
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The beat-to-beat electromechanical coupling between cardiac excitation and arterial pulse propagation encodes vital cardiovascular insights, but resolving this coherence in wearables is hindered by the spatial decoupling of sensors and attenuated epidermal signals. Here, we report a unified mechano-ionic skin that preserves this coherence through conducting biopotentials and efficiently transducing arterial pressures along a single ion-conducting pathway. By synergizing molecular cation tethering with microscale stress concentration, our design breaks the symmetry of ion dynamics. This yields a giant piezoionic sensitivity of 1071 mV kPa−1, exceeding state-of-the-art ionic conductors by over two orders of magnitude. This response resolves pulse waves and electrocardiograms simultaneously, eliminating cross-sensor synchronization errors. Implemented in a wristband, the interface enables beat-to-beat blood pressure monitoring and repeatedly tracks cardiovascular functions under daily resting conditions, demonstrating multimodal sensory fusion can be engineered as an intrinsic property of soft matter by precisely regulating ion dynamics.
title_zh: 用于解决本地机电耦合问题的统一机械离子皮肤
abstract_zh: 心脏兴奋和动脉脉冲传播之间的逐次机电耦合编码了重要的心血管洞察力，但解决可穿戴设备中的这种一致性受到传感器的空间解耦和减弱的表皮信号的阻碍。在这里，我们报告了一种统一的机械离子皮肤，它通过传导生物电并沿着单一离子传导途径有效地转换动脉压来保持这种一致性。通过协同分子阳离子束缚与微尺度应力集中，我们的设计打破了离子动力学的对称性。这产生了 1071 mV kPa−1 的巨大压电离子灵敏度，比最先进的离子导体高出两个数量级以上。这种响应可以同时解析脉搏波和心电图，从而消除跨传感器同步误差。该界面在腕带中实现，可实现逐次血压监测，并在日常休息条件下重复跟踪心血管功能，证明多模态感觉融合可以通过精确调节离子动力学来设计为软物质的固有特性。

title: Stoichiometry-driven electronic heterogeneity in covalent organic frameworks for coupled H2O2 photoproduction and chemoselective fragrance upgrading
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Coupling H2O2 photoproduction with value-added organic transformations avoids the sluggish kinetics of water oxidation, yet integrating both processes within one photocatalyst remains challenging. Here, we report stoichiometry-driven electronic heterogeneity in covalent organic frameworks (COFs) as a strategy for simultaneous H2O2 photoproduction and chemoselective fragrance upgrading. Adjusting monomer stoichiometry with distinct geometric symmetries perturbs local structural symmetry, generating electronically differentiated microenvironments within the COF skeleton. The optimized PTPD-COF1 achieves a H2O2 photosynthetic rate of 10.4 mmol g−1 h−1 in pure water, surpassing its binary analogues, and delivers coupled rates of 36.1, 53.2, and 21.6 mmol g−1 h−1 with near-quantitative, chemoselective conversion of cinnamyl, anisyl, and o-anisyl alcohols into fragrances. Theoretical analysis shows the modulated electronic environment enhances local dipole moments and lowers carrier effective masses, altering energy barriers for *OOH/*OH formation and C-H cleavage. In this work, stoichiometry-driven electronic heterogeneity is established as a design principle for multifunctional organic photocatalysts.
title_zh: 共价有机框架中化学计量驱动的电子异质性，用于耦合 H2O2 光生产和化学选择性香料升级
abstract_zh: 将 H2O2 光生产与增值有机转化相结合可以避免水氧化的缓慢动力学，但将这两个过程集成到一种光催化剂中仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了共价有机框架（COF）中化学计量驱动的电子异质性，作为同时 H2O2 光生产和化学选择性香料升级的策略。调整具有不同几何对称性的单体化学计量会扰乱局部结构对称性，在COF骨架内产生电子差异化的微环境。优化的 PTPD-COF1 在纯水中实现了 10.4 mmol g−1 h−1 的 H2O2 光合速率，超过了其二元类似物，并提供了 36.1、53.2 和 21.6 mmol g−1 h−1 的耦合速率，并将肉桂醇、茴香醇和邻茴香醇近乎定量地化学选择性转化为香料。理论分析表明，调制的电子环境增强了局部偶极矩并降低了载流子有效质量，改变了 *OOH/*OH 形成和 C-H 裂解的能垒。在这项工作中，化学计量驱动的电子异质性被确立为多功能有机光催化剂的设计原理。

title: Electrochemical hydrogenation of biomass substrates with cation shuttling in a solid electrolyte reactor
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Electrochemical hydrogenation of biomass-derived substrates offers a sustainable route to valuable chemicals, yet conventional systems often struggle to simultaneously achieve high efficiency and high product purity. Here we report an electrochemical process based on a porous solid-electrolyte reactor that integrates efficient hydrogenation with intrinsic purification for biomass-derived substrates, thereby eliminating the need for supporting electrolytes. The system promotes the hydrogenation of maleic acid solution (a model unsaturated biomass substrate) into succinic acid (a model saturated biomass substrate), via a cation shielding effect while suppressing competing reactions such as hydrogen evolution. By continuously recycling the generated sodium succinate from the cathode to the middle layer, the reactor further converts it into pure succinic acid, establishing a closed-loop alkali-metal-cation shuttle that enhances selectivity and minimizes side reactions. This system delivers succinic acid Faradaic efficiencies ~ 85%, long-term operational stability (over 500 hours), and a final solution of > 98% purity, without downstream electrolyte recovery. These results highlight a scalable pathway toward cleaner, more efficient electrochemical upgrading of biomass.
title_zh: 固体电解质反应器中阳离子穿梭生物质基质的电化学氢化
abstract_zh: 生物质衍生底物的电化学氢化提供了获取有价值化学品的可持续途径，但传统系统往往难以同时实现高效率和高产品纯度。在这里，我们报告了一种基于多孔固体电解质反应器的电化学过程，该反应器将高效氢化与生物质衍生基质的内在纯化相结合，从而消除了对支持电解质的需求。该系统通过阳离子屏蔽效应促进马来酸溶液（一种不饱和生物质底物模型）氢化成琥珀酸（一种饱和生物质底物模型），同时抑制析氢等竞争反应。通过将产生的琥珀酸钠不断地从阴极回收到中间层，反应器进一步将其转化为纯琥珀酸，建立闭环碱金属阳离子梭，提高选择性并最大限度地减少副反应。该系统提供约 85% 的琥珀酸法拉第效率、长期运行稳定性（超过 500 小时）以及纯度 > 98% 的最终溶液，无需下游电解液回收。这些结果凸显了一条通向更清洁、更高效的生物质电化学升级的可扩展途径。

title: Interpretable self-driving sputtering epitaxy reveals human-usable growth rules for β-Ga2O3 films
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Self-driving laboratories are powerful tools for navigating high-dimensional process spaces, yet Bayesian-optimization decision layers optimize black-box objective functions without distilling transferable process understanding. Here, we demonstrate a mathematically interpretable self-driving laboratory framework that transforms autonomous optimization data into human-executable growth rules. As a benchmark, we apply this framework to sputtering, addressing a challenge in sputtering epitaxy: realizing high-quality β-Ga2O3 heteroepitaxy and single-crystalline β-Ga2O3 homoepitaxy. By combining Bayesian optimization with automated optical evaluation of the Urbach energy as a sub-bandgap disorder metric, the self-driving system identifies heteroepitaxial conditions yielding an Urbach energy of 182 meV, below previously reported values for sputtered β-Ga2O3 films. Importantly, the optimized growth window is transferable across substrates, realizing single-crystalline β-Ga2O3 homoepitaxy, corroborated by scanning transmission electron microscopy. To convert closed-loop data into interpretable growth rules, we train a random forest surrogate and reveal that the growth landscape is described by additive contributions from four growth parameters, with a temperature–oxygen interaction. This structure suggests a human-executable strategy with sequential one-dimensional tuning followed by focused two-dimensional refinement, validated by human-executed re-optimization, yielding a reduced Urbach energy of 163 meV. This establishes an interpretable self-driving workflow that converts autonomous optimization data into validated, human-usable growth rules.
title_zh: 可解释的自驱动溅射外延揭示了 β-Ga2O3 薄膜的人类可用生长规则
abstract_zh: 自动驾驶实验室是导航高维过程空间的强大工具，而贝叶斯优化决策层可以优化黑盒目标函数，而无需提取可转移的过程理解。在这里，我们展示了一个数学上可解释的自动驾驶实验室框架，该框架将自主优化数据转换为人类可执行的增长规则。作为基准，我们将该框架应用于溅射，解决溅射外延中的挑战：实现高质量的β-Ga2O3异质外延和单晶β-Ga2O3同质外延。通过将贝叶斯优化与作为子带隙无序度量的 Urbach 能量的自动光学评估相结合，自动驱动系统识别出异质外延条件，产生 182 meV 的 Urbach 能量，低于之前报道的溅射 β-Ga2O3 薄膜的值。重要的是，优化的生长窗口可以跨衬底转移，实现单晶β-Ga2O3同质外延，并通过扫描透射电子显微镜证实。为了将闭环数据转换为可解释的生长规则，我们训练了一个随机森林代理，并揭示了生长景观是由四个生长参数的附加贡献以及温度-氧气相互作用来描述的。这种结构提出了一种人类可执行的策略，先进行顺序一维调整，然后进行集中的二维细化，并通过人类执行的重新优化进行验证，从而将乌尔巴赫能量降低至 163 meV。这建立了一个可解释的自动驾驶工作流程，将自动驾驶

title: Genome-wide CRISPR screening identifies cellular factors controlling nonviral genome editing efficiency
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: To systematically map cellular factors constraining nonviral genome editing, influencing uptake and intracellular trafficking, we develop a genome-wide CRISPR screening platform linking perturbation of 19,114 genes to editing outcomes in human cells. We identify six negative regulators of delivery whose depletion increases editing efficiency by up to six-fold across diverse payloads, loci, and cell types. We test the top two factors, GJB2 and BET1L, in two distinct human models: correction of a pathogenic adenine base mutation in KCNJ13 and introduction of a cytosine base mutation in the GABAA receptor gene. Depletion of either improves base-editing outcomes by 6-fold, potentially through effects on delivery. In a patient-derived model of retinal channelopathy, knockdown of either gene improves lipid nanoparticle base editing efficiency by over 3.5-fold. This enables functional restoration of Kir7.1 ion channels in a subset of edited cells, highlighting cellular barriers as actionable targets to enhance the potency of genetic therapies.
title_zh: 全基因组 CRISPR 筛选识别控制非病毒基因组编辑效率的细胞因素
abstract_zh: 为了系统地绘制限制非病毒基因组编辑、影响摄取和细胞内运输的细胞因素，我们开发了一个全基因组 CRISPR 筛选平台，将 19,114 个基因的扰动与人类细胞的编辑结果联系起来。我们确定了六种传递负调控因子，其耗尽可将不同有效负载、基因座和细胞类型的编辑效率提高六倍。我们在两个不同的人类模型中测试了最重要的两个因素：GJB2 和 BET1L：纠正 KCNJ13 中的致病性腺嘌呤碱基突变以及在 GABAA 受体基因中引入胞嘧啶碱基突变。任何一个的耗尽都可以将碱基编辑结果提高 6 倍，这可能是通过对传递的影响来实现的。在源自患者的视网膜通道病模型中，任一基因的敲低均可将脂质纳米颗粒碱基编辑效率提高 3.5 倍以上。这使得经过编辑的细胞子集中的 Kir7.1 离子通道能够功能恢复，突出细胞屏障作为增强基因疗法效力的可行目标。

title: The choice-wide behavioral association study: data-driven identification of interpretable behavioral components
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Behavior contains rich structure across many timescales. However, there is a dearth of methods to identify relevant components, especially over the longer periods required for learning and decision-making. Inspired by the goals and techniques of genome-wide association studies, we present a data-driven method—the choice-wide behavioral association study: CBAS—that systematically identifies such behavioral features. CBAS extracts sequences of actions or choices that either significantly differ between groups or correlate with a covariate of interest, using a powerful resampling-based method to correct for multiple comparisons. We illustrate CBAS through application to tasks performed by flies, rats, and humans, showing that it provides unexpected and interpretable information in each case.
title_zh: 全选择行为关联研究：数据驱动的可解释行为成分识别
abstract_zh: 行为包含跨多个时间尺度的丰富结构。然而，缺乏识别相关组成部分的方法，尤其是在学习和决策所需的较长时期内。受全基因组关联研究的目标和技术的启发，我们提出了一种数据驱动的方法——全选择行为关联研究：CBAS——系统地识别此类行为特征。 CBAS 使用强大的基于重采样的方法来纠正多重比较，提取组间显着差异或与感兴趣的协变量相关的行动或选择序列。我们通过将 CBAS 应用于果蝇、大鼠和人类执行的任务来说明 CBAS，表明它在每种情况下都提供了意想不到的且可解释的信息。

title: Multi-ancestry genetic architecture of heart failure subtypes
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Heart failure (HF) affects 6.7 million people in the US and includes two major subtypes, HF with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) and HF with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), with distinct genetic architectures. We meta-analyze genome-wide association studies (GWAS) of 38,781 HFrEF cases, 38,163 HFpEF cases, and 526,135 controls across European, African, Hispanic, and Asian ancestries using the Million Veteran Program and Vanderbilt University DNA Databank (BioVU). We identify 46 genome-wide significant loci for HFrEF (9 novel) and 3 loci for HFpEF (1 novel). Four HFrEF loci are detected in African ancestry participants near CD36, SPI1, TRIM48, and SPNS3, with lead SNPs showing low risk-allele frequencies in European populations. In the all-cause HF meta-analysis (200,070 cases, 2,076,466 controls), we identify 136 loci (12 novel). Gene-based tests, tissue enrichment, transcriptome-wide association, and fine-mapping implicate vascular, metabolic, and TGF-β/Smad signaling pathways and nominate candidate causal genes, clarifying shared and subtype-specific risk across ancestries.
title_zh: 心力衰竭亚型的多祖先遗传结构
abstract_zh: 心力衰竭 (HF) 影响美国 670 万人，包括两种主要亚型：射血分数降低的心力衰竭 (HFrEF) 和射血分数保留的心力衰竭 (HFpEF)，具有不同的遗传结构。我们使用百万退伍军人计划和范德比尔特大学 DNA 数据库 (BioVU) 对欧洲、非洲、西班牙和亚洲血统的 38,781 个 HFrEF 病例、38,163 个 HFpEF 病例和 526,135 个对照进行全基因组关联研究 (GWAS) 分析。我们确定了 HFrEF 的 46 个全基因组显着基因座（9 个新基因座）和 HFpEF 的 3 个基因座（1 个新基因座）。在非洲血统参与者中检测到 CD36、SPI1、TRIM48 和 SPNS3 附近的四个 HFrEF 位点，其中先导 SNP 在欧洲人群中显示出较低的风险等位基因频率。在全因心衰荟萃分析（200,070 例病例，2,076,466 对照）中，我们确定了 136 个基因座（12 个新基因座）。基于基因的测试、组织富集、全转录组关联和精细定位涉及血管、代谢和 TGF-β/Smad 信号通路，并提名候选因果基因，阐明跨祖先的共享风险和亚型特异性风险。

title: AAT/SERPINA1 Pi*Z variant linked to gestational length and preterm birth prevention via AAT in mice
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: About 10% of pregnancies end prematurely before 37 weeks, without effective prevention therapies. Previously, we identified rare damaging variants in SERPINA1 encoding alpha-1-antitrypsin (AAT) in families with recurrent spontaneous preterm births and detected decreased protein and transcript levels of AAT/SERPINA1 from placentas in spontaneous preterm births. Here, we investigate genetic associations between SERPINA1 variants and gestational duration and evaluate AAT supplementation as a therapeutic intervention in a mouse model of preterm birth. SERPINA1 Pi*Z variant (rs28929474-T) is associated with gestational duration (P −8) in European-ancestry mothers with spontaneous preterm and term deliveries. We detect a nine-day decrease in gestational duration and a fourfold odds for preterm birth vs. term birth in Pi*Z homozygotes (Pi*ZZ), compared to other genotypes. In transgenic mice without endogenous AAT, exogenous Prolastin® treatment inhibits lipopolysaccharide induced preterm births (P SERPINA1 Pi*ZZ genotype carriers.
title_zh: AAT/SERPINA1 Pi*Z 变体通过 AAT 与小鼠妊娠长度和早产预防相关
abstract_zh: 如果没有有效的预防治疗，大约 10% 的妊娠会在 37 周之前提前结束。此前，我们在反复自发性早产的家庭中发现了编码α-1-抗胰蛋白酶（AAT）的SERPINA1中罕见的破坏性变异，并检测到自发性早产胎盘中AAT/SERPINA1的蛋白质和转录水平降低。在这里，我们研究了 SERPINA1 变异与妊娠持续时间之间的遗传关联，并评估 AAT 补充剂作为早产小鼠模型的治疗干预作用。 SERPINA1 Pi*Z 变异 (rs28929474-T) 与自发性早产和足月分娩的欧洲血统母亲的妊娠持续时间 (P −8) 相关。我们发现，与其他基因型相比，Pi*Z 纯合子 (Pi*ZZ) 的妊娠持续时间缩短了 9 天，早产几率是足月出生的四倍。在没有内源性 AAT 的转基因小鼠中，外源性 Prolastin® 治疗可抑制脂多糖诱导的早产（P SERPINA1 Pi*ZZ 基因型携带者。

title: Phylogenetic reconciliation supports a methanogenic ancestor of the Archaea and a derived origin for host-associated lineages
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The phylogeny of the Archaea continues to be revisited and revised as new groups are discovered and phylogenetic methods improve, but key questions about their early evolution remain unanswered. It has been suggested that the root of the Archaea may lie on, or potentially within, any of three major groups - the Euryarchaeota, TACK+Asgard clade, and DPANN, the last of which includes many host-associated and genome-reduced lineages. These root hypotheses make starkly different predictions about the nature of early archaeal evolution: for example, a root on or within DPANN might suggest a small-genome and host-associated ancestor, with methanogenesis, the hallmark metabolism of the Archaea, evolving later. Here, we investigate the position of the archaeal root and the nature of the last archaeal common ancestor using a range of phylogenetic approaches, including the best available site- and branch-heterogeneous substitution models, and new gene tree-species tree reconciliation models that capture changes in rates of gene duplication, loss and transfer across the phylogeny. Our analyses converge on a narrow archaeal root region at or near the base of the Euryarchaeota, supporting hypotheses in which the Last Archaeal Common Ancestor (LACA) was a complex, free-living (hyper-)thermophilic methanogen. We recover DPANN as the sister group to TACK and Asgard archaea, and suggest that their genome evolution has been characterised by episodes of genome streamlining and expansion, driven by gene loss and transfer.
title_zh: 系统发育协调支持古细菌的产甲烷祖先和宿主相关谱系的衍生起源
abstract_zh: 随着新类群的发现和系统发育方法的改进，古细菌的系统发育不断被重新审视和修订，但有关其早期进化的关键问题仍未得到解答。有人认为古细菌的根源可能位于或可能位于三个主要类群中的任何一个——广古菌门、TACK+Asgard 分支和 DPANN，其中最后一个包括许多与宿主相关和基因组减少的谱系。这些根假说对早期古菌进化的性质做出了截然不同的预测：例如，DPANN上或DPANN内的根可能表明有一个小基因组和宿主相关的祖先，具有产甲烷作用，这是古菌的标志性代谢，后来进化。在这里，我们使用一系列系统发育方法研究古菌根的位置和最后一个古菌共同祖先的性质，包括最佳可用的位点和分支异质替代模型，以及新的基因树-物种树协调模型，该模型捕获整个系统发育中基因复制、丢失和转移率的变化。我们的分析集中在广古菌基部或附近的狭窄古菌根区域，支持最后古菌共同祖先（LACA）是一种复杂的、自由生活的（超）嗜热产甲烷菌的假设。我们将 DPANN 恢复为 TACK 和 Asgard 古菌的姐妹群，并表明它们的基因组进化的特点是基因组精简和扩展的事件，由基因丢失和转移驱动。

title: Iron-induced demethoxylation of lignin as an important source for methanol and its oxidation products in the environment
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Lignin, the largest reservoir of aromatic carbon in plants and soils, undergoes well-characterized biological demethylation by fungi and bacteria, and is industrially processed under harsh conditions to generate bio-based aromatics. However, the abiotic fate of lignin-derived methoxy groups under environmentally relevant conditions remains unresolved. Here, we report an iron-mediated demethoxylation mechanism involving direct aromatic C–O bond cleavage under ambient conditions. Using FeII/FeIII species and H2O2, we demonstrate the efficient release of entire methoxy groups from lignin monomers and methoxyphenols, forming methanol and subsequently formaldehyde. Isotopic labeling unequivocally shows that the complete –OCH3 group is liberated intact. Density functional theory calculations support an exergonic demethoxylation pathway with low activation energy (43 kJ/mol) and favorable thermodynamics. Soil laboratory incubation experiments with lignin and diverse natural soils rich in iron and methoxylated organic matter confirm that this abiotic pathway operates under environmentally relevant wet–dry conditions. These findings establish iron-induced demethoxylation as a abiotic process, linking lignin turnover to microbial C1 metabolism and soil carbon cycling, with implications for atmospheric trace gas fluxes.
title_zh: 铁诱导的木质素脱甲氧基是环境中甲醇及其氧化产物的重要来源
abstract_zh: 木质素是植物和土壤中最大的芳香碳库，经过真菌和细菌的充分表征的生物去甲基化，并在恶劣的条件下进行工业加工，产生生物基芳烃。然而，木质素衍生的甲氧基在环境相关条件下的非生物命运仍未解决。在这里，我们报告了一种铁介导的脱甲氧基化机制，涉及环境条件下芳香族 C-O 键的直接裂解。使用 FeII/FeIII 物质和 H2O2，我们证明了木质素单体和甲氧基酚中整个甲氧基的有效释放，形成甲醇，随后形成甲醛。同位素标记明确表明完整的 –OCH3 基团已完整释放。密度泛函理论计算支持具有低活化能（43 kJ/mol）和有利的热力学的放能脱甲氧基化途径。土壤实验室用木质素和富含铁和甲氧基化有机物的多种天然土壤进行的孵化实验证实，这种非生物途径在环境相关的干湿条件下运行。这些发现将铁诱导的脱甲氧基化确定为一种非生物过程，将木质素周转与微生物 C1 代谢和土壤碳循环联系起来，并对大气微量气体通量产生影响。

title: Non-solvating additives regulate zinc deposition through anion-gated Stern-layer competition
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: While additive-induced modulation of solvation structure has emerged as an effective strategy to enhance the performance of aqueous zinc-ion batteries, the electrochemical mechanisms by which non-solvation additives interact with ion species within the electric double layer and their subsequent impact on solid electrolyte interphase evolution remain poorly understood. Here, we propose an anion-released interfacial engineering strategy that leverages the competitive spatial distribution between surface-affinitive anions and cationic regulators within the Stern layer. This competition governs additive accessibility to the interface and enables the construction of a robust, inorganic–organic hybrid interface. Combined with in situ spectra and theoretical simulations, we decouple the key kinetic processes in Zn deposition, revealing that fast Zn2+ transport within the solid electrolyte interphase, coupled with moderated desolvation at the interface, underpins dendrite-free and highly reversible cycling. This study has the potential to establish a mechanistic framework for the interfacial function of non-solvating additives, thus offering refined insights into electrolyte design and interphase engineering for high-performance aqueous metal batteries.
title_zh: 非溶剂添加剂通过阴离子门控斯特恩层竞争调节锌沉积
abstract_zh: 虽然添加剂诱导的溶剂化结构调节已成为增强水系锌离子电池性能的有效策略，但非溶剂化添加剂与双电层内离子物质相互作用的电化学机制及其对固体电解质界面演化的后续影响仍知之甚少。在这里，我们提出了一种阴离子释放界面工程策略，该策略利用斯特恩层内表面亲和阴离子和阳离子调节剂之间的竞争性空间分布。这种竞争控制了界面的添加剂可访问性，并能够构建坚固的无机-有机混合界面。结合原位光谱和理论模拟，我们解耦了 Zn 沉积的关键动力学过程，揭示了固体电解质界面内 Zn2+ 的快速传输，加上界面处的适度去溶剂化，支撑了无枝晶和高度可逆的循环。这项研究有可能为非溶剂化添加剂的界面功能建立一个机制框架，从而为高性能水性金属电池的电解质设计和界面工程提供深入的见解。

title: Global geopolitical risk and energy poverty: New evidence from cross-country data
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Energy Policy
title_zh: 全球地缘政治风险和能源贫困：来自跨国数据的新证据

title: Public institutions for cleantech commercialization in the United States
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The United States has been building public institutions to promote cleantech commercialization since the 1970s oil crisis. The ascent of new industrial policy has accelerated this process substantially since 2020, resulting in a doubling of the total number of institutions by 2024. Introducing a dataset of 122 institutions, we show how institutions perform five functions: goal setting, coordination, derisking, imposing discipline, and external engagement. Further, we demonstrate how post-2020 institutions extend and diverge from historical trends, highlighting the recent buildout of planning capacity, the widespread use of conditionalities, and the pivot toward engagement with local and non-firm actors. We conclude with an analysis of how the second Trump administration is transforming the cleantech commercialization system through retrenching, redesigning, repurposing, and maintaining institutions. We offer a bottom-up, institution-level examination of the emergence and evolution of state capacity for green industrial policy in the United States, its functions, and current developments.
title_zh: 美国清洁技术商业化的公共机构
abstract_zh: 自 20 世纪 70 年代石油危机以来，美国一直在建立公共机构来促进清洁技术商业化。自 2020 年以来，新产业政策的兴起大大加速了这一进程，到 2024 年机构总数将增加一倍。通过引入 122 个机构的数据集，我们展示了机构如何履行五项职能：目标设定、协调、去风险、施加纪律和外部参与。此外，我们还展示了 2020 年后的机构如何延伸和偏离历史趋势，强调近期规划能力的建设、条件的广泛使用以及转向与当地和非企业参与者的接触。最后，我们分析了特朗普第二届政府如何通过紧缩、重新设计、重新利用和维护机构来改变清洁技术商业化体系。我们对美国绿色产业政策国家能力的出现和演变、其职能和当前发展进行自下而上的机构层面研究。

title: Conjugated Thiophene Linker Design of the Self‐Assembled Monolayer Toward Highly Efficient and Stable Organic Solar Cells
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Achieving high power conversion efficiency (PCE) and operational stability remains a critical challenge of organic solar cells (OSCs). While the 2PACz self‐assembled monolayer (SAM) offers suppressed parasitic absorption and facilitated charge collection over the routinely‐used PEDOT:PSS hole‐transport layer (HTL), their operational stability is often limited by the vulnerable chemical structure under high‐energy photon illumination. In this work, we design and synthesize two SAMs, PhPACz and ThPACz, whose flexible alkyl linker between phosphonic acid and carbazole of 2PACz is substituted by rigid phenyl or thiophene to manipulate the HOMO and LUMO orbitals and further mediate the electron density distribution of SAM, thereby promoting charge delocalization at the interface and enhancing photochemical stability. title: A democracy tax in support of science
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Over the past 19 months, the devastating effects of federal cuts to science funding in the United States have become plain: Young researchers are leaving scientific fields. title: Forest canopy decline under elevated CO2 during the Paleocene-Eocene Thermal Maximum
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Uncertainty remains regarding the impact of rapid anthropogenic warming on forest ecosystem structure, biodiversity, and function. As an analog, we reconstruct forest canopy density and compositional change in Wyoming, USA, through the Paleocene-Eocene Thermal Maximum (PETM), an interval of abrupt carbon increase and warming ~56 million years ago. We develop a proxy to quantify leaf area index and assess shifts in floral composition using palynomorphs. Forest canopies opened abruptly at onset of PETM warming, landscape erosion increased, and vegetation shifted from broad-leaved angiosperm to fern- and palm-dominated ecosystems. When combined with regional data, these patterns suggest that continental-scale changes in plant communities cause landscape destabilization. These shifts also have implications for multimillennial-scale hydrologic and carbon cycle feedbacks in the climate system.

title: Eco-evolutionary feedback reshapes competitive dynamics in an orchard fly system
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: The feedback between competition and evolution is central to hypotheses about the origin and maintenance of species diversity. Yet, whether competition-induced evolution is sufficiently rapid, consistent, and strong to maintain diversity on ecological timescales remains unresolved. We conducted an outdoor mesocosm experiment with four pairs of orchard fly species in which we manipulated species’ ability to evolve to one another during interspecific competition. We found significant competition-induced rapid evolution across phenotypes, which typically shifted in parallel across species. This evolution strongly affected the competitive population dynamics of all species pairs, typically boosting the rarer species’ abundance, and in one pair, reversing the abundance hierarchy. These results suggest that feedback between competition and evolution may be common and maintain species diversity on ecological timescales.

title: A joint geophysical-geochemical deep-mantle zoning map beneath East Africa and the Indian Ocean
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Geochemical signatures of hotspot lavas suggest that their mantle sources are compositionally distinct, but their source locations remain elusive. Mapping hotspots to their deep origins is complicated by the presence of interconnected, low–seismic velocity networks in the mantle, where plumelike anomalies often deviate from vertical conduits. We propose a graph theory–based framework to systematically trace ensembles of plume paths using a high-resolution regional tomographic model. Applied to eight East African and Indian Ocean hotspots, our method identified clustered source zones near the core-mantle boundary. Multivariate analysis of the isotope ratios of hotspot-related basalts reveals a broadly similar clustering. Together, these independent observations provide a first-order joint geophysical-geochemical zoning map in this region, with at least three distinct domains within the African large low-shear-velocity province (LLSVP).

title: Promoter-driven recrystallization affording highly textured ruthenium
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: The electrical properties of polycrystalline materials are governed by crystallite characteristics and spatial arrangement. We grew ruthenium polycrystals with a near-complete out-of-plane preferred orientation and predominantly low-energy grain boundaries on amorphous dielectric substrates, without relying on epitaxial growth or lattice-matched conditions. Whereas prior studies used high-density, high-quality polycrystalline materials derived from high-purity sources, we exploited trace carbon as a transient promoter at grain boundaries, revealing that it generated transient free volume during recrystallization and thus facilitated atomic migration, driving the dynamic vertical and horizontal orientation of grains. Our findings provide microscopic insights into the engineering of grain boundary kinetics through controlled trace element incorporation. The developed strategy is applicable to other polycrystalline materials, offering versatility for advanced material design and applications.

title: Tracking the baryon number with nuclear collisions
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract:
Baryon quantum number is found to be conserved since baryogenesis in the early Universe. Conventionally, each fractionally charged valence quark is understood to carry one-third of a baryon number. An alternative hypothesis posits that baryon number is instead carried by a baryon junction—a nonperturbative, Y-shaped gluonic configuration. Neither scenario has been verified experimentally. The STAR Collaboration reports measurements at mid-rapidity of baryon number (

                    B

title: Xylose phosphatase activity of dystroglycan self-regulates its receptor function
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Dystroglycan (DG) is an extracellular matrix receptor crucial for tissue development and pathogen entry. DG harbors a long, complex glycan called matriglycan. Loss of matriglycan or reduction in its length disrupts DG function, causing dystroglycanopathies. However, the mechanism regulating matriglycan length is unknown. In this study, we found that a xylose kinase facilitated the initiation of matriglycan synthesis by adding a phosphate to the xylose of the matriglycan primer. Matriglycan elongation occurred when the phosphate was removed by the N-terminal domain of DG (DGN). DGN has the conserved DXDXT/V active site motif found in haloacid dehalogenase domains of phosphohydrolases. Mutations in this site abolished DGN phosphatase activity, reduced matriglycan length, and caused muscle disease in mice. Thus, DG has an unexpected xylose phosphatase function involved in regulating matriglycan extension.

title: Codon optimization depletes stop codons in alternative reading frames of protein-coding nucleic acid therapeutics
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Out-of-frame translation events, arising from ribosomal frameshifting or noncanonical initiation, are an unavoidable feature of translation. Their consequences depend on the distribution of stop codons in alternative reading frames, which determines the permissiveness of those frames: whether out-of-frame translation terminates quickly or generates extended products. Using quantitative dual-fluorescence reporters, we show that these stop codons function as molecular checkpoints that terminate out-of-frame translation. Genome-wide analysis across 10 organisms reveals that natural coding sequences maintain dense stop codon distributions in alternative frames, with a median spacing of approximately 20 amino acids. Codon optimization, the standard method for enhancing translation, systematically depletes this safeguard. Because all three stop codons (UAA, UAG, UGA) begin with uridine, and optimal human codons exclude uridine from third positions, stop codons in the −1 reading frame become structurally impossible in codon-optimized sequences. Analysis of 120 therapeutic sequences, including FDA-approved COVID-19 messenger RNA (mRNA) vaccines, confirms widespread −1 frame stop codon depletion: out-of-frame products average 164 amino acids, sixfold longer than in natural human genes. Strategic restoration of stop codons through synonymous substitutions eliminates detectable out-of-frame products by mass spectrometry while preserving the intended protein. Although such products and immune responses have been detected in COVID-19 mRNA vaccine recipients, there is no evidence they cause clinical harm; nonetheless, our approach offers a simple way to eliminate them through informed sequence design alone, without changes to manufacturing or regulatory frameworks. Our findings establish stop codon distribution as a critical design parameter for protein-coding nucleic acid therapeutics.
